`src\components\TokenCounter.tsx`:

```tsx
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { Hash, TrendingUp, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Clock, Sparkles, AlertTriangle, Gauge, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { useLiveAPIContext } from '../context/LiveAPIContext';
import { useProfile } from '../context/UserProfileContext';
import type { TokenUsage } from '../hooks/useLiveAPI';

// ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function formatNumber(n: number): string {
  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return n.toString();
}

function timeAgo(date: Date): string {
  const seconds = Math.floor((Date.now() - date.getTime()) / 1000);
  if (seconds < 10) return 'à l\'instant';
  if (seconds < 60) return `il y a ${seconds}s`;
  const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  return `il y a ${minutes}min`;
}

// ─── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface OptimizationData {
  systemPromptTokens: number;
  memoryTokens: number;
  totalBaseTokens: number;
  availableForConversation: number;
  suggestions: string[];
  modelBudget: { maxTotal: number };
  compactEnabled?: boolean;
  savedTokens?: number;
}

// ─── Component ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Compteur de tokens affiché dans la ControlBar.
 * Au clic, affiche un détail des dernières requêtes + optimisations.
 */
export function TokenCounter() {
  const { tokenUsage } = useLiveAPIContext();
  const { profile, setField, save } = useProfile();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [optimization, setOptimization] = useState<OptimizationData | null>(null);
  const [loadingOpt, setLoadingOpt] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [animate, setAnimate] = useState(false);


  // Fermer au clic extérieur
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    function handleClick(e: MouseEvent) {
      if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setOpen(false);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClick);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClick);
  }, [open]);

  // Charger les stats d'optimisation quand on ouvre le dropdown
  const loadOptimization = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoadingOpt(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/tokens/optimization');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'success') {
        setOptimization(data.optimization);
      }
    } catch {
      // Silently fail
    } finally {
      setLoadingOpt(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) loadOptimization();
  }, [open, loadOptimization]);

  const { totalTokens, totalPromptTokens, totalCompletionTokens, history } = tokenUsage;
  const lastUsage = history.length > 0 ? history[history.length - 1] : null;
  // Déclencher l'animation au changement de totalTokens
  useEffect(() => {
    if (totalTokens > 0) {
      setAnimate(true);
      const timer = setTimeout(() => setAnimate(false), 300); // Durée de l'animation
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [totalTokens]);

      {/* Badge principal */}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen(o => !o)}
        className={`px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-semibold tracking-wide select-none flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 active:scale-95 ${animate ? 'scale-110 shadow-orange-200' : 'hover:scale-105'}`}

        style={{
          background: totalTokens > 0
            ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(251,146,60,0.08), rgba(251,146,60,0.15))'
            : 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.03), rgba(0,0,0,0.06))',
          color: totalTokens > 0 ? '#c2410c' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.45)',
          border: `1px solid ${totalTokens > 0 ? 'rgba(251,146,60,0.2)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.06)'}`,
          boxShadow: totalTokens > 0 ? '0 2px 8px rgba(251,146,60,0.08)' : 'none',
        }}
        title={`Jetons utilisés : ${totalTokens.toLocaleString()}`}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-haspopup="dialog"
      >
        <Hash className="w-3 h-3" />
        <span className="font-bold tabular-nums">{formatNumber(totalTokens)}</span>
        {lastUsage && (
          <span className="text-[9px] opacity-60">
            (+{formatNumber(lastUsage.totalTokens)})
          </span>
        )}
      </button>

      {/* Dropdown détail */}
      {open && (
        <div
          className="absolute bottom-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mb-3 w-72 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden z-50"
          style={{
            background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.98), rgba(255,255,255,0.92))',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(24px)',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.8)',
            animation: 'controlbar-dropdown-in 200ms ease-out',
          }}
          role="dialog"
          aria-label="Détail de l'utilisation des tokens"
        >
          {/* Header résumé */}
          <div className="px-4 pt-4 pb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
              <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-orange-50 flex items-center justify-center">
                <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-600" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400">Tokens session</p>
                <p className="text-lg font-black text-gray-800 tabular-nums leading-tight">
                  {totalTokens.toLocaleString()}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Stats prompt / completion */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              <div className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-50/60">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-blue-600 mb-0.5">
                  <ArrowUp className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Prompt</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-blue-800 tabular-nums">
                  {formatNumber(totalPromptTokens)}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50/60">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-emerald-600 mb-0.5">
                  <ArrowDown className="w-3 h-3" />
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">Réponse</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-800 tabular-nums">
                  {formatNumber(totalCompletionTokens)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Historique des dernières requêtes */}
          {history.length > 0 && (
            <div className="px-4 pt-2 pb-3 border-t border-gray-100/80">
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400 mb-2">
                Dernières requêtes ({history.length})
              </p>
              <div className="max-h-36 overflow-y-auto space-y-1 scrollbar-thin pr-1">
                {[...history].reverse().slice(0, 20).map((usage, i) => (
                  <TokenUsageRow key={i} usage={usage} />
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Aucune donnée */}
          {history.length === 0 && (
            <div className="px-4 pb-4 text-center">
              <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">Aucune requête enregistrée</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-300 mt-0.5">Les tokens apparaîtront après la première interaction</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Section Optimisation */}
          <div className="px-4 pt-2 pb-3 border-t border-gray-100/80">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-2">
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-500" />
              <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-gray-400">Optimisation</p>
            </div>

            {loadingOpt && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 animate-pulse">Analyse en cours...</p>
            )}

            {optimization && !loadingOpt && (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {/* Jauge d'utilisation du contexte */}
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] mb-1">
                    <span className="text-gray-500 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Gauge className="w-3 h-3" /> Contexte de base
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-bold text-gray-700 tabular-nums">
                      {formatNumber(optimization.totalBaseTokens)} / {formatNumber(optimization.modelBudget.maxTotal)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-1.5 bg-gray-100 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                    <div
                      className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
                      style={{
                        width: `${Math.min(100, (optimization.totalBaseTokens / optimization.modelBudget.maxTotal) * 100)}%`,
                        background: optimization.totalBaseTokens / optimization.modelBudget.maxTotal > 0.7
                          ? 'linear-gradient(90deg, #f59e0b, #ef4444)'
                          : 'linear-gradient(90deg, #10b981, #06b6d4)',
                      }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between mt-1 text-[9px] text-gray-400">
                    <span>Prompt: {formatNumber(optimization.systemPromptTokens)}</span>
                    <span>Mémoire: {formatNumber(optimization.memoryTokens)}</span>
                    <span>Dispo: {formatNumber(optimization.availableForConversation)}</span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Économies affichées si mode compact actif */}
                  {optimization.compactEnabled && optimization.savedTokens && optimization.savedTokens > 0 && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-1.5 text-[9px] text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50/80 px-2 py-1 rounded-md">
                      <Zap className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                      <span className="font-semibold">−{formatNumber(optimization.savedTokens)} tokens économisés (compact)</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Suggestions */}
                {optimization.suggestions.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    {optimization.suggestions.map((s, i) => (
                      <div
                        key={i}
                        className="flex items-start gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-amber-700 bg-amber-50/60 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg"
                      >
                        <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                        <span>{s}</span>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {optimization.suggestions.length === 0 && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50/60 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg">
                    <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3" />
                    <span>Utilisation optimale des tokens</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Toggle mode compact */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setField('compactPrompt', !profile.compactPrompt);
                    setTimeout(() => { save(); loadOptimization(); }, 100);
                  }}
                  className={`w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-medium transition-all cursor-pointer mt-1 ${
                    profile.compactPrompt
                      ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 ring-1 ring-emerald-200'
                      : 'bg-gray-50/80 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    Mode compact (−40% tokens prompt)
                  </span>
                  <span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-bold uppercase ${
                    profile.compactPrompt ? 'bg-emerald-200 text-emerald-900' : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-500'
                  }`}>
                    {profile.compactPrompt ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}
                  </span>
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
}

// ─── Row d'historique ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function TokenUsageRow({ usage }: { usage: TokenUsage }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50/80 transition-colors">
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px]">
          <span className="text-blue-600 font-medium tabular-nums">
            ↑{formatNumber(usage.promptTokens)}
          </span>
          <span className="text-emerald-600 font-medium tabular-nums">
            ↓{formatNumber(usage.completionTokens)}
          </span>
          <span className="text-gray-800 font-bold tabular-nums">
            Σ{formatNumber(usage.totalTokens)}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] text-gray-400 flex-shrink-0">
        <Clock className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
        {timeAgo(usage.timestamp)}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
/**
 * UnifiedSidebar — Sidebar unifiée fusionnant la navigation globale
 * et les outils IDE en un seul composant cohérent, sans doublons.
 *
 * Structure :
 * 1. Brand Row (en-tête — logo cliquable pour retourner à l'éditeur)
 * 2. IDE Tools (panneaux contextuels, uniquement en mode IDE)
 * 3. Agent Status (contrôle IA, uniquement en mode IDE)
 * 4. Navigation Globale (pages de haut niveau)
 * 5. Footer (paramètres, aide, quit)
 *
 * Améliorations v2 :
 * - Hook useTheme() appelé au top-level (respect des règles React)
 * - Composants extraits : QuitConfirmDialog, AgentStatusBlock, ModeToggleButton
 * - Hook custom useIDEState pour consolider state/actions
 * - buildAIMenuItems simplifié avec flatMap
 * - Accessibilité : Escape, role="menu", aria-labels
 * - Types explicites (pas de cast as Record)
 * - noop déclaré avant utilisation
 */

import { useRef, useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  History,
  Zap,
  HelpCircle,
  Power,
  Settings,
  SlidersHorizontal,
  BrainCircuit,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';

import { useTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { SidebarSection, SidebarSeparator } from './ide/sidebar/SidebarSection';
import { SidebarItem } from './ide/sidebar/SidebarItem';
import { sidebarSections } from '../config/ideSidebarConfig';
import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import logoDark from '../../assets/images/icon-sombre.png';
import logoLight from '../../assets/images/icon-light.png';

import { QuitConfirmDialog } from './sidebar/QuitConfirmDialog';
import { AgentStatusBlock } from './sidebar/AgentStatusBlock';
import { buildAIMenuItems } from './sidebar/buildAIMenuItems';
import { useIDEState } from './sidebar/useIDEState';
import type { UnifiedSidebarProps, SidebarContext } from './sidebar/types';

// Re-export types for consumers
export type { UnifiedSidebarProps } from './sidebar/types';

// ─── Constants ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const noop = () => {};

interface NavItem {
  path: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  label: string;
  match: (p: string) => boolean;
}

const GLOBAL_NAV_ITEMS: NavItem[] = [
  { path: '/history', icon: History, label: 'Historique', match: (p) => p === '/history' },
  { path: '/memories', icon: BrainCircuit, label: 'Mémoires', match: (p) => p === '/memories' },
  { path: '/automation', icon: Zap, label: 'Tâches', match: (p) => p === '/automation' },
  { path: '/settings', icon: Settings, label: 'Paramètres', match: (p) => p === '/settings' },
];

// ─── Composant Principal ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const UnifiedSidebar = memo(function UnifiedSidebar(props: UnifiedSidebarProps) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { theme } = useTheme();
  const { context } = props;

  const assistantMenuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [assistantMenuOpen, setAssistantMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [showQuitConfirm, setShowQuitConfirm] = useState(false);
  const hasAnimatedRef = useRef(false);

  // ── Consolidated IDE state/actions via custom hook ──
  const { state, actions } = useIDEState(props);

  // ── AI Menu items (memoized) ──
  const aiMenuItems = useMemo(
    () => buildAIMenuItems(props.assistantConnected ?? false),
    [props.assistantConnected]
  );

  // ── Close assistant menu on outside click ──
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!assistantMenuOpen) return;
    const handleClickOutside = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (assistantMenuRef.current && !assistantMenuRef.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
        setAssistantMenuOpen(false);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, [assistantMenuOpen]);

  // Mark animated after first render
  useEffect(() => {
    hasAnimatedRef.current = true;
  }, []);

  // ── Quit handlers ──
  const handleQuitClose = useCallback(() => setShowQuitConfirm(false), []);
  const handleQuitConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    setShowQuitConfirm(false);
    (window as any).electronAPI?.quit();
  }, []);

  // ─── Render ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  return (
    <nav
      className="flex flex-col items-center select-none relative"
      style={{
        width: '48px',
        borderRight: '1px solid var(--border-base)',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-sidebar)',
        height: '100%',
        paddingBottom: '6px',
        boxShadow: 'inset -1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03)',
      }}
      aria-label="Navigation principale"
    >
      {/* ═══ BRAND LOGO ═══ */}
      <BrandLogo theme={theme} onNavigate={() => navigate('/ide')} />

      {/* ═══ IDE TOOLS ═══ */}
      {context === 'ide' && (
        <IDEToolsSections
          state={state}
          actions={actions}
          assistantConnected={props.assistantConnected ?? false}
          skipAnimation={hasAnimatedRef.current}
        />
      )}

      {/* Spacer flexible */}
      <div className="flex-1" />

      {/* ═══ AGENT STATUS (IDE only) ═══ */}
      {context === 'ide' && (
        <AgentStatusBlock
          assistantConnected={props.assistantConnected ?? false}
          assistantWorking={props.assistantWorking ?? false}
          assistantMuted={props.assistantMuted ?? false}
          assistantMenuOpen={assistantMenuOpen}
          assistantMenuRef={assistantMenuRef}
          setAssistantMenuOpen={setAssistantMenuOpen}
          aiMenuItems={aiMenuItems}
          state={state}
          actions={actions}
          mode={props.mode ?? 'full'}
          onToggleChat={props.onToggleChat ?? noop}
          onToggleMode={props.onToggleMode ?? noop}
          onConnectAssistant={props.onConnectAssistant ?? noop}
          onDisconnectAssistant={props.onDisconnectAssistant ?? noop}
          onMuteToggle={props.onMuteToggle ?? noop}
        />
      )}

      {/* ═══ NAVIGATION GLOBALE ═══ */}
      <SidebarSeparator thin />
      <GlobalNavSection
        context={context}
        currentPath={location.pathname}
        navigate={navigate}
        showHistory={props.showHistory ?? false}
        onToggleHistory={props.onToggleHistory ?? noop}
        showAutomation={props.showAutomation ?? false}
        onToggleAutomation={props.onToggleAutomation ?? noop}
        showMemory={props.showMemory ?? false}
        onToggleMemory={props.onToggleMemory ?? noop}
      />

      {/* ═══ FOOTER ═══ */}
      <SidebarSeparator thin />
      <FooterSection
        context={context}
        currentPath={location.pathname}
        navigate={navigate}
        showSettings={props.showSettings ?? false}
        onToggleSettings={props.onToggleSettings ?? noop}
        showHelp={props.showHelp ?? false}
        onToggleHelp={props.onToggleHelp ?? noop}
      />

      {/* Quit App (Electron) */}
      {(window as any).electronAPI && (
        <>
          <SidebarItem
            icon={Power}
            active={false}
            onClick={() => setShowQuitConfirm(true)}
            title="Quitter Jarvis OS"
          />
          <QuitConfirmDialog
            open={showQuitConfirm}
            onClose={handleQuitClose}
            onConfirm={handleQuitConfirm}
          />
        </>
      )}
    </nav>
  );
});

// ─── Sub-components ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function BrandLogo({ theme, onNavigate }: { theme: string; onNavigate: () => void }) {
  return (
    <div
      className="w-full h-[60px] flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"
      style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}
    >
      <button
        type="button"
        className="w-[48px] h-[48px] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"
        style={{
          background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
          boxShadow: '0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)',
        }}
        onClick={onNavigate}
        title="Jarvis OS"
        aria-label="Retourner à l'éditeur"
      >
        <img
          src={theme === 'dark' ? logoDark : logoLight}
          alt="Jarvis OS"
          className="w-full h-full object-contain"
        />
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function IDEToolsSections({
  state,
  actions,
  assistantConnected,
  skipAnimation,
}: {
  state: import('./sidebar/types').IDEPanelState;
  actions: import('./sidebar/types').IDEPanelActions;
  assistantConnected: boolean;
  skipAnimation: boolean;
}) {
  // Cast to Record for SidebarSection compatibility (config-driven keys)
  const stateRecord = state as unknown as Record<string, boolean | string | null>;
  const actionsRecord = actions as unknown as Record<string, () => void>;

  return (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center pt-1">
      {sidebarSections.map((section, idx) => (
        <motion.div
          key={section.id}
          className="w-full"
          initial={skipAnimation ? false : { opacity: 0, x: -8 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
          transition={{ delay: skipAnimation ? 0 : idx * 0.05, duration: 0.2, ease: 'easeOut' }}
        >
          <SidebarSection
            config={section}
            state={stateRecord}
            actions={actionsRecord}
            assistantConnected={assistantConnected}
          />
          {idx < sidebarSections.length - 1 && <SidebarSeparator />}
        </motion.div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function GlobalNavSection({
  context,
  currentPath,
  navigate,
  showHistory,
  onToggleHistory,
  showAutomation,
  onToggleAutomation,
  showMemory,
  onToggleMemory,
}: {
  context: SidebarContext;
  currentPath: string;
  navigate: (path: string) => void;
  showHistory: boolean;
  onToggleHistory: () => void;
  showAutomation: boolean;
  onToggleAutomation: () => void;
  showMemory: boolean;
  onToggleMemory: () => void;
}) {
  // Map path → IDE panel toggle (pour éviter navigation hors contexte IDE)
  const ideOverrides: Record<string, { active: boolean; onClick: () => void }> = {
    '/history': { active: showHistory, onClick: onToggleHistory },
    '/automation': { active: showAutomation, onClick: onToggleAutomation },
    '/memories': { active: showMemory, onClick: onToggleMemory },
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center" role="navigation" aria-label="Navigation globale">
      {GLOBAL_NAV_ITEMS.map(({ path, icon, label, match }) => {
        const override = context === 'ide' ? ideOverrides[path] : undefined;
        const active = override ? override.active : match(currentPath);
        const onClick = override ? override.onClick : () => navigate(path);

        return (
          <SidebarItem
            key={path}
            icon={icon}
            active={active}
            onClick={onClick}
            title={label}
          />
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

function FooterSection({
  context,
  currentPath,
  navigate,
  showSettings,
  onToggleSettings,
  showHelp,
  onToggleHelp,
}: {
  context: SidebarContext;
  currentPath: string;
  navigate: (path: string) => void;
  showSettings: boolean;
  onToggleSettings: () => void;
  showHelp: boolean;
  onToggleHelp: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center" role="navigation" aria-label="Aide et paramètres">
      {/* {context === 'ide' && (
        <SidebarItem
          icon={SlidersHorizontal}
          active={showSettings}
          onClick={onToggleSettings}
          title="Réglages éditeur"
        />
      )} */}
      <SidebarItem
        icon={HelpCircle}
        active={context === 'ide' ? showHelp : currentPath === '/help'}
        onClick={context === 'ide' ? onToggleHelp : () => navigate('/help')}
        title="Aide"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';

export function WebcamCapture({ onFrame }: { onFrame: (base64: string) => void }) {
  const videoRef  = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let stream: MediaStream | null = null;
    let interval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

    async function startCamera() {
      try {
        stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true });
        if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = stream;

        interval = setInterval(() => {
          if (!videoRef.current || !canvasRef.current) return;
          const { videoWidth, videoHeight } = videoRef.current;
          if (videoWidth === 0 || videoHeight === 0) return;

          const canvas = canvasRef.current;
          canvas.width  = videoWidth;
          canvas.height = videoHeight;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          if (!ctx) return;

          ctx.drawImage(videoRef.current, 0, 0, videoWidth, videoHeight);
          onFrame(canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.5));
        }, 3000);
      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to start camera', err);
      }
    }

    startCamera();
    return () => {
      if (interval) clearInterval(interval);
      stream?.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
    };
  }, [onFrame]);

  return (
    <div
      className="relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden aspect-video flex items-center justify-center"
      style={{ border: '1px solid var(--border-strong)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}
    >
      <video ref={videoRef} autoPlay playsInline muted className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
      <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="hidden" />

      {/* LIVE badge — red is semantically correct regardless of theme */}
      <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm text-red-400 text-[10px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full border border-red-500/30">
        <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-red-500 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        LIVE
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

`src\components\ide\ActivityFeed.tsx`:

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import {
  Activity, FileText, GitBranch, Terminal, MessageSquare,
  Zap, CheckCircle2, Clock, ChevronDown,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { ActivityStep } from '../../hooks/useLiveAPI';

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface FeedEntry {
  id: string;
  type: 'file' | 'git' | 'terminal' | 'chat' | 'agent' | 'system';
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  timestamp: Date;
  status: 'success' | 'running' | 'error';
}

interface ActivityFeedProps {
  steps: ActivityStep[];
  connected: boolean;
}

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function timeLabel(d: Date): string {
  return d.toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
}

function getIcon(type: FeedEntry['type']) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'file': return FileText;
    case 'git': return GitBranch;
    case 'terminal': return Terminal;
    case 'chat': return MessageSquare;
    case 'agent': return Zap;
    default: return Activity;
  }
}

function getColor(type: FeedEntry['type']) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'file': return '#60a5fa';
    case 'git': return '#f472b6';
    case 'terminal': return '#fbbf24';
    case 'chat': return 'var(--accent-primary)';
    case 'agent': return '#a855f7';
    default: return 'var(--text-muted)';
  }
}

function stepToFeedEntry(step: ActivityStep): FeedEntry {
  const tool = step.tool;
  let type: FeedEntry['type'] = 'agent';
  if (tool.includes('file') || tool.includes('project') || tool.includes('codebase')) type = 'file';
  else if (tool.includes('git')) type = 'git';
  else if (tool.includes('system_execute') || tool.includes('terminal')) type = 'terminal';

  return {
    id: step.id,
    type,
    title: step.label,
    timestamp: step.timestamp,
    status: step.status === 'running' ? 'running' : 'success',
  };
}

// ── Activity Feed Component ────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function ActivityFeed({ steps, connected }: ActivityFeedProps) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(true);

  const entries: FeedEntry[] = steps.map(stepToFeedEntry);
  const grouped = groupByTime(entries);

  if (!connected || entries.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col overflow-hidden" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div
        className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 cursor-pointer select-none flex-shrink-0"
        onClick={() => setExpanded(v => !v)}
      >
        <Activity size={12} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider flex-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
          Activité
        </span>
        <span className="text-[9px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)', color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
          {entries.length}
        </span>
        <ChevronDown size={11} className={`transition-transform ${expanded ? '' : '-rotate-90'}`} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
      </div>

      {/* Feed entries */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {expanded && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto' }}
            exit={{ height: 0 }}
            className="overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="overflow-y-auto max-h-48 px-2 pb-2 space-y-0.5 custom-scrollbar">
              {grouped.map(({ label, items }) => (
                <div key={label}>
                  <div className="text-[9px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                    {label}
                  </div>
                  {items.map((entry) => (
                    <FeedRow key={entry.id} entry={entry} />
                  ))}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Feed Row ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function FeedRow({ entry }: { entry: FeedEntry }) {
  const Icon = getIcon(entry.type);
  const color = getColor(entry.type);
  const isRunning = entry.status === 'running';

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5 transition">
      <div
        className="w-5 h-5 rounded flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"
        style={{ backgroundColor: `${color}12` }}
      >
        <Icon size={10} style={{ color }} />
      </div>
      <span className="text-[10px] flex-1 truncate" style={{ color: isRunning ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
        {entry.title}
      </span>
      <span className="text-[9px] font-mono flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
        {timeLabel(entry.timestamp)}
      </span>
      {isRunning ? (
        <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full animate-pulse flex-shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: color }} />
      ) : (
        <CheckCircle2 size={9} className="flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)', opacity: 0.4 }} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ── Group entries by time period ───────────────────────────────────────────

function groupByTime(entries: FeedEntry[]): { label: string; items: FeedEntry[] }[] {
  const now = Date.now();
  const groups: { label: string; items: FeedEntry[] }[] = [];
  const recent: FeedEntry[] = [];
  const earlier: FeedEntry[] = [];

  for (const e of [...entries].reverse()) {
    const age = now - e.timestamp.getTime();
    if (age < 5 * 60 * 1000) recent.push(e);
    else earlier.push(e);
  }

  if (recent.length > 0) groups.push({ label: 'Maintenant', items: recent });
  if (earlier.length > 0) groups.push({ label: 'Plus tôt', items: earlier });

  return groups;
}
```

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import {
  Bot, Target, Loader2, CheckCircle2, XCircle,
  Brain, ChevronUp, ChevronDown, Zap, AlertTriangle,
} from 'lucide-react';

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Agent Activity Overlay — Indicateur flottant toujours visible
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Overlay compact affiché en bas à droite de l'IDE quand des agents
 * ou des missions travaillent en arrière-plan.
 * 
 * Permet de voir en un coup d'œil:
 * - Nombre d'agents actifs
 * - Mission en cours avec progression
 * - Dernière action et son résultat
 * - Confiance de l'agent
 *
 * Cliquable pour ouvrir/fermer les détails.
 */

interface AgentActivity {
  taskId: string;
  role: string;
  agentName: string;
  title: string;
  status: string;
  timestamp: Date;
}

interface MissionActivity {
  missionId: string;
  title: string;
  status: string;
  confidence: number;
  currentGoal?: string;
  lastAction?: string;
  lastDecision?: string;
}

interface AgentActivityOverlayProps {
  /** Callback to open the full Agents panel */
  onOpenAgents?: () => void;
  /** Callback to open the full Missions panel */
  onOpenMissions?: () => void;
}

export function AgentActivityOverlay({ onOpenAgents, onOpenMissions }: AgentActivityOverlayProps) {
  const [agents, setAgents] = useState<AgentActivity[]>([]);
  const [missions, setMissions] = useState<MissionActivity[]>([]);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [lastEvent, setLastEvent] = useState<string>('');
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0);

  // ── Ticker: force cleanup of stale entries every 2s ──
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => setTick(t => t + 1), 2000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);
  // Listen for agent events
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (e as CustomEvent).detail;
      if (!detail) return;

      if (detail.type === 'agent_event') {
        setAgents(prev => {
          const filtered = prev.filter(a => a.taskId !== detail.taskId);
          const isDone = detail.event === 'task_completed' || detail.event === 'task_failed';
          return [...filtered, {
            taskId: detail.taskId,
            role: detail.role,
            agentName: detail.agentName,
            title: detail.title,
            status: isDone ? detail.event.replace('task_', '') : detail.status,
            timestamp: new Date(detail.timestamp),
          }];
        });
        setLastEvent(`${detail.agentName}: ${detail.detail || detail.title}`);
      }
    };

    const missionHandler = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (e as CustomEvent).detail;
      if (!detail || detail.type !== 'mission_event') return;

      setMissions(prev => {
        const existing = prev.find(m => m.missionId === detail.missionId);

        switch (detail.event) {
          case 'mission_started':
            if (existing) return prev;
            return [...prev, {
              missionId: detail.missionId,
              title: detail.title ?? 'Mission',
              status: 'in_progress',
              confidence: 0.5,
            }];

          case 'goal_started':
            return prev.map(m => m.missionId === detail.missionId
              ? { ...m, currentGoal: detail.goalTitle ?? detail.goalId }
              : m
            );

          case 'action_completed':
            return prev.map(m => m.missionId === detail.missionId
              ? {
                  ...m,
                  confidence: detail.confidence ?? m.confidence,
                  lastAction: detail.skill,
                  lastDecision: detail.decision,
                }
              : m
            );

          case 'mission_completed':
          case 'mission_cancelled':
          case 'mission_failed':
            return prev.map(m => m.missionId === detail.missionId
              ? { ...m, status: detail.success ? 'completed' : 'failed' }
              : m
            );

          default:
            return prev;
        }
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('jarvis-agent-event', handler);
    window.addEventListener('jarvis-mission-event', missionHandler);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('jarvis-agent-event', handler);
      window.removeEventListener('jarvis-mission-event', missionHandler);
    };
  }, []);

  const activeAgents = useMemo(
    () => agents.filter(a => a.status === 'running' || a.status === 'pending'),
    [agents, tick]
  );
  const activeMissions = useMemo(
    () => missions.filter(m => m.status === 'in_progress'),
    [missions, tick]
  );

  // ── Cleanup stale entries (completed/failed for > 5s) via ticker ──
  useEffect(() => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const staleThreshold = 5000;

    setAgents(prev => {
      const cleaned = prev.filter(a => {
        if (a.status === 'running' || a.status === 'pending') return true;
        return (now - a.timestamp.getTime()) < staleThreshold;
      });
      return cleaned.length !== prev.length ? cleaned : prev;
    });

    setMissions(prev => {
      const cleaned = prev.filter(m => m.status === 'in_progress');
      return cleaned.length !== prev.length ? cleaned : prev;
    });
  }, [tick]);

  // Ne rien afficher si rien d'actif
  if (activeAgents.length === 0 && activeMissions.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, scale: 0.95 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, scale: 0.95 }}
      className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-50 flex flex-col items-end gap-2"
      style={{ maxWidth: '320px' }}
    >
      {/* Expanded detail panel */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {expanded && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10, height: 0 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, height: 'auto' }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 10, height: 0 }}
            className="w-72 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-xl"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-panel)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border-base)',
            }}
          >
            {/* Active missions */}
            {activeMissions.map(mission => (
              <div
                key={mission.missionId}
                className="px-3 py-2.5 cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/5 transition"
                onClick={onOpenMissions}
                style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Target size={11} style={{ color: '#38bdf8' }} />
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold flex-1 truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                    {mission.title}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold"
                    style={{ color: mission.confidence >= 0.7 ? '#4ade80' : mission.confidence >= 0.4 ? '#fbbf24' : '#f87171' }}>
                    {Math.round(mission.confidence * 100)}%
                  </span>
                </div>
                {mission.currentGoal && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1 ml-5">
                    <Loader2 size={8} className="animate-spin" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
                    <span className="text-[9px] truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                      {mission.currentGoal}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
                {mission.lastAction && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5 ml-5">
                    <Zap size={8} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
                    <span className="text-[8px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                      {mission.lastAction}
                    </span>
                    {mission.lastDecision && mission.lastDecision !== 'continue' && (
                      <span className="text-[8px] font-bold px-1 rounded"
                        style={{
                          color: mission.lastDecision === 'retry' ? '#fbbf24' : '#f87171',
                          backgroundColor: mission.lastDecision === 'retry' ? 'rgba(251,191,36,0.1)' : 'rgba(248,113,113,0.1)',
                        }}>
                        {mission.lastDecision}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}

            {/* Active agents */}
            {activeAgents.map(agent => (
              <div
                key={agent.taskId}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/5 transition"
                onClick={onOpenAgents}
              >
                <Loader2 size={10} className="animate-spin" style={{ color: '#a855f7' }} />
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-medium truncate block" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                    {agent.agentName}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] truncate block" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                    {agent.title}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Compact indicator pill */}
      <motion.button
        onClick={() => setExpanded(v => !v)}
        className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-full shadow-lg cursor-pointer select-none hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-panel)',
          border: '1px solid var(--border-base)',
          boxShadow: '0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)',
        }}
        whileHover={{ scale: 1.03 }}
        whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
      >
        {/* Pulsing indicator */}
        <div className="relative">
          <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-400 animate-pulse" />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-400 animate-ping opacity-50" />
        </div>

        {/* Content */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {activeMissions.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Target size={10} style={{ color: '#38bdf8' }} />
              <span className="text-[9px] font-bold" style={{ color: '#38bdf8' }}>
                {activeMissions.length}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
          {activeAgents.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Bot size={10} style={{ color: '#a855f7' }} />
              <span className="text-[9px] font-bold" style={{ color: '#a855f7' }}>
                {activeAgents.length}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Last event text */}
        {lastEvent && (
          <span className="text-[9px] max-w-[140px] truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            {lastEvent}
          </span>
        )}

        {/* Expand/collapse icon */}
        {expanded ? (
          <ChevronDown size={10} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
        ) : (
          <ChevronUp size={10} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
        )}
      </motion.button>
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback, memo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Loader2,
  ChevronUp,
  ChevronDown,
  X,
  Clock,
  Zap,
  Terminal,
  Info,
  FileText,
  FilePen,
  Search,
  Trash2,
  Globe,
  Brain,
  Users,
  Database,
  LayoutGrid,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { ActivityStep, ReasoningState } from '../../hooks/useLiveAPI';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Types & Helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

interface AgentProgressBarProps {
  steps: ActivityStep[];
  connected: boolean;
  onClear?: () => void;
  reasoning?: ReasoningState;
}

function elapsed(ts: Date): string {
  if (!(ts instanceof Date)) ts = new Date(ts);
  const seconds = Math.floor((Date.now() - ts.getTime()) / 1000);
  if (seconds < 2) return 'à l\'instant';
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds}s`;
  const mins = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
  const secs = seconds % 60;
  if (mins < 60) return secs > 0 ? `${mins}m ${secs}s` : `${mins}m`;
  return `${Math.floor(mins / 60)}h ${mins % 60}m`;
}

function elapsedBetween(start: Date, end: Date): string {
  const ms = new Date(end).getTime() - new Date(start).getTime();
  if (ms < 100) return `${ms}ms`;
  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`;
  const seconds = ms / 1000;
  if (seconds < 60) return `${seconds.toFixed(1)}s`;
  return `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}m ${Math.floor(seconds % 60)}s`;
}

/** Duration of a completed step */
function stepDuration(step: ActivityStep): string | null {
  if (!step.endTimestamp) return null;
  return elapsedBetween(new Date(step.timestamp), new Date(step.endTimestamp));
}

type StepStatus = 'running' | 'done' | 'error' | 'pending';

function getStepStatus(step: ActivityStep): StepStatus {
  if (step.status === 'running') return 'running';
  if (step.status === 'done') return 'done';
  if (step.status === 'error') return 'error';
  return 'pending';
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tool categorisation
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

type ToolCategory = 'file-read' | 'file-write' | 'file-delete' | 'search' | 'web' | 'agent' | 'reasoning' | 'memory' | 'system' | 'other';

const TOOL_CATEGORIES: Record<string, ToolCategory> = {
  read_project_file: 'file-read',
  list_project_files: 'file-read',
  analyze_project_file: 'file-read',
  open_project_file: 'file-read',
  write_project_file: 'file-write',
  modify_project_file: 'file-write',
  create_project_directory: 'file-write',
  rename_project_file: 'file-write',
  delete_project_file: 'file-delete',
  search_in_files: 'search',
  automation_search: 'search',
  automation_navigate: 'web',
  automation_snapshot: 'web',
  automation_click: 'web',
  automation_type: 'web',
  automation_extract: 'web',
  agent_delegate: 'agent',
  agent_orchestrate: 'agent',
  agent_status: 'agent',
  agent_list_tasks: 'agent',
  agent_list_roles: 'agent',
  agent_cancel: 'agent',
  agent_stats: 'agent',
  reasoning_think: 'reasoning',
  reasoning_delegate_task: 'reasoning',
  reasoning_list_strategies: 'reasoning',

};

function getToolCategory(tool: string): ToolCategory {
  return TOOL_CATEGORIES[tool] ?? 'other';
}

const CATEGORY_COLORS: Record<ToolCategory, string> = {
  'file-read':   'var(--accent-primary)',
  'file-write':  '#22c55e',
  'file-delete': '#ef4444',
  'search':      '#f59e0b',
  'web':         '#6366f1',
  'agent':       '#ec4899',
  'reasoning':   '#a855f7',
  'memory':      '#14b8a6',
  'system':      'var(--text-muted)',
  'other':       'var(--text-dimmed)',
};

const ToolCategoryIcon = memo(function ToolCategoryIcon({ tool, size = 10 }: { tool: string; size?: number }) {
  const cat = getToolCategory(tool);
  const color = CATEGORY_COLORS[cat];
  const cls = `flex-shrink-0`;
  const style = useMemo(() => ({ color, width: size, height: size }), [color, size]);

  switch (cat) {
    case 'file-read':   return <FileText className={cls} style={style} />;
    case 'file-write':  return <FilePen className={cls} style={style} />;
    case 'file-delete': return <Trash2 className={cls} style={style} />;
    case 'search':      return <Search className={cls} style={style} />;
    case 'web':         return <Globe className={cls} style={style} />;
    case 'agent':       return <Users className={cls} style={style} />;
    case 'reasoning':   return <Brain className={cls} style={style} />;
    case 'memory':      return <Database className={cls} style={style} />;
    case 'system':      return <LayoutGrid className={cls} style={style} />;
    default:            return <Terminal className={cls} style={style} />;
  }
});

function formatToolName(tool: string): string {
  const translations: Record<string, string> = {
    'agent orchestrate': 'orchestration d\'agents',
    'agent delegate': 'délégation d\'agent',
    'agent status': 'statut de l\'agent',
    'read project file': 'lecture de fichier',
    'write project file': 'écriture de fichier',
    'modify project file': 'modification de fichier',
    'patch project file': 'patch de fichier',
    'list project files': 'liste des fichiers',
    'search in files': 'recherche dans les fichiers',
    'verify file': 'vérification de fichier',
    'knowledge build context': 'construction du contexte',
    'knowledge semantic search': 'recherche sémantique',
    'knowledge search entities': 'recherche d\'entités',
    'knowledge memory search': 'recherche en mémoire',
    'knowledge memory add': 'ajout en mémoire',
    'knowledge memory list': 'liste de la mémoire',
    'knowledge impact analyze': 'analyse d\'impact',
    'knowledge status': 'statut de la connaissance',
    'knowledge reindex': 'ré-indexation',
    'save memory': 'sauvegarde en mémoire',
    'search memory': 'recherche en mémoire',
    'get current time': 'heure actuelle',
    'reasoning think': 'raisonnement',
    'automation search': 'recherche web',
    'request tools': 'demande d\'outils',
    'open ide': 'ouverture de l\'IDE',
    'open project file': 'ouverture de fichier',
    'analyze project file': 'analyse de fichier',
  };

  const formatted = tool
    .replace(/_/g, ' ')
    .replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, '$1 $2')
    .toLowerCase();

  return translations[formatted] || formatted;
}
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Sub-components

const StepIcon = memo(function StepIcon({ status, tool }: { status: StepStatus; tool: string }) {
  const cat = getToolCategory(tool);
  const color = CATEGORY_COLORS[cat];

  if (status === 'running') {
    return (
      <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center w-4 h-4">
        <motion.div
          className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full"
          style={{ backgroundColor: color, opacity: 0.12 }}
          animate={{ scale: [1, 1.5, 1], opacity: [0.12, 0.04, 0.12] }}
          transition={{ duration: 1.4, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
        />
        <Loader2 style={{ width: 12, height: 12, color, position: 'relative' }} className="animate-spin" />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (status === 'done') {
    return (
      <div className="w-4 h-4 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(34,197,94,0.1)' }}>
        <CheckCircle2 style={{ width: 11, height: 11, color: 'var(--color-success)' }} />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (status === 'error') {
    return (
      <div className="w-4 h-4 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.1)' }}>
        <AlertCircle style={{ width: 11, height: 11, color: 'var(--color-error)' }} />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <div className="w-4 h-4 flex items-center justify-center">
      <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--border-base)' }} />
    </div>
  );
});

const ProgressRing = memo(function ProgressRing({ percent, size = 20, stroke = 2.5, isWorking }: {
  percent: number;
  size?: number;
  stroke?: number;
  isWorking?: boolean;
}) {
  const radius = (size - stroke) / 2;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const offset = circumference - (percent / 100) * circumference;

  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} className="flex-shrink-0 -rotate-90">
      <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none"
        stroke="var(--border-base)" strokeWidth={stroke} opacity={0.25} />
      <motion.circle
        cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius} fill="none"
        stroke={isWorking ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--color-success)'}
        strokeWidth={stroke}
        strokeDasharray={circumference}
        strokeDashoffset={offset}
        strokeLinecap="round"
        initial={{ strokeDashoffset: circumference }}
        animate={{ strokeDashoffset: offset }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.35, ease: 'easeOut' }}
      />
    </svg>
  );
});

const CategoryLegend = memo(function CategoryLegend({ steps }: { steps: ActivityStep[] }) {
  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Partial<Record<ToolCategory, number>> = {};
    for (const s of steps) {
      const cat = getToolCategory(s.tool);
      map[cat] = (map[cat] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    return Object.entries(map) as [ToolCategory, number][];
  }, [steps]);

  if (counts.length < 2) return null;

  const translations: Record<ToolCategory, string> = {
    'file-read': 'lecture de fichier',
    'file-write': 'écriture de fichier',
    'file-delete': 'suppression de fichier',
    'search': 'recherche',
    'web': 'web',
    'agent': 'agent',
    'reasoning': 'raisonnement',
    'memory': 'mémoire',
    'system': 'système',
    'other': 'autre',
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 px-3 pb-3">
      {counts.map(([cat, n]) => (
        <div
          key={cat}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-3 py-1"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)',
          }}
        >
          <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: CATEGORY_COLORS[cat] }} />
          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
            {translations[cat] || cat.replace('-', ' ')} · {n}
          </span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
});

      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-auto">

        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono tabular-nums" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
          {totalDuration}
        </span>

  );
});


// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// ReasoningPanel — affichage des étapes Chain-of-Thought en temps réel
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

const COMPLEXITY_LABELS: Record<string, { label: string; color: string }> = {
  simple:   { label: 'Direct',             color: '#94a3b8' },
  moderate: { label: 'Chain of Thought',   color: '#60a5fa' },
  complex:  { label: 'CoT complet',        color: '#a78bfa' },
  critical: { label: 'Tree-of-Thought',    color: '#f97316' },
};

const CoTStepRow = memo(function CoTStepRow({ step, isLast }: { step: NonNullable<ReasoningState['steps']>[number]; isLast: boolean }) {
  const isRunning = step.status === 'running';
  const isDone    = step.status === 'done';
  const isFailed  = step.status === 'failed';

  const dotColor = isRunning ? '#a855f7' : isDone ? '#22c55e' : isFailed ? '#ef4444' : '#64748b';

  return (
    <div className="flex gap-2 min-h-[24px]">
      {/* Timeline */}
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center flex-shrink-0 w-3.5 pt-[4px]">
        {isRunning ? (
          <Loader2 style={{ width: 10, height: 10, color: dotColor }} className="animate-spin" />
        ) : isDone ? (
          <CheckCircle2 style={{ width: 10, height: 10, color: dotColor }} />
        ) : isFailed ? (
          <AlertCircle style={{ width: 10, height: 10, color: dotColor }} />
        ) : (
          <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full mt-0.5" style={{ backgroundColor: dotColor }} />
        )}
        {!isLast && (
          <div
            className="w-px flex-1 mt-0.5"
            style={{ backgroundColor: isDone ? `${dotColor}55` : 'var(--border-base)', opacity: 0.5 }}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Content */}
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 pb-1.5">
        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2 min-w-0">
          <span
            className="text-[10px] leading-snug"
            style={{
              color: isRunning ? 'var(--text-primary)' : isDone ? 'var(--text-secondary)' : isFailed ? 'var(--color-error)' : 'var(--text-dimmed)',
              fontWeight: isRunning ? 600 : 400,
            }}
          >
            {step.label}
          </span>
          {step.durationMs !== undefined && (
            <span className="text-[9px] tabular-nums font-mono flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
              {step.durationMs < 1000 ? `${step.durationMs}ms` : `${(step.durationMs / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {step.content && (
          <p className="text-[9px] leading-relaxed mt-0.5 line-clamp-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
            {step.content}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

const ReasoningPanel = memo(function ReasoningPanel({ reasoning }: { reasoning?: ReasoningState }) {
  if (!reasoning || (!reasoning.active && (!reasoning.steps || reasoning.steps.length === 0))) return null;

  const meta = reasoning.complexity ? COMPLEXITY_LABELS[reasoning.complexity] : null;
  const steps = reasoning.steps ?? [];
  const doneCount = steps.filter(s => s.status === 'done').length;
  const totalSteps = reasoning.totalSteps ?? steps.length;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {(reasoning.active || steps.length > 0) && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: 'easeOut' }}
          style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}
          role="region"
          aria-label="Raisonnement en cours"
        >
          {/* Header */}
          <div
            className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 border-b"
            style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'rgba(168,85,247,0.04)' }}
          >
            <motion.div
              animate={reasoning.active ? { rotate: 360 } : { rotate: 0 }}
              transition={reasoning.active ? { duration: 2, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' } : {}}
            >
              <Brain style={{ width: 11, height: 11, color: '#a855f7' }} />
            </motion.div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold" style={{ color: '#a855f7' }}>
              {reasoning.strategyLabel ?? reasoning.strategy ?? 'Raisonnement'}
            </span>
            {meta && (
              <span
                className="text-[8px] px-1.5 py-px rounded font-mono"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: meta.color + '22',
                  color: meta.color,
                  border: `1px solid ${meta.color}44`,
                }}
              >
                {meta.label}
              </span>
            )}
            {totalSteps > 0 && (
              <span
                className="ml-auto text-[9px] tabular-nums font-mono"
                style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}
              >
                {doneCount}/{totalSteps}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Steps */}
          {steps.length > 0 && (
            <div className="px-3 py-2">
              {steps.map((step, i) => (
                <CoTStepRow key={step.index} step={step} isLast={i === steps.length - 1} />
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Pulse quand actif sans steps encore */}
          {reasoning.active && steps.length === 0 && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2">
              {[0, 1, 2].map(i => (
                <motion.div
                  key={i}
                  className="w-1 h-1 rounded-full"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: '#a855f7' }}
                  animate={{ opacity: [0.3, 1, 0.3], scale: [0.8, 1.2, 0.8] }}
                  transition={{ duration: 1, repeat: Infinity, delay: i * 0.2 }}
                />
              ))}
              <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>Analyse en cours…</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
});

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// AgentProgressBar Component
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

export function AgentProgressBar({ steps, connected, onClear, reasoning }: AgentProgressBarProps) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const [expandedStepId, setExpandedStepId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const runningStep = useMemo(() => [...steps].reverse().find(s => s.status === 'running'), [steps]);
  const isWorking = !!runningStep;
  const doneCount = useMemo(() => steps.filter(s => s.status === 'done').length, [steps]);
  const errorCount = useMemo(() => steps.filter(s => s.status === 'error').length, [steps]);
  const totalCount = steps.length;
  const progressPercent = useMemo(
    () => totalCount > 0 ? Math.round((doneCount / totalCount) * 100) : 0,
    [doneCount, totalCount]
  );

  /** Total session duration */
  const totalDuration = useMemo(() => {
    if (steps.length === 0) return '0s';
    const first = new Date(steps[0].timestamp);
    const last = new Date(steps[steps.length - 1].timestamp);
    return elapsedBetween(first, isWorking ? new Date() : last);
  }, [steps, isWorking]);

  /** Average step duration (only completed steps with endTimestamp) */
  const avgDuration = useMemo(() => {
    const completed = steps.filter(s => s.endTimestamp);
    if (completed.length === 0) return null;
    const totalMs = completed.reduce((acc, s) => {
      return acc + (new Date(s.endTimestamp!).getTime() - new Date(s.timestamp).getTime());
    }, 0);
    const avg = totalMs / completed.length;
    if (avg < 1000) return `${Math.round(avg)}ms`;
    return `${(avg / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`;
  }, [steps]);

  const toggleExpand = useCallback(() => setExpanded(v => !v), []);
  const [, setTick] = useState<number>(0);

  // Auto-scroll to bottom when new steps arrive
  useEffect(() => {
    if (expanded && listRef.current) {
      listRef.current.scrollTop = listRef.current.scrollHeight;
    }
  }, [steps.length, expanded]);

  // Auto-expand when agent starts working
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isWorking && steps.length <= 2) setExpanded(true);
  }, [isWorking, steps.length]);

  // Keep live progress timestamps updating while working
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isWorking) return;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      // force rerender via state update when working
      setTick(t => t + 1);
    }, 500);
    return () => clearInterval(id);
  }, [isWorking]);

  if (!connected || steps.length === 0) return null;

  const activeColor = isWorking ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--color-success)';

  return (
    <div
      className="border-t select-none"
      style={{
        borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
        background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-panel), rgba(0,0,0,0.02))',
        boxShadow: '0 -4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.12)',
      }}
    >
      {/* Thin progress bar at very top */}
      <div className="relative h-[2px] w-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--border-base)', opacity: 0.35 }}>
        <motion.div
          className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0"
          style={{ backgroundColor: activeColor }}
          initial={{ width: '0%' }}
          animate={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.3, ease: 'easeOut' }}
        />
        {isWorking && (
          <motion.div
            className="absolute inset-y-0 w-12"
            style={{ background: `linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--accent-primary), transparent)` }}
            animate={{ left: ['-10%', '110%'] }}
            transition={{ duration: 1.8, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Header bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-3">
        <div
          className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-1 min-w-0 cursor-pointer p-2 rounded-md hover:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.02)]"
          onClick={toggleExpand}
          onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); toggleExpand(); }}}
          tabIndex={0}
          role="button"
          aria-expanded={expanded}
          aria-label="Afficher les détails de progression"
        >
          {/* Progress ring */}
          <ProgressRing percent={progressPercent} isWorking={isWorking} size={22} />

          {/* Status icon */}
          {isWorking ? (
            <div className="relative flex-shrink-0 w-5 h-5 flex items-center justify-center">
              <motion.div
                className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-primary)', opacity: 0.08 }}
                animate={{ scale: [1, 1.7, 1] }}
                transition={{ duration: 2, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
              />
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin relative" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
            </div>
          ) : errorCount > 0 ? (
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--color-warning)' }} />
          ) : (
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--color-success)' }} />
          )}

          {/* Summary text */}
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-col gap-[2px]">
            {isWorking ? (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
                  <ToolCategoryIcon tool={runningStep.tool} size={10} />
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                    {runningStep.label}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span
                    className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-px rounded font-mono leading-none"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: CATEGORY_COLORS[getToolCategory(runningStep.tool)] + '22',
                      color: CATEGORY_COLORS[getToolCategory(runningStep.tool)],
                      border: `1px solid ${CATEGORY_COLORS[getToolCategory(runningStep.tool)]}44`,
                    }}
                  >
                    {formatToolName(runningStep.tool)}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] tabular-nums font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                    {elapsed(runningStep.timestamp)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--color-success)' }}>
                  Exécution terminée
                </span>
                <span className="text-[9px] tabular-nums" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                  {doneCount}/{totalCount} • {totalDuration}
                  {errorCount > 0 && (
                    <span style={{ color: 'var(--color-error)' }}> • {errorCount} erreur{errorCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>
                  )}
                </span>
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Step counter badge */}
          <span
            className="text-[10px] font-mono tabular-nums px-2 py-1 flex-shrink-0"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-surface)',
              color: 'var(--text-secondary)',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              border: '1px solid var(--border-base)',
              boxShadow: 'inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.03)'
            }}
          >
            {doneCount}/{totalCount}
          </span>

          {/* Expand chevron */}
          {expanded
            ? <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
            : <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
          }
        </div>

        {/* Clear button */}
        {!isWorking && onClear && (
          <button
            onClick={onClear}
            className="flex-shrink-0 p-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors hover:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.04)]"
            title="Effacer l'historique"
            aria-label="Effacer l'historique des étapes"
            style={{ borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)', color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Expanded panel */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {expanded && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.18, ease: 'easeOut' }}
            style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}
          >
            <StatsBar
              doneCount={doneCount}
              errorCount={errorCount}
              totalCount={totalCount}
              totalDuration={totalDuration}
              avgDuration={avgDuration}
            />

            {/* Timeline */}
            <div ref={listRef} className="px-3 py-2 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                {steps.map((step, i) => {
                  const status = getStepStatus(step);
                  const isLast = i === steps.length - 1;
                  const isStepExpanded = expandedStepId === step.id;
                  const catColor = CATEGORY_COLORS[getToolCategory(step.tool)];
                  const dur = stepDuration(step);

                  return (
                    <div key={step.id} className="flex gap-2 min-h-[28px]">
                      {/* Timeline column */}
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center flex-shrink-0 w-4 pt-[5px]">
                        <StepIcon status={status} tool={step.tool} />
                        {!isLast && (
                          <div
                            className="w-px flex-1 mt-0.5"
                            style={{
                              background: status === 'done'
                                ? `linear-gradient(to bottom, ${catColor}55, var(--border-base)44)`
                                : status === 'error'
                                  ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.3)'
                                  : 'var(--border-base)',
                              opacity: 0.6,
                            }}
                          />
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Step content */}
                      <div
                        className="flex-1 min-w-0 pb-2 cursor-pointer group rounded-md transition-colors hover:bg-[rgba(255,255,255,0.03)]"
                        onClick={() => setExpandedStepId(isStepExpanded ? null : step.id)}
                        style={{ padding: '6px 8px', marginLeft: '-6px' }}
                      >
                        {/* Main label row */}
                        <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2 min-w-0">
                          <span
                            className="text-[11px] flex-1 truncate leading-tight"
                            style={{
                              color: status === 'running'
                                ? 'var(--text-primary)'
                                : status === 'error'
                                  ? 'var(--color-error)'
                                  : 'var(--text-secondary)',
                              fontWeight: status === 'running' ? 600 : 400,
                            }}
                          >
                            {step.label}
                          </span>
                          {/* Duration or elapsed */}
                          {dur ? (
                            <span
                              className="text-[9px] tabular-nums font-mono flex-shrink-0"
                              style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)', opacity: 0.7 }}
                            >
                              {dur}
                            </span>
                          ) : status === 'running' ? (
                            <span
                              className="text-[9px] tabular-nums font-mono flex-shrink-0"
                              style={{ color: catColor, opacity: 0.8 }}
                            >
                              {elapsed(step.timestamp)}
                            </span>
                          ) : null}
                        </div>

                        {/* Tool tag row */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                          <ToolCategoryIcon tool={step.tool} size={9} />
                          <span
                            className="text-[9px] font-mono truncate"
                            style={{ color: catColor, opacity: 0.7 }}
                          >
                            {formatToolName(step.tool)}
                          </span>
                          {step.detail && (
                            <Info
                              style={{ width: 9, height: 9, flexShrink: 0, color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}
                              className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-50 transition-opacity"
                            />
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {/* Expanded detail */}
                        <AnimatePresence>
                          {isStepExpanded && step.detail && (
                            <motion.div
                              initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                              animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
                              exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                              transition={{ duration: 0.12 }}
                              className="overflow-hidden"
                            >
                              <pre
                                className="mt-1.5 p-2 text-[10px] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap break-all font-mono"
                                style={{
                                  color: 'var(--text-muted)',
                                  backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)',
                                  border: '1px solid var(--border-base)',
                                  borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
                                }}
                              >
                                {step.detail}
                              </pre>
                            </motion.div>
                          )}
                        </AnimatePresence>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Category legend */}
            <CategoryLegend steps={steps} />
            {reasoning && <ReasoningPanel reasoning={reasoning} />}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}
```
