`src\components\ide\FileExplorer.tsx`:

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, memo } from 'react';
import {
  Folder, FolderOpen, Plus, RefreshCcw, ChevronRight, ChevronDown,
  Shield, Search, X, ArrowDownAZ, ArrowUpZA, Layers, GripVertical,
  Eye, EyeOff, FolderInput,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { FileIcon } from './FileIcon';
import { Breadcrumb } from './Breadcrumb';
import type { TreeEntry } from '../../types/ide';
import { sandboxApi } from '../../services/sandboxApi';

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type SortMode = 'name-asc' | 'name-desc' | 'type';

type FileExplorerProps = {
  tree: TreeEntry[];
  expandedDirs: Set<string>;
  loading: boolean;
  currentDir: string;
  onOpenFile: (path: string) => void;
  onToggleDirectory: (path: string) => void;
  onContextMenu: (e: React.MouseEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => void;
  onCreateFile: () => void;
  onRefresh: () => void;
  onNavigate: (dir: string) => void;
  onMoveEntry?: (srcPath: string, destDir: string) => void;
};

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function sortEntries(entries: TreeEntry[], mode: SortMode): TreeEntry[] {
  const dirs  = entries.filter(e => e.type === 'directory');
  const files = entries.filter(e => e.type === 'file');

  const byName = (a: TreeEntry, b: TreeEntry) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base' });
  const byNameDesc = (a: TreeEntry, b: TreeEntry) => -byName(a, b);

  switch (mode) {
    case 'name-asc':
      return [...dirs.sort(byName), ...files.sort(byName)];
    case 'name-desc':
      return [...dirs.sort(byNameDesc), ...files.sort(byNameDesc)];
    case 'type':
      return [
        ...dirs.sort(byName),
        ...files.sort((a, b) => {
          const extA = a.name.includes('.') ? a.name.split('.').pop()! : '';
          const extB = b.name.includes('.') ? b.name.split('.').pop()! : '';
          return extA.localeCompare(extB) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        }),
      ];
  }
}

function filterTree(entries: TreeEntry[], query: string): TreeEntry[] {
  if (!query) return entries;
  const q = query.toLowerCase();
  return entries.reduce<TreeEntry[]>((acc, entry) => {
    if (entry.type === 'directory' && entry.children) {
      const filteredChildren = filterTree(entry.children, query);
      if (filteredChildren.length > 0 || entry.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
        acc.push({ ...entry, children: filteredChildren });
      }
    } else if (entry.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
      acc.push(entry);
    }
    return acc;
  }, []);
}

// ── Sort Icon helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SortIcon({ mode }: { mode: SortMode }) {
  if (mode === 'name-asc')  return <ArrowDownAZ size={11} />;
  if (mode === 'name-desc') return <ArrowUpZA size={11} />;
  return <Layers size={11} />;
}

function sortLabel(mode: SortMode): string {
  if (mode === 'name-asc')  return 'Tri : A→Z';
  if (mode === 'name-desc') return 'Tri : Z→A';
  return 'Tri : Type';
}

function nextSort(mode: SortMode): SortMode {
  if (mode === 'name-asc')  return 'name-desc';
  if (mode === 'name-desc') return 'type';
  return 'name-asc';
}

// ── HighlightMatch — highlight query in file names ─────────────────────────

function HighlightMatch({ text, query }: { text: string; query: string }) {
  const idx = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase());
  if (idx === -1) return <>{text}</>;
  return (
    <>
      {text.slice(0, idx)}
      <mark
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 35%, transparent)',
          color: 'inherit',
          borderRadius: '2px',
          padding: '0 1px',
        }}
      >
        {text.slice(idx, idx + query.length)}
      </mark>
      {text.slice(idx + query.length)}
    </>
  );
}

// ── Count total entries in a filtered tree ─────────────────────────────────

function countEntries(entries: TreeEntry[]): number {
  return entries.reduce((acc, e) => {
    if (e.type === 'file') return acc + 1;
    return acc + countEntries(e.children ?? []);
  }, 0);
}

// ── Main Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const FileExplorer = memo(function FileExplorer({
  tree,
  expandedDirs,
  loading,
  currentDir,
  onOpenFile,
  onToggleDirectory,
  onContextMenu,
  onCreateFile,
  onRefresh,
  onNavigate,
  onMoveEntry,
}: FileExplorerProps) {
  // ── Sandbox status (cached via sandboxApi, pas de polling rafale) ──────────
  const [sandboxActive, setSandboxActive] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    let debounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

    const checkSandbox = async (force = false) => {
      try {
        const data = await sandboxApi.getStatus(force);
        if (mounted && data.status === 'success') {
          setSandboxActive(data.sandbox?.active ?? false);
        }
      } catch { /* silent */ }
    };

    checkSandbox();

    // Écoute debouncée: si l'event est émis plusieurs fois en rafale,
    // on ne fait qu'un seul re-fetch au bout de 150ms.
    const handleChange = () => {
      if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => checkSandbox(true), 150);
    };

    window.addEventListener('jarvis-sandbox-changed', handleChange);
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
      if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      window.removeEventListener('jarvis-sandbox-changed', handleChange);
    };
  }, []);

  // ── Search + Sort ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [showSearch, setShowSearch]   = useState(false);
  const [sortMode, setSortMode]       = useState<SortMode>('name-asc');

  const toggleSearch = useCallback(() => {
    setShowSearch(prev => {
      if (prev) setSearchQuery('');
      return !prev;
    });
  }, []);

  const processedTree = useMemo(() => {
    const filtered = filterTree(tree, searchQuery);
    // Apply sort recursively
    const applySort = (entries: TreeEntry[]): TreeEntry[] =>
      sortEntries(entries, sortMode).map(e =>
        e.type === 'directory' && e.children
          ? { ...e, children: applySort(e.children) }
          : e
      );
    return applySort(filtered);
  }, [tree, searchQuery, sortMode]);

  // ── Drag & Drop ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const [draggingPath, setDraggingPath] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOverPath, setDragOverPath] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleDragStart = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => {
    setDraggingPath(entry.path);
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
    e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', entry.path);
  }, []);

  const handleDragOver = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => {
    if (entry.type !== 'directory') return;
    if (entry.path === draggingPath) return;
    // Prevent dropping parent into its own child
    if (draggingPath && entry.path.startsWith(draggingPath + '/')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
    setDragOverPath(entry.path);
  }, [draggingPath]);

  const handleDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
    // Only clear if leaving to an element outside the item
    if (!(e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) {
      setDragOverPath(null);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleDrop = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragOverPath(null);
    setDraggingPath(null);
    if (entry.type !== 'directory') return;
    const src = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    if (!src || src === entry.path) return;
    if (src.startsWith(entry.path + '/')) return; // dropping into own child
    onMoveEntry?.(src, entry.path);
  }, [onMoveEntry]);

  const handleDragEnd = useCallback(() => {
    setDraggingPath(null);
    setDragOverPath(null);
  }, []);

  // ── Tree entry renderer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const renderTreeEntry = useCallback((entry: TreeEntry, depth = 0): React.ReactNode => {
    const isExpanded = expandedDirs.has(entry.path);
    const hasChildren = entry.children && entry.children.length > 0;
    const isDraggingThis = draggingPath === entry.path;
    const isDragTarget   = dragOverPath === entry.path;

    const handleClick = () => {
      if (entry.type === 'file') {
        onOpenFile(entry.path);
      } else {
        onToggleDirectory(entry.path);
      }
    };

    return (
      <div
        key={entry.path}
        className="relative"
        style={{ opacity: isDraggingThis ? 0.4 : 1 }}
        onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
      >
        {/* Indentation guide line (rendered only for child elements) */}
        {depth > 0 && (
          <div
            className="absolute top-0 bottom-0 pointer-events-none opacity-20"
            style={{
              left: `${10 + (depth - 1) * 12}px`,
              width: '1px',
              borderLeft: '1.2px dashed var(--text-primary)',
            }}
          />
        )}

        <div
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 py-1 px-2 text-[11px] cursor-pointer select-none relative group transition-colors duration-100"
          style={{
            paddingLeft: `${8 + depth * 12}px`,
            color: 'var(--text-primary)',
            backgroundColor: isDragTarget
              ? 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 18%, transparent)'
              : undefined,
            outline: isDragTarget ? '1px solid var(--accent-primary)' : undefined,
            outlineOffset: '-1px',
            borderRadius: isDragTarget ? '4px' : undefined,
          }}
          onClick={handleClick}
          onContextMenu={(e) => onContextMenu(e, entry)}
          /* Drag source */
          draggable
          onDragStart={(e) => handleDragStart(e, entry)}
          onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
          /* Drop target (directories only) */
          onDragOver={(e) => handleDragOver(e, entry)}
          onDrop={(e) => handleDrop(e, entry)}
        >
          {/* Drag handle indicator */}
          <span className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-30 transition-opacity absolute" style={{ left: `${depth * 12 + 1}px` }}>
            <GripVertical size={9} />
          </span>

          {/* Arrow indicator for directories */}
          {entry.type === 'directory' ? (
            <span className="opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-100 mr-0.5">
              {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown size={11} /> : <ChevronRight size={11} />}
            </span>
          ) : (
            // Tiny spacer to align files with folders that have arrows
            <span className="w-3.5" />
          )}

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-1 min-w-0 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors">
            {entry.type === 'directory' ? (
              isDragTarget ? (
                <FolderOpen size={13} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
              ) : isExpanded ? (
                <FolderOpen size={13} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
              ) : (
                <Folder size={13} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
              )
            ) : (
              <FileIcon filePath={entry.path} />
            )}
            <span className="truncate font-medium opacity-90 group-hover:opacity-100" title={entry.name}>
              {/* Highlight search match */}
              {searchQuery ? (
                <HighlightMatch text={entry.name} query={searchQuery} />
              ) : (
                entry.name
              )}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {entry.type === 'directory' && isExpanded && hasChildren && (
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            {entry.children!.map((child) => renderTreeEntry(child, depth + 1))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }, [
    expandedDirs,
    draggingPath,
    dragOverPath,
    onOpenFile,
    onToggleDirectory,
    onContextMenu,
    handleDragStart,
    handleDragEnd,
    handleDragOver,
    handleDrop,
    handleDragLeave,
    searchQuery,
  ]);

  return (
    <div
      className="flex flex-col border-r h-full select-none"
      style={{
        width: '240px',
        borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-sidebar)',
      }}
    >
      {/* Change Project Header Button */}
      <div
        className="p-2 border-b"
        style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-panel)' }}
      >
        <button
          onClick={async () => {
            try {
              await fetch('/api/self-root/clear', { method: 'POST' });
            } catch { /* best-effort */ }
            window.location.reload();
          }}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors hover:opacity-90 shadow-sm"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 12%, transparent)',
            color: 'var(--accent-primary)',
            border: '1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 25%, transparent)',
          }}
          title="Changer de projet racine"
        >
          <FolderInput size={14} />
          <span>Changer de projet</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Explorer Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b px-3.5" style={{ height: '35px', borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {sandboxActive ? (
            <span
              className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[8px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-bold"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, #10b981 15%, transparent)', color: '#10b981' }}
              title="Mode Sandbox actif — les modifications sont isolées"
            >
              <Shield size={9} />
              MODE SANDBOX
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span
              className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[8px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-bold"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-muted) 15%, transparent)', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}
              title="Mode Sandbox inactif — modifications directes sur les fichiers locaux"
            >
              <Shield size={9} style={{ opacity: 0.6 }} />
              SANDBOX INACTIVE
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-0.5">
          {/* Search toggle */}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Search bar (animated) */}
      {showSearch && (
        <div
          className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b px-2.5 py-1.5"
          style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-base)' }}
        >
          <Search size={11} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', flexShrink: 0 }} />
          <input
            autoFocus
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Filtrer les fichiers…"
            className="flex-1 bg-transparent text-[11px] outline-none placeholder:opacity-40"
            style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}
          />
          {searchQuery && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
              className="opacity-50 hover:opacity-100 transition"
              title="Effacer"
            >
              <X size={10} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Breadcrumb */}
      <div className="border-b px-3.5 py-1.5" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-base)' }}>
        <button
            onClick={toggleSearch}
            className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-white/5 transition"
            title="Rechercher"
            style={{ color: showSearch ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}
          >
            <Search size={12} />
          </button>
          {/* Sort cycling */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setSortMode(nextSort)}
            className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-white/5 transition"
            title={sortLabel(sortMode)}
            style={{ color: sortMode !== 'name-asc' ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}
          >
            <SortIcon mode={sortMode} />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onCreateFile}
            className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-white/5 transition"
            title="Nouveau fichier"
          >
            <Plus size={12} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={onRefresh}
            className="rounded p-1 hover:bg-white/5 transition"
            title="Actualiser"
          >
            <RefreshCcw size={12} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
          </button>
      </div>

      {/* Sort mode indicator (when not default) */}
      {sortMode !== 'name-asc' && !searchQuery && (
        <div
          className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-0.5 text-[9px] border-b"
          style={{
            borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
            backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 8%, transparent)',
            color: 'var(--accent-primary)',
          }}
        >
          <SortIcon mode={sortMode} />
          <span>{sortLabel(sortMode)}</span>
          <button
            className="ml-auto opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 transition"
            onClick={() => setSortMode('name-asc')}
            title="Réinitialiser le tri"
          >
            <X size={9} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search result count */}
      {searchQuery && (
        <div
          className="px-3 py-0.5 text-[9px] border-b"
          style={{
            borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
            color: 'var(--text-muted)',
            backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 5%, transparent)',
          }}
        >
          {countEntries(processedTree)} résultat{countEntries(processedTree) !== 1 ? 's' : ''} pour «{searchQuery}»
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tree View Container */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-2 custom-scrollbar">
        {loading ? (
          /* Skeleton tree view loaders */
          <div className="space-y-1.5 px-3.5 py-2">
            {Array.from({ length: 10 }).map((_, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2" style={{ paddingLeft: `${8 + (i % 3) * 12}px` }}>
                <div className="skeleton w-3 h-3 rounded flex-shrink-0 opacity-40" />
                <div className="skeleton h-2.5 rounded flex-1 opacity-30" style={{ maxWidth: `${60 + Math.random() * 85}px` }} />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : processedTree.length === 0 && !searchQuery ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 px-4 text-center">
            <div
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded flex items-center justify-center mb-2.5"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-subtle)' }}
            >
              <Folder size={16} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              Aucun fichier
            </p>
            <p className="text-[10px] mb-3.5 leading-normal opacity-60" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              Ouvrez un projet ou créez un fichier pour commencer.
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={onCreateFile}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold transition hover:opacity-95"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-primary)',
                color: '#fff',
                borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
              }}
            >
              <Plus size={11} />
              Nouveau fichier
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : processedTree.length === 0 && searchQuery ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-10 px-4 text-center">
            <Search size={20} className="mb-2 opacity-30" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
            <p className="text-[11px] opacity-60" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              Aucun fichier ne correspond à «{searchQuery}»
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="flex flex-col">
            {processedTree.map((entry) => renderTreeEntry(entry))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

export { FileExplorer };
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, memo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Folder, FolderOpen, Plus, RefreshCcw, ChevronRight, ChevronDown, ChevronUp,
  Shield, Search, X, ArrowDownAZ, ArrowUpZA, Layers, GripVertical,
  Eye, EyeOff, FolderInput,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { FileIcon } from './FileIcon';
import type { TreeEntry } from '../../types/ide';
import Tree from 'react-window-tree';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type SortMode = 'name-asc' | 'name-desc' | 'type';

type FileExplorerProps = {
  tree: TreeEntry[];
  expandedDirs: Set<string>;
  loading: boolean;
  currentDir: string;
  onOpenFile: (path: string) => void;
  onToggleDirectory: (path: string) => void;
  onContextMenu: (e: React.MouseEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => void;
  onCreateFile: () => void;
  onRefresh: () => void;
  onNavigate: (dir: string) => void;
  onMoveEntry?: (srcPath: string, destDir: string) => void;
};

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function sortEntries(entries: TreeEntry[], mode: SortMode): TreeEntry[] {
  const dirs = entries.filter(e => e.type === 'directory');
  const files = entries.filter(e => e.type === 'file');

  const byName = (a: TreeEntry, b: TreeEntry) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base' });
  const byNameDesc = (a: TreeEntry, b: TreeEntry) => -byName(a, b);

  switch (mode) {
    case 'name-asc':
      return [...dirs.sort(byName), ...files.sort(byName)];
    case 'name-desc':
      return [...dirs.sort(byNameDesc), ...files.sort(byNameDesc)];
    case 'type':
      return [
        ...dirs.sort(byName),
        ...files.sort((a, b) => {
          const extA = a.name.includes('.') ? a.name.split('.').pop()! : '';
          const extB = b.name.includes('.') ? b.name.split('.').pop()! : '';
          return extA.localeCompare(extB) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
        }),
      ];
  }
}

function filterTree(entries: TreeEntry[], query: string, showHidden: boolean): TreeEntry[] {
  if (!query && showHidden) return entries;
  const q = query.toLowerCase();
  return entries.reduce<TreeEntry[]>((acc, entry) => {
    const isHidden = entry.name.startsWith('.');
    if (!showHidden && isHidden) return acc;
    if (entry.type === 'directory' && entry.children) {
      const filteredChildren = filterTree(entry.children, query, showHidden);
      if (filteredChildren.length > 0 || entry.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
        acc.push({ ...entry, children: filteredChildren });
      }
    } else if (entry.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
      acc.push(entry);
    }
    return acc;
  }, []);
}

function countEntries(entries: TreeEntry[]): number {
  return entries.reduce((acc, e) => {
    if (e.type === 'file') return acc + 1;
    return acc + countEntries(e.children ?? []);
  }, 0);
}

// ── Sort Icon helper ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SortIcon({ mode }: { mode: SortMode }) {
  if (mode === 'name-asc') return <ArrowDownAZ size={12} />;
  if (mode === 'name-desc') return <ArrowUpZA size={12} />;
  return <Layers size={12} />;
}

function sortLabel(mode: SortMode): string {
  if (mode === 'name-asc') return 'Tri : A→Z';
  if (mode === 'name-desc') return 'Tri : Z→A';
  return 'Tri : Type';
}

function nextSort(mode: SortMode): SortMode {
  if (mode === 'name-asc') return 'name-desc';
  if (mode === 'name-desc') return 'type';
  return 'name-asc';
}

// ── HighlightMatch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function HighlightMatch({ text, query }: { text: string; query: string }) {
  const idx = text.toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase());
  if (idx === -1) return <>{text}</>;
  return (
    <>
      {text.slice(0, idx)}
      <mark
        style={{
          backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 30%, transparent)',
          color: 'inherit',
          borderRadius: '2px',
          padding: '0 2px',
        }}
      >
        {text.slice(idx, idx + query.length)}
      </mark>
      {text.slice(idx + query.length)}
    </>
  );
}

// ── Convert TreeEntry to DataNode ──────────────────────────────────────────

interface DataNode {
  key: string;
  title: React.ReactNode;
  children?: DataNode[];
  isLeaf?: boolean;
  originalEntry: TreeEntry;
}

function toDataNode(
  entry: TreeEntry,
  depth: number,
  expandedDirs: Set<string>,
  searchQuery: string,
  onOpenFile: (path: string) => void,
  onToggleDirectory: (path: string) => void,
  onContextMenu: (e: React.MouseEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => void,
  draggingPath: string | null,
  dragOverPath: string | null,
  onMoveEntry: ((srcPath: string, destDir: string) => void) | undefined,
  handleDragStart: (e: React.DragEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => void,
  handleDragEnd: () => void,
  handleDragOver: (e: React.DragEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => void,
  handleDragLeave: (e: React.DragEvent) => void,
  handleDrop: (e: React.DragEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => void,
): DataNode {
  const isExpanded = expandedDirs.has(entry.path);
  const hasChildren = entry.type === 'directory' && entry.children && entry.children.length > 0;
  const isDragTarget = dragOverPath === entry.path;

  const title = (
    <div
      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 py-1 px-2 text-[12px] cursor-pointer select-none relative group transition-colors duration-150 rounded-md"
      style={{
        paddingLeft: `${8 + depth * 14}px`,
        color: 'var(--text-primary)',
        backgroundColor: isDragTarget
          ? 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 15%, transparent)'
          : 'transparent',
        outline: isDragTarget ? '1.5px solid var(--accent-primary)' : 'none',
        outlineOffset: '-1px',
        borderRadius: '6px',
        transition: 'background 0.15s, outline 0.15s',
      }}
      onClick={() => {
        if (entry.type === 'file') onOpenFile(entry.path);
        else onToggleDirectory(entry.path);
      }}
      onContextMenu={(e) => onContextMenu(e, entry)}
      draggable
      onDragStart={(e) => handleDragStart(e, entry)}
      onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
      onDragOver={(e) => handleDragOver(e, entry)}
      onDragLeave={handleDragLeave}
      onDrop={(e) => handleDrop(e, entry)}
    >
      {/* Drag handle indicator */}
      <span className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-30 transition-opacity absolute" style={{ left: `${depth * 14 + 2}px` }}>
        <GripVertical size={10} />
      </span>

      {/* Arrow indicator for directories */}
      {entry.type === 'directory' ? (
        <span className="opacity-60 group-hover:opacity-100 mr-0.5">
          {isExpanded ? <ChevronDown size={12} /> : <ChevronRight size={12} />}
        </span>
      ) : (
        <span className="w-4" />
      )}

      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-1 min-w-0">
        {entry.type === 'directory' ? (
          isDragTarget || isExpanded ? (
            <FolderOpen size={14} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
          ) : (
            <Folder size={14} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
          )
        ) : (
          <FileIcon filePath={entry.path} size={14} />
        )}
        <span className="truncate font-normal opacity-90 group-hover:opacity-100" title={entry.name}>
          {searchQuery ? (
            <HighlightMatch text={entry.name} query={searchQuery} />
          ) : (
            entry.name
          )}
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  const children = hasChildren && isExpanded
    ? entry.children!.map(child =>
        toDataNode(
          child,
          depth + 1,
          expandedDirs,
          searchQuery,
          onOpenFile,
          onToggleDirectory,
          onContextMenu,
          draggingPath,
          dragOverPath,
          onMoveEntry,
          handleDragStart,
          handleDragEnd,
          handleDragOver,
          handleDragLeave,
          handleDrop,
        )
      )
    : undefined;

  return {
    key: entry.path,
    title,
    children,
    isLeaf: entry.type === 'file',
    originalEntry: entry,
  };
}

// ── Main Component ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const FileExplorer = memo(function FileExplorer({
  tree,
  expandedDirs,
  loading,
  currentDir,
  onOpenFile,
  onToggleDirectory,
  onContextMenu,
  onCreateFile,
  onRefresh,
  onNavigate,
  onMoveEntry,
}: FileExplorerProps) {
  // Sandbox status
  const [sandboxActive, setSandboxActive] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    let debounceTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

    const checkSandbox = async (force = false) => {
      try {
        const { sandboxApi } = await import('../../services/sandboxApi');
        const data = await sandboxApi.getStatus(force);
        if (mounted && data.status === 'success') {
          setSandboxActive(data.sandbox?.active ?? false);
        }
      } catch { /* silent */ }
    };

    checkSandbox();

    const handleChange = () => {
      if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => checkSandbox(true), 150);
    };

    window.addEventListener('jarvis-sandbox-changed', handleChange);
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
      if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      window.removeEventListener('jarvis-sandbox-changed', handleChange);
    };
  }, []);

  // Search, Sort, Hidden files
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [showSearch, setShowSearch] = useState(false);
  const [sortMode, setSortMode] = useState<SortMode>('name-asc');
  const [showHidden, setShowHidden] = useState(false);
  const [debouncedSearch, setDebouncedSearch] = useState('');
  const searchInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // Debounce manuel
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setDebouncedSearch(searchQuery), 200);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [searchQuery]);

  // Keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+F to focus search
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && e.key === 'F') {
        e.preventDefault();
        setShowSearch(true);
        setTimeout(() => searchInputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && showSearch) {
        setShowSearch(false);
        setSearchQuery('');
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handler);
  }, [showSearch]);

  const toggleSearch = useCallback(() => {
    setShowSearch(prev => {
      if (prev) setSearchQuery('');
      else {
        setTimeout(() => searchInputRef.current?.focus(), 50);
      }
      return !prev;
    });
  }, []);

  // Process tree: filter, hidden, sort
  const processedTree = useMemo(() => {
    const filtered = filterTree(tree, debouncedSearch, showHidden);
    const applySort = (entries: TreeEntry[]): TreeEntry[] =>
      sortEntries(entries, sortMode).map(e =>
        e.type === 'directory' && e.children
          ? { ...e, children: applySort(e.children) }
          : e
      );
    return applySort(filtered);
  }, [tree, debouncedSearch, sortMode, showHidden]);

  // Drag & Drop
  const [draggingPath, setDraggingPath] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOverPath, setDragOverPath] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleDragStart = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => {
    setDraggingPath(entry.path);
    e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
    e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', entry.path);
  }, []);

  const handleDragOver = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => {
    if (entry.type !== 'directory') return;
    if (entry.path === draggingPath) return;
    if (draggingPath && entry.path.startsWith(draggingPath + '/')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
    setDragOverPath(entry.path);
  }, [draggingPath]);

  const handleDragLeave = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
    if (!(e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).contains(e.relatedTarget as Node | null)) {
      setDragOverPath(null);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleDrop = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent, entry: TreeEntry) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setDragOverPath(null);
    setDraggingPath(null);
    if (entry.type !== 'directory') return;
    const src = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    if (!src || src === entry.path) return;
    if (src.startsWith(entry.path + '/')) return;
    onMoveEntry?.(src, entry.path);
  }, [onMoveEntry]);

  const handleDragEnd = useCallback(() => {
    setDraggingPath(null);
    setDragOverPath(null);
  }, []);

  // Convert to rc-tree format
  const treeData = useMemo(() => {
    return processedTree.map(entry =>
      toDataNode(
        entry,
        0,
        expandedDirs,
        debouncedSearch,
        onOpenFile,
        onToggleDirectory,
        onContextMenu,
        draggingPath,
        dragOverPath,
        onMoveEntry,
        handleDragStart,
        handleDragEnd,
        handleDragOver,
        handleDragLeave,
        handleDrop,
      )
    );
  }, [
    processedTree,
    expandedDirs,
    debouncedSearch,
    onOpenFile,
    onToggleDirectory,
    onContextMenu,
    onMoveEntry,
    draggingPath,
    dragOverPath,
    handleDragStart,
    handleDragEnd,
    handleDragOver,
    handleDragLeave,
    handleDrop,
  ]);

  // Sync expansion with rc-tree
  const expandedKeys = useMemo(() => Array.from(expandedDirs), [expandedDirs]);

  const handleTreeExpand = useCallback((expandedKeys: string[]) => {
    expandedKeys.forEach(key => onToggleDirectory(key));
  }, [onToggleDirectory]);

  // Count files
  const fileCount = useMemo(() => countEntries(processedTree), [processedTree]);

  return (
    <div
      className="flex flex-col border-r h-full select-none"
      style={{
        width: '260px',
        borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-sidebar)',
      }}
    >
      {/* Change Project Header Button */}
      <div
        className="p-2 border-b"
        style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-panel)' }}
      >
        <button
          onClick={async () => {
            try {
              await fetch('/api/self-root/clear', { method: 'POST' });
            } catch { /* best-effort */ }
            window.location.reload();
          }}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-semibold transition-colors hover:opacity-90 shadow-sm"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 12%, transparent)',
            color: 'var(--accent-primary)',
            border: '1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 25%, transparent)',
          }}
          title="Changer de projet racine"
        >
          <FolderInput size={14} />
          <span>Changer de projet</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Explorer Header */}
      <div
        className="flex items-center justify-between border-b px-3"
        style={{ height: '36px', borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-medium truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
              📁 Explorer
            </span>
            <div className="text-[9px] truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} title={currentDir ? currentDir : 'Racine'}>
              {currentDir === '.' ? 'Racine' : currentDir}
            </div>
          </div>
          {!loading && (
            <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 rounded-md" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)', background: 'var(--bg-input)' }}>
              {fileCount}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          {currentDir && currentDir !== '.' && (
            <button
              onClick={() => onNavigate(currentDir.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/') || '.')}
              className="flex items-center rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-semibold transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--bg-panel)]"
              style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }}
              title="Remonter d’un niveau"
            >
              <ChevronUp size={12} />
              <span className="hidden sm:inline">Parent</span>
            </button>
          )}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            {sandboxActive ? (
              <span
                className="text-[8px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-bold flex items-center gap-0.5 shadow-sm border border-success-subtle bg-success-subtle text-success"
                title="Mode Sandbox actif"
              >
                <Shield size={8} />
                SBX
              </span>
            ) : (
              <span
                className="text-[8px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md font-bold flex items-center gap-0.5 border border-[rgba(156,163,175,0.15)] bg-[rgba(156,163,175,0.08)] text-[var(--text-muted)]"
                title="Mode Sandbox inactif"
              >
                <Shield size={8} />
                SBX
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div
        className="flex items-center gap-0.5 px-2 border-b"
        style={{ height: '32px', borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-base)' }}
      >
        <button
          onClick={toggleSearch}
          className={`rounded-md p-1.5 transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--bg-panel)] ${showSearch ? 'bg-[var(--bg-panel)]' : ''}`}
          title="Rechercher (Ctrl+Shift+F)"
          style={{ color: showSearch ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}
        >
          <Search size={13} />
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowHidden(!showHidden)}
          className="rounded-md p-1.5 transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--bg-panel)]"
          title={showHidden ? 'Masquer fichiers cachés' : 'Afficher fichiers cachés'}
          style={{ color: showHidden ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}
        >
          {showHidden ? <Eye size={13} /> : <EyeOff size={13} />}
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setSortMode(nextSort)}
          className="rounded-md p-1.5 transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--bg-panel)]"
          title={sortLabel(sortMode)}
          style={{ color: sortMode !== 'name-asc' ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}
        >
          <SortIcon mode={sortMode} />
        </button>
        <div className="flex-1" />
        <button
          onClick={onCreateFile}
          className="rounded-md p-1.5 transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--bg-panel)]"
          title="Nouveau fichier"
        >
          <Plus size={13} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={onRefresh}
          className="rounded-md p-1.5 transition-colors hover:bg-[var(--bg-panel)]"
          title="Actualiser"
        >
          <RefreshCcw size={13} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Search input (expandable) */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {showSearch && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}
            className="overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b px-3 py-1.5"
              style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-base)' }}
            >
              <Search size={12} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)', flexShrink: 0 }} />
              <input
                ref={searchInputRef}
                type="text"
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Filtrer les fichiers…"
                className="flex-1 bg-transparent text-[12px] outline-none placeholder:opacity-40"
                style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                  className="opacity-50 hover:opacity-100 transition"
                  title="Effacer"
                >
                  <X size={11} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
                </button>
              )}
              <button
                onClick={toggleSearch}
                className="opacity-50 hover:opacity-100 transition"
                title="Fermer la recherche"
              >
                <X size={11} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
              </button>
            </div>
            {searchQuery && (
              <div
                className="px-3 py-0.5 text-[9px] border-b"
                style={{
                  borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
                  color: 'var(--text-dimmed)',
                  backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 5%, transparent)',
                }}
              >
                {fileCount} résultat{fileCount !== 1 ? 's' : ''} pour «{searchQuery}»
              </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

      {/* Sort indicator (non-default) */}
      {sortMode !== 'name-asc' && !searchQuery && !showSearch && (
        <div
          className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-0.5 text-[9px] border-b"
          style={{
            borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
            backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 8%, transparent)',
            color: 'var(--accent-primary)',
          }}
        >
          <SortIcon mode={sortMode} />
          <span>{sortLabel(sortMode)}</span>
          <button
            className="ml-auto opacity-60 hover:opacity-100 transition"
            onClick={() => setSortMode('name-asc')}
            title="Réinitialiser le tri"
          >
            <X size={9} />
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tree View Container - Virtualized */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-1 custom-scrollbar" style={{ height: '100%' }}>
        {loading ? (
          <div className="space-y-1.5 px-3 py-2">
            {Array.from({ length: 12 }).map((_, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2" style={{ paddingLeft: `${8 + (i % 4) * 14}px` }}>
                <div className="skeleton w-4 h-4 rounded flex-shrink-0 opacity-40" />
                <div className="skeleton h-2.5 rounded flex-1 opacity-30" style={{ maxWidth: `${60 + Math.random() * 80}px` }} />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : processedTree.length === 0 && !searchQuery ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 px-4 text-center">
            <div
              className="w-10 h-10 rounded flex items-center justify-center mb-3"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-subtle)' }}
            >
              <Folder size={20} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
            </div>
            <p className="text-[12px] font-semibold mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              Dossier vide
            </p>
            <p className="text-[10px] mb-4 leading-normal opacity-60" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              Créez un fichier ou ouvrez un projet.
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={onCreateFile}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-semibold transition hover:opacity-95"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-primary)',
                color: '#fff',
                borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
              }}
            >
              <Plus size={12} />
              Nouveau fichier
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : processedTree.length === 0 && searchQuery ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 px-4 text-center">
            <Search size={24} className="mb-3 opacity-30" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
            <p className="text-[12px] opacity-60" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              Aucun fichier ne correspond à «{searchQuery}»
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <Tree
            treeData={treeData}
            height={600}
            width={260}
            itemHeight={26}
            virtual
            showLine
            expandedKeys={expandedKeys}
            onExpand={handleTreeExpand}
            selectable={false}
            defaultExpandParent
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
});

export { FileExplorer };
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import {
  FileCode2, FileText, FileJson, FileImage,
  File, Settings, Database, Globe,
} from 'lucide-react';

// ── Couleurs par extension ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
const EXT_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  // TypeScript
  ts: '#3178c6', tsx: '#3178c6',
  // JavaScript
  js: '#f7df1e', jsx: '#f7df1e', cjs: '#f7df1e', mjs: '#f7df1e',
  // Markup / style
  html: '#e44d26', css: '#264de4', scss: '#c6538c', sass: '#c6538c',
  // Data
  json: '#cbcb41', yaml: '#cc3e44', yml: '#cc3e44', sql: '#e38c00',
  // Doc
  md: '#ffffff', txt: '#9ca3af',
  // Config / env
  env: '#eab308', gitignore: '#f05032', lock: '#6b7280',
  // Python
  py: '#3572a5',
  // Shell
  sh: '#89e051', bash: '#89e051',
  // Other
  cjs_: '#f7df1e',
};

// ── Icône par extension ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function pickIcon(ext: string): React.ComponentType<{ size?: number; color?: string }> {
  if (['ts', 'tsx', 'js', 'jsx', 'cjs', 'mjs', 'py', 'sh', 'bash'].includes(ext)) return FileCode2;
  if (['json', 'yaml', 'yml'].includes(ext)) return FileJson;
  if (['md', 'txt'].includes(ext)) return FileText;
  if (['png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'svg', 'webp'].includes(ext)) return FileImage;
  if (['html', 'htm'].includes(ext)) return Globe;
  if (['css', 'scss', 'sass'].includes(ext)) return FileCode2;
  if (['sql', 'db', 'sqlite'].includes(ext)) return Database;
  if (['env', 'config', 'cfg', 'ini', 'toml'].includes(ext)) return Settings;
  return File;
}

interface FileIconProps {
  filePath: string;
  size?: number;
}

export function FileIcon({ filePath, size = 15 }: FileIconProps) {
  const name = filePath.split('/').pop() ?? filePath;

  // Cas spéciaux par nom de fichier
  if (name === '.env' || name.startsWith('.env.')) {
    return <Settings size={size} color="#eab308" />;
  }
  if (name === '.gitignore') {
    return <File size={size} color="#f05032" />;
  }
  if (name === 'package.json' || name === 'package-lock.json') {
    return <FileJson size={size} color="#cb3837" />;
  }
  if (name === 'tsconfig.json' || name === 'vite.config.ts') {
    return <Settings size={size} color="#3178c6" />;
  }

  const parts = name.split('.');
  const ext   = parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1].toLowerCase() : '';
  const Icon  = pickIcon(ext);
  const color = EXT_COLOR[ext] ?? 'var(--text-muted)';

  return <Icon size={size} color={color} />;
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Github, GitPullRequest, AlertCircle, Bell, Search, Star,
  ExternalLink, RefreshCw, Loader2, X, BookOpen, Eye,
  ChevronDown, ChevronRight, FolderOpen,
} from 'lucide-react';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface Repo {
  full_name: string;
  description: string | null;
  language: string | null;
  stars: number;
  updated_at: string;
  private: boolean;
  html_url: string;
}

interface Issue {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  state: string;
  author: string;
  labels: string[];
  created_at: string;
  comments: number;
  html_url: string;
}

interface PullRequest {
  number: number;
  title: string;
  state: string;
  author: string;
  head: string;
  base: string;
  created_at: string;
  draft: boolean;
  html_url: string;
}

interface Notification {
  id: string;
  reason: string;
  unread: boolean;
  title: string;
  type: string;
  repo: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

type Tab = 'repos' | 'issues' | 'prs' | 'notifications';

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function timeAgo(dateStr: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  if (mins < 60) return `${mins}m`;
  const hours = Math.floor(mins / 60);
  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h`;
  const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  return `${days}j`;
}

function langColor(lang: string | null): string {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    TypeScript: '#3178c6', JavaScript: '#f7df1e', Python: '#3572A5',
    Rust: '#dea584', Go: '#00ADD8', Java: '#b07219', 'C#': '#178600',
    HTML: '#e34c26', CSS: '#563d7c', Shell: '#89e051',
  };
  return colors[lang || ''] || '#8b949e';
}

// ─── Component ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface GitHubPanelProps {
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function GitHubPanel({ onClose }: GitHubPanelProps) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('repos');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [configured, setConfigured] = useState(true);

  // Data
  const [repos, setRepos] = useState<Repo[]>([]);
  const [issues, setIssues] = useState<Issue[]>([]);
  const [prs, setPrs] = useState<PullRequest[]>([]);
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<Notification[]>([]);

  // Search / filter
  const [repoOwner, setRepoOwner] = useState('');
  const [repoName, setRepoName] = useState('');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  // ─── Auto-detect current project's GitHub repo ────────────────────────

  const detectCurrentRepo = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/github/current-repo');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'success' && data.owner && data.repo) {
        // Verify the repo actually exists on GitHub before setting it
        const checkRes = await fetch(`/api/github/issues?owner=${encodeURIComponent(data.owner)}&repo=${encodeURIComponent(data.repo)}&state=open`);
        const checkData = await checkRes.json();
        if (!checkData.error) {
          setRepoOwner(data.owner);
          setRepoName(data.repo);
        } else {
          console.warn(`[GitHubPanel] Repo ${data.owner}/${data.repo} non accessible:`, checkData.error);
          // Still set it so user sees which repo was detected
          setRepoOwner(data.owner);
          setRepoName(data.repo);
        }
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { detectCurrentRepo(); }, [detectCurrentRepo]);

  // ─── API calls ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const fetchRepos = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/github/repos');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) {
        if (data.error.includes('TOKEN')) setConfigured(false);
        setError(data.error);
        return;
      }
      setRepos(data.repos || []);
      setConfigured(true);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const fetchIssues = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!repoOwner || !repoName) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ owner: repoOwner, repo: repoName });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/github/issues?${params}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) { setError(data.error); return; }
      setIssues(data.issues || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [repoOwner, repoName]);

  const fetchPRs = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!repoOwner || !repoName) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ owner: repoOwner, repo: repoName });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/github/pulls?${params}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) { setError(data.error); return; }
      setPrs(data.pull_requests || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [repoOwner, repoName]);

  const fetchNotifications = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/github/notifications');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) {
        // Don't show "not configured" or scope errors as blocking
        if (data.error.includes('TOKEN') || data.error.includes('scope')) {
          setNotifications([]);
          // Show error only as a subtle message, not blocking
          setError(`⚠️ ${data.error}`);
        } else {
          setError(data.error);
        }
        return;
      }
      setNotifications(data.notifications || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const searchRepos = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ query: searchQuery.trim() });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/github/search?${params}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) { setError(data.error); return; }
      setRepos(data.repos || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [searchQuery]);

  // Select a repo to browse its issues/PRs
  const selectRepo = useCallback((fullName: string) => {
    const [owner, repo] = fullName.split('/');
    setRepoOwner(owner);
    setRepoName(repo);
  }, []);

  // ─── Effects ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  useEffect(() => { fetchRepos(); }, [fetchRepos]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab === 'issues' && repoOwner && repoName) fetchIssues();
    if (tab === 'prs' && repoOwner && repoName) fetchPRs();
    if (tab === 'notifications') fetchNotifications();
  }, [tab, repoOwner, repoName, fetchIssues, fetchPRs, fetchNotifications]);

  // Auto-load issues when repo is detected and panel opens on issues tab
  useEffect(() => {
    if (repoOwner && repoName && tab === 'issues') fetchIssues();
    if (repoOwner && repoName && tab === 'prs') fetchPRs();
  }, [repoOwner, repoName]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  // ─── Render ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  return (
    <div
      className="border-l flex flex-col"
      style={{ width: '320px', borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-panel)' }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div
        className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-2 border-b flex-shrink-0"
        style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Github size={14} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
          <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
            GitHub
          </span>
          {repoOwner && repoName && (
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded flex items-center gap-1" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(14,165,233,0.1)', color: 'var(--accent-primary)', border: '1px solid rgba(14,165,233,0.2)' }}>
              {repoOwner}/{repoName}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button
            onClick={() => { if (tab === 'repos') fetchRepos(); else if (tab === 'issues') fetchIssues(); else if (tab === 'prs') fetchPRs(); else fetchNotifications(); }}
            className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10"
            title="Rafraîchir"
          >
            {loading ? <Loader2 size={12} className="animate-spin" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} /> : <RefreshCw size={12} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />}
          </button>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10" title="Fermer">
            <X size={12} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex border-b flex-shrink-0" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}>
        {([
          { key: 'repos', label: 'Repos', icon: <BookOpen size={11} /> },
          { key: 'issues', label: 'Issues', icon: <AlertCircle size={11} /> },
          { key: 'prs', label: 'PRs', icon: <GitPullRequest size={11} /> },
          { key: 'notifications', label: 'Notifs', icon: <Bell size={11} /> },
        ] as { key: Tab; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[]).map(({ key, label, icon }) => (
          <button
            key={key}
            onClick={() => setTab(key)}
            className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 px-2 py-2 text-[10px] font-semibold transition-all border-b-2"
            style={{
              borderColor: tab === key ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'transparent',
              color: tab === key ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-dimmed)',
            }}
          >
            {icon} {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Error */}
      {error && (
        <div className="mx-3 mt-2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded text-[10px]" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.08)', color: '#f87171', border: '1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.15)' }}>
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Not configured */}
      {!configured && (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center flex-1 px-4 py-8 text-center">
          <Github size={32} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} className="mb-3" />
          <p className="text-xs font-semibold mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>GitHub non configuré</p>
          <p className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            Ajoutez votre GITHUB_TOKEN dans les paramètres pour accéder à vos repos, issues et PRs.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Content */}
      {configured && (
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
          {/* ─── Repos Tab ─────────────────────────────────────── */}
          {tab === 'repos' && (
            <div className="p-2">
              {/* Search */}
              <div className="flex gap-1 mb-2">
                <input
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Rechercher des repos..."
                  className="flex-1 px-2 py-1 rounded text-[11px] focus:outline-none"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)', border: '1px solid var(--border-base)', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && searchRepos()}
                />
                <button onClick={searchRepos} className="px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-white/10" title="Rechercher">
                  <Search size={12} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
                </button>
              </div>

              {repos.map((repo) => (
                <button
                  key={repo.full_name}
                  onClick={() => selectRepo(repo.full_name)}
                  className="w-full text-left px-2 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors mb-1"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <FolderOpen size={12} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-medium truncate flex-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                      {repo.full_name}
                    </span>
                    {repo.private && (
                      <span className="text-[8px] px-1 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>privé</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {repo.description && (
                    <p className="text-[10px] mt-0.5 truncate pl-5" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{repo.description}</p>
                  )}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-1 pl-5">
                    {repo.language && (
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                        <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: langColor(repo.language) }} />
                        {repo.language}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                      <Star size={9} /> {repo.stars}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{timeAgo(repo.updated_at)}</span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
              {repos.length === 0 && !loading && !error && (
                <p className="text-center text-[10px] py-6" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>Aucun repo</p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ─── Issues Tab ────────────────────────────────────── */}
          {tab === 'issues' && (
            <div className="p-2">
              {!repoOwner || !repoName ? (
                <div className="text-center py-6">
                  <AlertCircle size={20} className="mx-auto mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
                  <p className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                    Sélectionnez un repo dans l'onglet Repos
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {issues.map((issue) => (
                    <a
                      key={issue.number}
                      href={issue.html_url}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="flex items-start gap-2 px-2 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors mb-1"
                    >
                      <AlertCircle size={12} className="mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: issue.state === 'open' ? '#3fb950' : '#f85149' }} />
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                          #{issue.number} {issue.title}
                        </p>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                          <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{issue.author}</span>
                          <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{timeAgo(issue.created_at)}</span>
                          {issue.comments > 0 && <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>💬{issue.comments}</span>}
                        </div>
                        {issue.labels.length > 0 && (
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1">
                            {issue.labels.slice(0, 3).map((l) => (
                              <span key={l} className="text-[8px] px-1 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                                {l}
                              </span>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <ExternalLink size={10} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} className="flex-shrink-0 mt-1" />
                    </a>
                  ))}
                  {issues.length === 0 && !loading && (
                    <p className="text-center text-[10px] py-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>Aucune issue ouverte</p>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ─── PRs Tab ───────────────────────────────────────── */}
          {tab === 'prs' && (
            <div className="p-2">
              {!repoOwner || !repoName ? (
                <div className="text-center py-6">
                  <GitPullRequest size={20} className="mx-auto mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
                  <p className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                    Sélectionnez un repo dans l'onglet Repos
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {prs.map((pr) => (
                    <a
                      key={pr.number}
                      href={pr.html_url}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="flex items-start gap-2 px-2 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors mb-1"
                    >
                      <GitPullRequest size={12} className="mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: pr.state === 'open' ? '#3fb950' : '#a371f7' }} />
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                          #{pr.number} {pr.title}
                        </p>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                          <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{pr.author}</span>
                          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                            {pr.head} → {pr.base}
                          </span>
                          {pr.draft && <span className="text-[8px] px-1 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)', color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>draft</span>}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <ExternalLink size={10} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} className="flex-shrink-0 mt-1" />
                    </a>
                  ))}
                  {prs.length === 0 && !loading && (
                    <p className="text-center text-[10px] py-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>Aucune PR ouverte</p>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* ─── Notifications Tab ─────────────────────────────── */}
          {tab === 'notifications' && (
            <div className="p-2">
              {notifications.map((n) => (
                <div
                  key={n.id}
                  className="flex items-start gap-2 px-2 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors mb-1"
                >
                  <Bell size={12} className="mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: n.unread ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-[11px] font-medium truncate" style={{ color: n.unread ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                      {n.title}
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                      <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{n.repo}</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{n.reason}</span>
                      <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{timeAgo(n.updated_at)}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
              {notifications.length === 0 && !loading && (
                <p className="text-center text-[10px] py-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>Aucune notification</p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

`src\components\ide\GitHubRepoSelector.tsx`:

```tsx
import React, { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { GitBranch, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, RefreshCw, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, Loader2, Cloud } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';

interface RepoSyncStatusProps {
  /** Compact mode (pour sidebar) vs expanded (pour panneau) */
  compact?: boolean;
}

interface GitStatus {
  branch: string;
  clean: boolean;
  ahead: number;
  behind: number;
  lastCommit: string;
  lastCommitDate: string;
}

/**
 * RepoSyncStatus — Indicateur de sync du repo Jarvis-OS (auto-référentiel).
 * Remplace l'ancien GitHubRepoSelector (clone multi-repos supprimé).
 * Affiche : branche courante, ahead/behind, boutons push/pull.
 */
export const GitHubRepoSelector = React.memo(function RepoSyncStatus({ compact = false }: RepoSyncStatusProps) {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<GitStatus | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [syncing, setSyncing] = useState<'push' | 'pull' | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const hasFetched = useRef(false);

  const fetchStatus = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/self-root/status');
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      setStatus({
        branch: data.gitBranch || 'main',
        clean: data.gitStatus === 'clean',
        ahead: data.aheadBehind?.ahead || 0,
        behind: data.aheadBehind?.behind || 0,
        lastCommit: data.lastCommit || '—',
        lastCommitDate: data.lastCommitDate || '—',
      });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message || 'Erreur');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasFetched.current) return;
    hasFetched.current = true;
    fetchStatus();
    // Refresh every 30s
    const interval = setInterval(fetchStatus, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [fetchStatus]);

  const handlePush = useCallback(async () => {
    setSyncing('push');
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/push', { method: 'POST' });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) setError(data.error);
      else await fetchStatus();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setSyncing(null);
    }
  }, [fetchStatus]);

  const handlePull = useCallback(async () => {
    setSyncing('pull');
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/pull', { method: 'POST' });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) setError(data.error);
      else await fetchStatus();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setSyncing(null);
    }
  }, [fetchStatus]);

  if (loading && !status) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
        <Loader2 size={12} className="animate-spin" />
        <span className="text-[10px]">Chargement git…</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!status) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
        <AlertCircle size={12} />
        <span className="text-[10px]">{error || 'Git indisponible'}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (compact) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}>
        <GitBranch size={11} style={{ color: '#f472b6' }} />
        <span className="text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
          {status.branch}
        </span>
        {(status.ahead > 0 || status.behind > 0) && (
          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
            {status.ahead > 0 && <span style={{ color: '#4ade80' }}>↑{status.ahead}</span>}
            {status.behind > 0 && <span style={{ color: '#f59e0b' }}> ↓{status.behind}</span>}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full" style={{
          backgroundColor: status.clean ? '#4ade80' : '#f59e0b'
        }} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5 p-3 rounded-xl"
      style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)', border: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(244,114,182,0.12)' }}>
            <GitBranch size={13} style={{ color: '#f472b6' }} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              {status.branch}
            </p>
            <p className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
              {status.clean ? 'Propre' : 'Modifications non commitées'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={fetchStatus}
          className="p-1.5 rounded-md transition-colors hover:bg-[color-mix(in_srgb,var(--text-muted)_10%,transparent)]"
          title="Rafraîchir"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={12} className={loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Status indicators */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px]"
          style={{ color: status.clean ? '#4ade80' : '#f59e0b' }}>
          {status.clean ? <CheckCircle2 size={11} /> : <AlertCircle size={11} />}
          {status.clean ? 'Clean' : 'Dirty'}
        </span>
        {status.ahead > 0 && (
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px]" style={{ color: '#4ade80' }}>
            <ArrowUp size={11} /> {status.ahead} ahead
          </span>
        )}
        {status.behind > 0 && (
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px]" style={{ color: '#f59e0b' }}>
            <ArrowDown size={11} /> {status.behind} behind
          </span>
        )}
        {status.ahead === 0 && status.behind === 0 && (
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
            <Cloud size={11} /> À jour
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Last commit */}
      <div className="text-[9px] px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-base)', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
        <span className="font-mono">{status.lastCommit}</span>
        <span className="ml-2 opacity-60">{status.lastCommitDate}</span>
      </div>

      {/* Push/Pull actions */}
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <motion.button
          type="button"
          onClick={handlePull}
          disabled={syncing !== null || status.behind === 0}
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.96 }}
          className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-[10px] font-semibold transition-all disabled:opacity-40"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: status.behind > 0 ? 'color-mix(in srgb, #f59e0b 12%, transparent)' : 'var(--bg-base)',
            border: `1px solid ${status.behind > 0 ? 'color-mix(in srgb, #f59e0b 30%, transparent)' : 'var(--border-base)'}`,
            color: status.behind > 0 ? '#fbbf24' : 'var(--text-muted)',
          }}
        >
          {syncing === 'pull' ? <Loader2 size={11} className="animate-spin" /> : <ArrowDown size={11} />}
          Pull
        </motion.button>
        <motion.button
          type="button"
          onClick={handlePush}
          disabled={syncing !== null || status.ahead === 0}
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.96 }}
          className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-[10px] font-semibold transition-all disabled:opacity-40"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: status.ahead > 0 ? 'color-mix(in srgb, #4ade80 12%, transparent)' : 'var(--bg-base)',
            border: `1px solid ${status.ahead > 0 ? 'color-mix(in srgb, #4ade80 30%, transparent)' : 'var(--border-base)'}`,
            color: status.ahead > 0 ? '#4ade80' : 'var(--text-muted)',
          }}
        >
          {syncing === 'push' ? <Loader2 size={11} className="animate-spin" /> : <ArrowUp size={11} />}
          Push
        </motion.button>
      </div>

      {/* Error */}
      {error && (
        <p className="text-[10px] px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'color-mix(in srgb, #ef4444 8%, transparent)', color: '#f87171' }}>
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});
```
