```tsx
import {
  Check, Code2, Database, Eye, Keyboard, Palette, Plus, RotateCcw, SlidersHorizontal, Type, X, Minus, Search,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useState, type ReactNode, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import type { IdeSettings } from '../../types/ide';
import { DEFAULT_IDE_SETTINGS } from '../../types/ide';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';

type SettingsPanelProps = {
  settings: IdeSettings;
  onUpdateSetting: <K extends keyof IdeSettings>(key: K, value: IdeSettings[K]) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
};

// ── Composants internes réutilisables ──────────────────────────────────────

function Toggle({ checked, onChange, label }: { checked: boolean; onChange: (value: boolean) => void; label?: string }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      role="switch"
      aria-checked={checked}
      aria-label={label || (checked ? 'Activer' : 'Désactiver')}
      onClick={() => onChange(!checked)}
      className="relative h-5 w-9 rounded-full transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-1"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: checked ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--bg-input)',
        boxShadow: checked ? '0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary) 12%, transparent)' : 'none',
      }}
    >
      <span
        className="absolute top-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white shadow-sm transition-transform"
        style={{ transform: checked ? 'translateX(18px)' : 'translateX(2px)' }}
      />
    </button>
  );
}

function CompactSelect({ value, onChange, children, label }: { value: string | number; onChange: (value: string) => void; children: ReactNode; label?: string }) {
  return (
    <select
      value={value}
      onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
      aria-label={label}
      className="rounded-md border px-2 py-1 text-[11px] outline-none transition-colors"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)',
        borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
        color: 'var(--text-primary)',
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </select>
  );
}

// ── Catégories ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type Category = { id: string; label: string; icon: typeof Palette; description: string };

const CATEGORIES: Category[] = [
  { id: 'apparence',  label: 'Apparence',    icon: Palette,           description: 'Thèmes, minimap, espaces' },
  { id: 'texte',      label: 'Typographie',  icon: Type,              description: 'Police, tabulation, retour à la ligne' },
  { id: 'editeur',    label: 'Éditeur',      icon: Code2,             description: 'Paires, scroll épinglé' },
  { id: 'raccourcis', label: 'Raccourcis',   icon: Keyboard,          description: 'Tous les raccourcis' },
  { id: 'donnees',    label: 'Données',      icon: Database,          description: 'Gestion des conversations' },
];

// ── Composant principal ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export function SettingsPanel({ settings, onUpdateSetting, onClose }: SettingsPanelProps) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<Category['id']>('apparence');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const searchInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'f') {
        e.preventDefault();
        searchInputRef.current?.focus();
      }
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && searchQuery) {
        setSearchQuery('');
        searchInputRef.current?.blur();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handler);
  }, [searchQuery]);

  const handleReset = () => {
    (Object.keys(DEFAULT_IDE_SETTINGS) as Array<keyof IdeSettings>).forEach((key) => {
      onUpdateSetting(key, DEFAULT_IDE_SETTINGS[key]);
    });
  };

  const filterSettings = (tabId: string): boolean => {
    if (!searchQuery) return true;
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
    const tab = CATEGORIES.find(c => c.id === tabId);
    if (tab && (tab.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || tab.description.toLowerCase().includes(q))) return true;
    const settingLabels: Record<string, string[]> = {
      apparence:  ['Thème', 'Minimap', 'Espaces visibles'],
      texte:      ['Taille de police', 'Tabulation', 'Word wrap'],
      editeur:    ['Brackets colorés', 'Sticky scroll'],
      raccourcis: ['Multi-curseur', 'Sélection multiple', 'Commenter', 'Formater', 'Définition', 'Références', 'Fichiers', 'Commandes'],
      donnees:    ["Vider l'historique"],
    };
    return settingLabels[tabId]?.some(label => label.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ?? false;
  };

  const renderContent = () => {
    switch (activeTab) {
      case 'apparence':  return <AppearanceSettings settings={settings} onUpdateSetting={onUpdateSetting} />;
      case 'texte':      return <TextSettings settings={settings} onUpdateSetting={onUpdateSetting} />;
      case 'editeur':    return <EditorSettings settings={settings} onUpdateSetting={onUpdateSetting} />;
      case 'raccourcis': return <ShortcutsSection />;
      case 'donnees':    return <ClearConversationsCard />;
      default:           return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex h-full w-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-panel)', borderLeft: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>

      {/* ─── Sidebar catégories ─── */}
      <aside className="flex w-48 flex-shrink-0 flex-col border-r" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b px-3 py-2.5" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}>
          <SlidersHorizontal size={14} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>Réglages éditeur</span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-2">
          {CATEGORIES.map((cat) => {
            if (!filterSettings(cat.id)) return null;
            const active = activeTab === cat.id;
            const Icon = cat.icon;
            return (
              <button
                key={cat.id}
                onClick={() => setActiveTab(cat.id)}
                className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 text-left transition-colors"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: active ? 'var(--accent-subtle)' : 'transparent',
                  color: active ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)',
                  borderRight: active ? '2px solid var(--accent-primary)' : '2px solid transparent',
                }}
              >
                <Icon size={15} />
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-medium truncate">{cat.label}</div>
                  <div className="text-[9px] truncate opacity-60">{cat.description}</div>
                </div>
                {active && <Check size={12} className="flex-shrink-0" />}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        <div className="border-t px-3 py-2" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}>
          <button
            onClick={handleReset}
            className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-[10px] transition hover:bg-white/10"
            style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}
          >
            <RotateCcw size={12} />
            Réinitialiser
          </button>
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* ─── Contenu principal ─── */}
      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col min-w-0">
        {/* Header avec recherche */}
        <header className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b px-4 py-2.5" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}>
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <h3 className="text-[12px] font-semibold truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              {CATEGORIES.find(c => c.id === activeTab)?.label || 'Réglages'}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-[10px] truncate opacity-60" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              {CATEGORIES.find(c => c.id === activeTab)?.description || ''}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="relative flex items-center gap-2">
            <Search size={13} className="absolute left-2.5 pointer-events-none" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
            <input
              ref={searchInputRef}
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Rechercher… (Ctrl+F)"
              className="w-44 rounded-md border bg-transparent py-1 pl-7 pr-2 text-[11px] outline-none transition-colors"
              style={{
                borderColor: searchQuery ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--border-base)',
                color: 'var(--text-primary)',
              }}
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')} className="absolute right-2 p-0.5 rounded-full hover:bg-white/10" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                <X size={11} />
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="rounded-lg p-1.5 transition hover:bg-white/10" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            <X size={16} />
          </button>
        </header>

        {/* Zone scrollable */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 custom-scrollbar">
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            <motion.div
              key={activeTab}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}
              className="max-w-2xl mx-auto"
            >
              {renderContent()}
            </motion.div>
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ─── Onglets ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function AppearanceSettings({ settings, onUpdateSetting }: { settings: IdeSettings; onUpdateSetting: any }) {
  return (
    <SectionCard icon={Palette} title="Apparence" description="Personnalisez le thème et les affichages">
      <div className="mb-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        {([
          { value: 'vs-dark', label: 'Sombre',   color: '#202124' },
          { value: 'vs',      label: 'Clair',    color: '#f4f4f4' },
          { value: 'hc-black',label: 'HC noir',  color: '#000000' },
          { value: 'hc-light',label: 'HC clair', color: '#ffffff' },
        ] as { value: IdeSettings['theme']; label: string; color: string }[]).map((theme) => {
          const active = settings.theme === theme.value;
          return (
            <button key={theme.value} onClick={() => onUpdateSetting('theme', theme.value)}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-colors"
              style={{ borderColor: active ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: active ? 'var(--accent-subtle)' : 'var(--bg-input)' }}
            >
              <span className="h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full border" style={{ backgroundColor: theme.color, borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }} />
              <span className="flex-1 text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: active ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-primary)' }}>{theme.label}</span>
              {active && <Check size={10} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <SettingRow label="Minimap" description="Aperçu du fichier à droite">
        <Toggle checked={settings.showMinimap} onChange={(v) => onUpdateSetting('showMinimap', v)} />
      </SettingRow>
      <SettingRow label="Espaces visibles" description="Marque les espaces et tabulations">
        <Toggle checked={settings.showWhitespace} onChange={(v) => onUpdateSetting('showWhitespace', v)} />
      </SettingRow>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

function TextSettings({ settings, onUpdateSetting }: { settings: IdeSettings; onUpdateSetting: any }) {
  return (
    <SectionCard icon={Type} title="Typographie" description="Police, tabulation et retour à la ligne">
      <SettingRow label="Taille de police" description={`${settings.fontSize}px · de 10 à 24`}>
        <div className="flex items-center rounded-md border" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)' }}>
          <button onClick={() => onUpdateSetting('fontSize', Math.max(10, settings.fontSize - 1))} className="p-1 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-l-md" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            <Minus size={11} />
          </button>
          <span className="w-7 text-center font-mono text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>{settings.fontSize}</span>
          <button onClick={() => onUpdateSetting('fontSize', Math.min(24, settings.fontSize + 1))} className="p-1 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-r-md" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            <Plus size={11} />
          </button>
        </div>
      </SettingRow>
      <SettingRow label="Tabulation" description="Nombre d'espaces par niveau">
        <CompactSelect value={settings.tabSize} onChange={(v) => onUpdateSetting('tabSize', Number(v))}>
          <option value={2}>2 espaces</option>
          <option value={4}>4 espaces</option>
          <option value={8}>8 espaces</option>
        </CompactSelect>
      </SettingRow>
      <SettingRow label="Word wrap" description="Enveloppe les longues lignes">
        <Toggle checked={settings.wordWrap} onChange={(v) => onUpdateSetting('wordWrap', v)} />
      </SettingRow>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

function EditorSettings({ settings, onUpdateSetting }: { settings: IdeSettings; onUpdateSetting: any }) {
  return (
    <SectionCard icon={Code2} title="Éditeur" description="Comportement et aides visuelles">
      <SettingRow label="Brackets colorés" description="Coloration des paires de parenthèses">
        <Toggle checked={settings.bracketPairs} onChange={(v) => onUpdateSetting('bracketPairs', v)} />
      </SettingRow>
      <SettingRow label="Sticky scroll" description="Épingle les scopes en haut de l'éditeur">
        <Toggle checked={settings.stickyScroll} onChange={(v) => onUpdateSetting('stickyScroll', v)} />
      </SettingRow>
      <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg p-2" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)' }}>
        <p className="text-[9px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
          Les changements sont appliqués instantanément à l'éditeur actif.
        </p>
      </div>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

function ShortcutsSection() {
  const shortcuts = [
    ['Multi-curseur', 'Alt + clic'],
    ['Sélection multiple', 'Ctrl + D'],
    ['Commenter', 'Ctrl + /'],
    ['Formater', 'Shift + Alt + F'],
    ['Définition', 'F12'],
    ['Références', 'Shift + F12'],
    ['Fichiers', 'Ctrl + P'],
    ['Commandes', 'Ctrl + Shift + P'],
  ];
  return (
    <SectionCard icon={Keyboard} title="Raccourcis clavier" description="Tous les raccourcis disponibles">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1">
        {shortcuts.map(([action, shortcut]) => (
          <div key={action} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b py-1.5 last:border-b-0" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}>
            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>{action}</span>
            <kbd className="rounded border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[8px]" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              {shortcut}
            </kbd>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1.5" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
        <Eye size={11} />
        <span className="text-[9px]">Ces raccourcis sont actifs dans l'éditeur</span>
      </div>
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

function ClearConversationsCard() {
  const [clearing, setClearing] = useState(false);
  const [confirmOpen, setConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; message: string } | null>(null);

  const handleClear = async () => {
    setClearing(true);
    setResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/conversations/all', { method: 'DELETE' });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'success') {
        setResult({ type: 'success', message: `${data.deleted} conversation(s) supprimée(s)` });
      } else {
        setResult({ type: 'error', message: data.error || 'Erreur inconnue' });
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setResult({ type: 'error', message: e.message || 'Erreur réseau' });
    } finally {
      setClearing(false);
      setConfirmOpen(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <SectionCard icon={Database} title="Stockage" description="Gérez les données stockées dans Supabase">
      <p className="mb-3 text-[10px] leading-relaxed" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
        La suppression est irréversible : toutes les conversations et messages seront définitivement effacés.
      </p>
      {!confirmOpen ? (
        <button onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(true)}
          className="w-full rounded-md border px-3 py-2 text-[10px] font-medium transition hover:opacity-80"
          style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)', color: '#f87171' }}
        >
          Vider l'historique des conversations
        </button>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: '#f87171' }}>Confirmer la suppression définitive ?</p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button onClick={handleClear} disabled={clearing}
              className="flex-1 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium text-white transition hover:opacity-80 disabled:opacity-50"
              style={{ backgroundColor: '#ef4444' }}
            >
              {clearing ? 'Suppression…' : 'Confirmer'}
            </button>
            <button onClick={() => setConfirmOpen(false)} disabled={clearing}
              className="flex-1 rounded-md border px-2 py-1.5 text-[10px] font-medium transition hover:opacity-80 disabled:opacity-50"
              style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}
            >
              Annuler
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {result && (
        <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: result.type === 'success' ? '#4ade80' : '#f87171' }}>
          {result.message}
        </p>
      )}
    </SectionCard>
  );
}

// ─── Composants auxiliaires ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SectionCard({ icon: Icon, title, description, children }: { icon: typeof Palette; title: string; description: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="rounded-xl border p-4 shadow-sm" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary, var(--bg-panel))' }}>
      <div className="mb-3 flex items-start gap-2.5">
        <div className="flex h-7 w-7 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-subtle)' }}>
          <Icon size={14} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <h4 className="text-[12px] font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>{title}</h4>
          <p className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{description}</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">{children}</div>
    </section>
  );
}

function SettingRow({ label, description, children }: { label: string; description: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b py-2 last:border-b-0" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}>
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        <p className="text-[11px] font-medium truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>{label}</p>
        <p className="text-[9px] truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{description}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex-shrink-0">{children}</div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import type { SlashCommandSuggestion } from '../../hooks/useSlashCommand';

interface SlashCommandDropdownProps {
  suggestions: SlashCommandSuggestion[];
  selectedIndex: number;
  onSelect: (suggestion: SlashCommandSuggestion) => void;
  onHover: (index: number) => void;
  query: string;
}

/**
 * Dropdown autocomplete pour les commandes /skill dans le chat.
 */
export function SlashCommandDropdown({ suggestions, selectedIndex, onSelect, onHover, query }: SlashCommandDropdownProps) {
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Scroll selected item into view
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = listRef.current?.children[selectedIndex + 1] as HTMLElement | undefined; // +1 for header
    el?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' });
  }, [selectedIndex]);

  if (suggestions.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div
      ref={listRef}
      className="absolute bottom-full left-0 right-0 mb-1 rounded-lg overflow-hidden z-50 max-h-[220px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-ctrl)',
        border: '1px solid var(--border-strong)',
        boxShadow: 'var(--shadow-lg)',
      }}
    >
      {/* Header */}
      <div
        className="px-3 py-1.5 text-[9px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5"
        style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}
      >
        <Zap size={9} />
        Skills disponibles
      </div>

      {suggestions.map((item, index) => (
        <button
          key={item.name}
          onClick={() => onSelect(item)}
          onMouseEnter={() => onHover(index)}
          className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2 text-left transition-colors"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: index === selectedIndex ? 'var(--accent-subtle)' : 'transparent',
          }}
        >
          <div
            className="w-5 h-5 rounded flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: index === selectedIndex ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--bg-input)',
              border: '1px solid var(--border-base)',
            }}
          >
            <span
              className="text-[10px] font-bold"
              style={{ color: index === selectedIndex ? '#fff' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}
            >
              /
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <span className="text-[11px] font-medium block truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              <HighlightMatch text={item.name} query={query} />
            </span>
            <span className="text-[9px] block truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
              {item.description}
            </span>
          </div>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Highlight the matching portion of a name */
function HighlightMatch({ text, query }: { text: string; query: string }) {
  if (!query) return <>{text}</>;
  const lower = text.toLowerCase();
  const idx = lower.indexOf(query.toLowerCase());
  if (idx === -1) return <>{text}</>;

  return (
    <>
      {text.slice(0, idx)}
      <span style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)', fontWeight: 600 }}>
        {text.slice(idx, idx + query.length)}
      </span>
      {text.slice(idx + query.length)}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  onToggleMcp?: () => void;
  onToggleSandbox?: () => void;
}

// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function getModifierKey(): string {
  return navigator.platform.includes('Mac') ? '⌘' : 'Ctrl';
}

// ── StatusBar Component ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const StatusBar = memo(function StatusBar({
  filePath,
  line,
  column,
  dirty,
  encoding = 'UTF-8',
  assistantBusy,
  onToggleMcp,
  onToggleSandbox,
}: StatusBarProps) {
  const { tokenUsage, promptContext } = useLiveAPIContext();
  const { profile } = useProfile();


  const [showDetailModal, setShowDetailModal] = useState(false);
  const [showResetConfirm, setShowResetConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [resetCode, setResetCode] = useState('');
  const resetInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  const [gitBranch, setGitBranch] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showBranchPicker, setShowBranchPicker] = useState(false);
  const [branches, setBranches] = useState<Array<{ name: string; current: boolean }>>([]);
  const [branchLoading, setBranchLoading] = useState(false);
  const [branchSwitching, setBranchSwitching] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  const [mcpStatus, setMcpStatus] = useState<'ok' | 'error' | 'loading'>('loading');
  const [buildStatus, setBuildStatus] = useState<'idle' | 'pass' | 'fail' | 'running'>('idle');
  const [sandboxActive, setSandboxActive] = useState(false);

  const modifierKey = getModifierKey();
  const buildStatusLabel =
    buildStatus === 'running' ? 'Build en cours' :
    buildStatus === 'pass' ? 'Build OK' :
    buildStatus === 'fail' ? 'Build échoué' :
    'Build';
  const chipBase = 'inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold transition duration-200';
  const buildClasses =
    buildStatus === 'pass' ? `${chipBase} bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 shadow-sm` :
    buildStatus === 'fail' ? `${chipBase} bg-error-50 border border-error-200 text-error shadow-sm` :
    buildStatus === 'running' ? `${chipBase} bg-sky-50 border border-sky-200 text-sky-700 shadow-sm` :
    `${chipBase} bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] border border-[var(--border-base)] text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:bg-gray-200/40`;
  const sandboxLabel = sandboxActive ? 'Sandbox actif' : 'Sandbox inactif';
  const sandboxClasses = sandboxActive
    ? `${chipBase} bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 shadow-sm`
    : `${chipBase} bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] border border-[var(--border-base)] text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:bg-gray-200/40`;
  const busyChipClasses = `${chipBase} bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-700 shadow-sm`;
  const fileStateChipClasses = `${chipBase} bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] border border-[var(--border-base)] text-[var(--text-muted)] hover:bg-gray-200/40`;

  // ── Git ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const fetchBranch = async () => {
      try {
        const token = localStorage.getItem('jarvis_api_token');
        const headers: Record<string, string> = token ? { 'x-jarvis-token': token } : {};
        const res = await fetch('/api/git/status', { headers });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!cancelled && data.status === 'success' && data.branch) {
          setGitBranch(data.branch);
        }
      } catch {
        /* silent */
      }
    };
    fetchBranch();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchBranch, 15000);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, []);

  const loadBranches = useCallback(async () => {
    setBranchLoading(true);
    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('jarvis_api_token');
      const headers: Record<string, string> = token ? { 'x-jarvis-token': token } : {};
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/branches', { headers });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'success' && data.branches) {
        setBranches(data.branches);
      }
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    } finally {
      setBranchLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const switchBranch = useCallback(async (branchName: string) => {
    setBranchSwitching(branchName);
    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('jarvis_api_token');
      const headers: Record<string, string> = {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...(token ? { 'x-jarvis-token': token } : {}),
      };
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/switch', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ branch: branchName }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'success') {
        setGitBranch(branchName);
        setShowBranchPicker(false);
      }
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    } finally {
      setBranchSwitching(null);
    }
  }, []);

  // ── MCP ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const fetchMcp = async () => {
      try {
        const token = localStorage.getItem('jarvis_api_token');
        const headers: Record<string, string> = token ? { 'x-jarvis-token': token } : {};
        const res = await fetch('/api/mcp/status', { headers });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!cancelled) {
          setMcpStatus(data.status === 'success' ? 'ok' : 'error');
        }
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setMcpStatus('error');
      }
    };
    fetchMcp();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchMcp, 10000);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, []);

  // ── Build ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleBuildEvent(e: CustomEvent) {
      if (e.detail?.status) {
        setBuildStatus(e.detail.status);
      }
    }
    window.addEventListener('jarvis-build-status', handleBuildEvent as EventListener);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('jarvis-build-status', handleBuildEvent as EventListener);
    };
  }, []);

  // ── Sandbox ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const fetchSandbox = async () => {
      try {
        const token = localStorage.getItem('jarvis_api_token');
        const headers: Record<string, string> = token ? { 'x-jarvis-token': token } : {};
        const res = await fetch('/api/sandbox/status', { headers });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!cancelled && data.status === 'success') {
          setSandboxActive(data.sandbox?.active ?? false);
        }
      } catch {
        /* silent */
      }
    };
    fetchSandbox();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchSandbox, 5000);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, []);

  const handleConfirmReset = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('jarvis_api_token');
      const headers: Record<string, string> = {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...(token ? { 'x-jarvis-token': token } : {}),
      };
      const res = await fetch('/api/sandbox/reset', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ code: resetCode }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'success') {
        setShowResetConfirm(false);
        setResetCode('');
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('jarvis-sandbox-changed'));
      }
    } catch {
      /* silent */
    }
  }, [resetCode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!showResetConfirm) return;
    const handler = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setShowResetConfirm(false);
        setResetCode('');
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handler);
  }, [showResetConfirm]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (showResetConfirm) {
      resetInputRef.current?.focus();
    }
  }, [showResetConfirm]);

  // ── Render ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const { suggestion } = promptContext;

  return (
    <>
      <div
        className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 h-9 border-t select-none status-bar-enhanced"
        style={{
          borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
          backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)',
          boxShadow: '0 -2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)',
        }}
      >
        {/* Branch Section */}
        <div className="relative">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              if (!showBranchPicker) loadBranches();
              setShowBranchPicker((prev) => !prev);
            }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-medium transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-gray-200/60 active:scale-95"
            style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}
          >
            <GitFork size={10} strokeWidth={2} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
            <span className="truncate max-w-[120px]">{gitBranch || 'Chargement…'}</span>
          </button>

          {showBranchPicker && (
            <div
              className="absolute bottom-full left-0 mb-2 w-48 max-h-60 overflow-y-auto rounded-lg border shadow-lg z-50"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-ctrl)',
                borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
                boxShadow: '0 4px 12px var(--bg-shadow)',
              }}
            >
              {branchLoading ? (
                <div className="p-3 text-center text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] flex items-center gap-2 justify-center">
                  <LoaderCircle size={10} className="animate-spin" />
                  Chargement...
                </div>
              ) : branches.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-3 text-center text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Aucune branche.</div>
              ) : (
                branches.map((b) => (
                  <button
                    key={b.name}
                    onClick={() => switchBranch(b.name)}
                    disabled={b.current || branchSwitching === b.name}
                    className="flex items-center w-full px-3 py-1.5 text-left text-[10px] transition-colors hover:bg-gray-100/10 disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                    style={{ color: b.current ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-primary)' }}
                  >
                    {branchSwitching === b.name ? (
                      <LoaderCircle size={10} className="animate-spin mr-2" />
                    ) : (
                      <GitFork size={10} className="mr-2" style={{ opacity: b.current ? 1 : 0.4 }} />
                    )}
                    <span className="truncate">{b.name}</span>
                    {b.current && <span className="ml-auto w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[var(--accent-primary)]" />}
                  </button>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Sandbox Status */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => onToggleSandbox?.()}
          className={sandboxClasses}
          title={sandboxLabel}
        >
          <div className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full ${sandboxActive ? 'bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse' : 'bg-gray-400'}`} />
          <span>{sandboxLabel}</span>
        </button>

        {/* Build Status */}
        <div className={buildClasses} title={buildStatusLabel}>
          {buildStatus === 'running' ? (
            <LoaderCircle size={12} className="animate-spin text-sky-700" />
          ) : buildStatus === 'pass' ? (
            <CheckCircle size={12} className="text-emerald-700" />
          ) : buildStatus === 'fail' ? (
            <AlertCircle size={12} className="text-error" />
          ) : (
            <PackageSearch size={12} className="text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
          )}
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">{buildStatusLabel}</span>
        </div>

        {/* AI Model */}
        <div className={`${chipBase} bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] border border-[var(--border-base)] text-[var(--text-muted)]`}>
          <BrainCircuit size={12} className="text-[var(--text-muted)]" />
          <span className="font-medium">
            {profile.textProvider === 'openrouter' 
              ? profile.openrouterModel.split('/').pop() // Show only model name, not path
              : 'Gemini Live'}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* MCP & Token Section */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 ml-auto">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onToggleMcp}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 rounded-full border border-[var(--border-base)] bg-[var(--bg-secondary)] transition-colors hover:border-sky-300 hover:bg-sky-50"
            title={`MCP Status: ${mcpStatus}`}
          >
            <BrainCircuit size={14} style={{
              color: mcpStatus === 'ok' ? 'var(--color-success)' :
                     mcpStatus === 'error' ? 'var(--color-error)' : 'var(--text-muted)'
            }} />
          </button>

          <div
            onClick={() => setShowDetailModal(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-3 px-3 h-8 rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-gray-200/60"
            style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}
            title={`Tokens exacts : ${formatExactTokenCount(tokenUsage.totalTokens)} · Contexte : ${formatExactTokenCount(promptContext.currentSize)} / ${formatExactTokenCount(promptContext.maxSize)}`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 tabular-nums text-[10px] font-semibold">
              <Hash size={10} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
              {tokenUsage.totalTokens > 0 ? (
                <span>{formatTokenCount(tokenUsage.totalTokens)}</span>
              ) : (
                <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>—</span>
              )}
            </div>

            <div className="relative flex items-center gap-1 tabular-nums text-[10px] font-semibold">
              <FileText size={10} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
              <span>{formatTokenCount(promptContext.currentSize)} / {formatTokenCount(promptContext.maxSize)}</span>

              {suggestion && (
                <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-2 w-2">
                  <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-amber-400 opacity-75"></span>
                  <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-amber-500"></span>
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {assistantBusy && (
            <span className={busyChipClasses}>
              <LoaderCircle size={10} className="animate-spin text-amber-700" />
              <span>Traitement en cours…</span>
            </span>
          )}

          {filePath ? (
            <span className={fileStateChipClasses}>
              {dirty ? (
                <>
                  <LoaderCircle size={10} className="animate-spin text-amber-700" />
                  <span className="text-amber-700">Modifié</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <CheckCircle size={10} className="text-emerald-700" />
                  <span className="text-emerald-700">Sauvegardé</span>
                </>
              )}
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShowResetConfirm(true)}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-medium transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 ml-auto"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-warning-subtle, rgba(251,191,36,0.1))',
            border: '1px solid rgba(251,191,36,0.25)',
            color: 'var(--color-warning)',
          }}
          title="Réinitialiser le sandbox (copie fraîche du code source)"
        >
          <RefreshCcw size={9} strokeWidth={1.8} />
          <span className="hidden sm:inline">Réinitialiser</span>
        </button>

        {/* ─── ÉDITION ────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
          <button className="px-2 py-1 rounded-full hover:bg-gray-200/60 transition-colors" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}>{encoding}</button>
          <span>LF</span>
          {typeof line === 'number' && typeof column === 'number' && (
            <button
              onClick={() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'g', ...(navigator.platform.includes('Mac') ? { metaKey: true } : { ctrlKey: true }) }))}
              className="font-mono tabular-nums px-2 py-1 rounded-full transition-colors hover:bg-gray-200/60"
              style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}
              title="Aller à la ligne..."
            >
              Ln {line}, Col {column}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'p', ctrlKey: true }))}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-3 py-1 rounded-full font-mono text-[10px] transition-colors hover:bg-gray-200/60"
          style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}
        >
          <span className="opacity-60">{modifierKey}</span>
          <span className="font-semibold">P</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {showResetConfirm && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[100] flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/40"
          onClick={() => {
            setShowResetConfirm(false);
            setResetCode('');
          }}
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          aria-labelledby="reset-confirm-title"
        >
          <div
            className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl border shadow-2xl transition-all duration-300"
            style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-panel)', borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 px-5 py-4 border-b" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(251,146,60,0.12)' }}>
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
                </div>
                <div className="text-left">
                  <h3 id="reset-confirm-title" className="text-sm font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                    Confirmer la réinitialisation
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                    Supprimez toutes les modifications en cours et restaurez l'état d'origine.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => { setShowResetConfirm(false); setResetCode(''); }}
                className="p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition"
                style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}
                aria-label="Fermer"
              >
                <X size={14} />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="p-5 space-y-4">
              <p className="text-xs leading-relaxed" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                Entrez le code de confirmation pour valider la réinitialisation du sandbox.
              </p>
              <input
                ref={resetInputRef}
                type="text"
                maxLength={6}
                onChange={(e) => setResetCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6))}
                onKeyDown={(e: any) => {
                  if (e.key === 'Enter' && resetCode.length === 6) handleConfirmReset();
                  if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                    setShowResetConfirm(false);
                    setResetCode('');
                  }
                }}
                value={resetCode}
                className="w-full rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-center text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.45em] outline-none transition-colors"
                style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}
                placeholder="000000"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 px-5 py-4 border-t" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => { setShowResetConfirm(false); setResetCode(''); }}
                className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition hover:bg-white/10"
                style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}
              >
                Annuler
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleConfirmReset}
                disabled={resetCode.length !== 6}
                className="rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--color-warning)', color: '#ffffff' }}
              >
                Réinitialiser
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {showDetailModal && <TokenDetailModal onClose={() => setShowDetailModal(false)} />}
    </>
  );
});
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { X, BrainCircuit, GitBranch, FolderOpen, MessageSquare } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';

interface SystemModalProps {
  onClose: () => void;
  connected: boolean;
  profile: any;
  gitInfo: { branch: string; summary: string } | null;
  workspace: { path: string; exists: boolean } | null;
}

export function SystemModal({ onClose, connected, profile, gitInfo, workspace }: SystemModalProps) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center"
      initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm" />
      <motion.div
        className="relative w-full max-w-md max-h-[80vh] overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col"
        style={{ background: 'var(--bg-secondary)', border: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}
        initial={{ scale: 0.9, y: 20 }}
        animate={{ scale: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ scale: 0.9, y: 20 }}
        onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 border-b" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(74,222,128,0.12)' }}>
              <BrainCircuit className="w-5 h-5" style={{ color: '#4ade80' }} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>Statut système</h2>
              <p className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>État des services Jarvis</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-4 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', border: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: connected ? '#4ade80' : '#fbbf24' }} />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>IA ({profile.aiName || 'Leanna'})</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-medium" style={{ color: connected ? '#4ade80' : '#fbbf24' }}>
              {connected ? 'Connectée' : 'Déconnectée'}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', border: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: '#a855f7' }} />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>Fournisseur</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              {profile.textProvider === 'openrouter' ? profile.openrouterModel?.split('/').pop() || 'OpenRouter' : 'Gemini 2.0'}
            </span>
          </div>
          {gitInfo && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', border: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <GitBranch size={12} style={{ color: '#f472b6' }} />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>Git</span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono block" style={{ color: '#f472b6' }}>{gitInfo.branch}</span>
                <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{gitInfo.summary}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {workspace && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', border: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <FolderOpen size={12} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>Workspace</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono truncate max-w-[180px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
                {workspace.path.split(/[/\\]/).pop()}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', border: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <MessageSquare size={12} style={{ color: '#0ea5e9' }} />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>Voix</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{profile.aiVoice || 'Aoede'}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 rounded-xl" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', border: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: '#06b6d4' }} />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>Langue</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{profile.language === 'fr' ? 'Français' : profile.language === 'en' ? 'English' : profile.language}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, {
  forwardRef,
  useEffect,
  useImperativeHandle,
  useRef,
} from 'react';
import { Terminal as XTerm } from '@xterm/xterm';
import { FitAddon } from '@xterm/addon-fit';
import '@xterm/xterm/css/xterm.css';

// ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface TerminalRef {
  sendCommand: (cmd: string) => void;
  clear: () => void;
  fit: () => void;
  focus: () => void;
}

interface TerminalProps {
  /** Callback appelé pour chaque chunk de sortie PTY brute (utile pour détecter des URLs) */
  onOutput?: (chunk: string) => void;
}

// ── Component ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const TerminalComponent = forwardRef<TerminalRef, TerminalProps>(
  ({ onOutput }, ref) => {
    const onOutputRef = useRef(onOutput);
    useEffect(() => { onOutputRef.current = onOutput; }, [onOutput]);
    const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const xtermRef     = useRef<XTerm | null>(null);
    const fitAddonRef  = useRef<FitAddon | null>(null);
    const wsRef        = useRef<WebSocket | null>(null);
    const reconnectRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
    const tries        = useRef(0);
    const MAX_TRIES    = 5;
    const unmounted    = useRef(false);
    const commandQueue = useRef<string[]>([]);

    // ── xterm init ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    useEffect(() => {
        unmounted.current = false;

        const term = new XTerm({
          theme: {
            background: '#0d0d0d',
            foreground: '#e5e5e5',
            cursor:     '#7dd3fc',
            selectionBackground: 'rgba(125,211,252,0.25)',
            black:   '#000000', red:     '#f87171',
            green:   '#4ade80', yellow:  '#fbbf24',
            blue:    '#60a5fa', magenta: '#c084fc',
            cyan:    '#22d3ee', white:   '#e5e5e5',
            brightBlack:   '#525252', brightRed:     '#fca5a5',
            brightGreen:   '#86efac', brightYellow:  '#fde68a',
            brightBlue:    '#93c5fd', brightMagenta: '#d8b4fe',
            brightCyan:    '#67e8f9', brightWhite:   '#f5f5f5',
          },
          fontFamily: '"Cascadia Code", "Fira Code", "JetBrains Mono", Consolas, monospace',
          fontSize: 13,
          lineHeight: 1.4,
          cursorBlink: true,
          cursorStyle: 'block',
          scrollback: 5000,
          convertEol: true,
        });

        const fitAddon = new FitAddon();
        term.loadAddon(fitAddon);
        xtermRef.current    = term;
        fitAddonRef.current = fitAddon;

        if (containerRef.current) {
          term.open(containerRef.current);
          setTimeout(() => {
            fitAddon.fit();
          }, 50);
        }

        // ── WebSocket connection ─────────────────────────────────────────────

        const connect = () => {
          if (unmounted.current || tries.current >= MAX_TRIES) return;

          const token = localStorage.getItem('jarvis_api_token');
          console.log("[Terminal Client] Connecting with token:", token ? `"${token.slice(0, 3)}..."` : "NO TOKEN");
          const wsUrl = `ws://${window.location.host}/terminal${token ? `?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}` : ''}`;
          console.log("[Terminal Client] WebSocket URL:", wsUrl);
          const ws = new WebSocket(wsUrl);
          wsRef.current = ws;

          ws.onopen = () => {
            if (unmounted.current) { 
              ws.close(); 
              return; 
            }
            tries.current = 0;
            // Send initial size
            const dims = fitAddon.proposeDimensions();
            if (dims) {
              ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'resize', cols: dims.cols, rows: dims.rows }));
            }
            term.writeln('\x1b[32m✓ Terminal connecté\x1b[0m');
            term.writeln(`\x1b[90mWorkspace: ${window.location.host}\x1b[0m`);
            term.writeln('');

            // Send any queued commands
            while (commandQueue.current.length > 0) {
              const cmd = commandQueue.current.shift();
              if (cmd) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'input', data: cmd }));
              }
            }
          };

          ws.onmessage = (ev) => {
            const text = typeof ev.data === 'string' ? ev.data : new TextDecoder().decode(ev.data);
            term.write(typeof ev.data === 'string' ? ev.data : new Uint8Array(ev.data));
            // Notify parent of raw output (strips ANSI escape codes for clean parsing)
            if (onOutputRef.current) {
              // Strip basic ANSI sequences so URL detection works on clean text
              const clean = text.replace(/\x1b\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]/g, '').replace(/\x1b\][^\x07]*\x07/g, '');
              onOutputRef.current(clean);
            }
          };

          ws.onerror = (event) => {
            // Don't log errors if we're already unmounting
            if (!unmounted.current) {
              console.error("[Terminal Client] WebSocket error event:", event);
              console.error("[Terminal Client] WebSocket readyState:", ws.readyState);
            }
          };

          ws.onclose = (event) => {
            console.log("[Terminal Client] WebSocket closed, code:", event.code, "reason:", event.reason, "clean:", event.wasClean);
            wsRef.current = null;
            if (unmounted.current) return;
            tries.current += 1;
            if (tries.current < MAX_TRIES) {
              term.writeln(`\r\n\x1b[33m⟳ Reconnexion (${tries.current}/${MAX_TRIES})...\x1b[0m`);
              reconnectRef.current = setTimeout(connect, 1500);
            } else {
              term.writeln('\r\n\x1b[31m✗ Terminal non disponible — serveur PTY introuvable.\x1b[0m');
              term.writeln('\x1b[90mUtilisez votre terminal système pour exécuter des commandes.\x1b[0m');
            }
          };
        };

        // Handle key events to ensure Ctrl+C is sent
      term.attachCustomKeyEventHandler((event: KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (event.ctrlKey && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'c') {
          // Check if there's a selection
          const hasSelection = term.hasSelection();
          if (hasSelection) {
            // If there's a selection, let the browser handle copy
            return true;
          } else {
            // No selection, send Ctrl+C (ASCII ETX character) to interrupt
            if (wsRef.current?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
              wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'input', data: '\x03' }));
            }
            event.preventDefault();
            return false;
          }
        }
        if (event.ctrlKey && event.key.toLowerCase() === 'v') {
          // Handle paste
          event.preventDefault();
          navigator.clipboard.readText().then(text => {
            if (wsRef.current?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
              wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'input', data: text }));
            }
          });
          return false;
        }
        return true; // Let XTerm handle other keys normally
      });

      // Key input → send to PTY
      term.onData((data) => {
        if (wsRef.current?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
          wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'input', data }));
        }
      });

        connect();

      // ── Resize observer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

      const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        try {
          fitAddon.fit();
          const dims = fitAddon.proposeDimensions();
          if (dims && wsRef.current?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
            wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'resize', cols: dims.cols, rows: dims.rows }));
          }
        } catch { /* ignore during teardown */ }
      });

      if (containerRef.current) ro.observe(containerRef.current);

      return () => {
        unmounted.current = true;
        ro.disconnect();
        if (reconnectRef.current) {
          clearTimeout(reconnectRef.current);
        }
        wsRef.current?.close();
        term.dispose();
        xtermRef.current    = null;
        fitAddonRef.current = null;
      };
    }, []);

    // ── Imperative API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
      sendCommand: (cmd: string) => {
        const fullCmd = cmd + '\r\n';
        const ws = wsRef.current;
        if (ws?.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'input', data: fullCmd }));
        } else {
          // Queue the command to send when connection is established
          commandQueue.current.push(fullCmd);
          xtermRef.current?.writeln(`\x1b[33m$ ${cmd}\x1b[0m`);
          xtermRef.current?.writeln('\x1b[90m⌛ Commande en file d\'attente, connexion en cours...\x1b[0m');
        }
      },
      clear: () => {
        xtermRef.current?.clear();
      },
      fit: () => {
        try { 
          fitAddonRef.current?.fit();
        } catch (err) { 
          console.error("[Terminal Client] fit() failed:", err); 
        }
      },
      focus: () => {
        xtermRef.current?.focus();
      }
    }));

    return (
      <div
        ref={containerRef}
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          height: '100%',
          backgroundColor: '#0d0d0d',
          overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
      />
    );
  }
);

TerminalComponent.displayName = 'TerminalComponent';
```
