```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { History, Search, Trash2, MessageSquare, ChevronLeft, RefreshCw, User, Cpu } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { Panel } from '../ui/Panel';
import { IconButton } from '../ui/IconButton';

// ── Types ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface Conversation {
  id: string;
  title: string | null;
  summary: string | null;
  started_at: string;
  ended_at: string | null;
  message_count: number;
}

interface ConversationMessage {
  id: string;
  conversation_id: string;
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
  content: string;
  created_at: string;
}

interface SearchResult {
  message_id: string;
  conversation_id: string;
  conversation_title: string | null;
  role: string;
  content: string;
  created_at: string;
  rank: number;
}

// ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function timeAgo(dateStr: string): string {
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const mins  = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
  const hours = Math.floor(diff / 3600000);
  const days  = Math.floor(diff / 86400000);
  if (days > 0)  return `Il y a ${days}j`;
  if (hours > 0) return `Il y a ${hours}h`;
  if (mins > 0)  return `Il y a ${mins}m`;
  return 'À l\'instant';
}

function formatDate(dateStr: string): string {
  return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', {
    day: 'numeric',
    month: 'short',
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
  });
}

// ── Component ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface ConversationHistoryPanelProps {
  onLoadConversation?: (messages: ConversationMessage[]) => void;
}

export const ConversationHistoryPanel = React.memo(function ConversationHistoryPanel({
  onLoadConversation,
}: ConversationHistoryPanelProps) {
  const [conversations, setConversations] = useState<Conversation[]>([]);
  const [selectedConversation, setSelectedConversation] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ConversationMessage[]>([]);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<SearchResult[]>([]);
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [view, setView] = useState<'list' | 'detail' | 'search'>('list');

  // ── Fetch conversations ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const fetchConversations = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/conversations?limit=30');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'success') {
        setConversations(data.conversations);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[History] Erreur chargement conversations:', e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // ── Fetch conversation messages ───────────────────────────────────────────
  const fetchMessages = useCallback(async (conversationId: string) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/conversations/${conversationId}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'success') {
        setMessages(data.messages);
        setSelectedConversation(conversationId);
        setView('detail');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[History] Erreur chargement messages:', e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  // ── Search ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleSearch = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!searchQuery.trim()) return;
    setIsSearching(true);
    setView('search');
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/conversations/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(searchQuery)}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'success') {
        setSearchResults(data.results);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[History] Erreur recherche:', e);
    } finally {
      setIsSearching(false);
    }
  }, [searchQuery]);

  // ── Delete conversation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const handleDelete = useCallback(async (conversationId: string, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/conversations/${conversationId}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      setConversations(prev => prev.filter(c => c.id !== conversationId));
      if (selectedConversation === conversationId) {
        setView('list');
        setSelectedConversation(null);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[History] Erreur suppression:', e);
    }
  }, [selectedConversation]);

  // ── Load on mount ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  useEffect(() => { fetchConversations(); }, [fetchConversations]);

  // ── Render list view ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const renderListView = () => (
    <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pr-1 custom-scrollbar">
      {/* Search bar */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 mb-3">
        <div className="relative flex-1">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3.5 h-3.5" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
          <input
            type="text"
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSearch()}
            placeholder="Rechercher dans l'historique..."
            className="w-full pl-8 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs border focus:outline-none focus:ring-1"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)',
              borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
              color: 'var(--text-primary)',
            }}
            aria-label="Rechercher dans l'historique des conversations"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Conversation list */}
      {conversations.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-12 gap-4 border-2 border-dashed rounded-2xl"
          style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}
        >
          <History className="w-10 h-10 animate-pulse" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
          <div className="text-center space-y-1">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              Aucun historique
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs max-w-[240px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              Les conversations seront sauvegardées automatiquement ici.
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
          {conversations.map((conv) => (
            <motion.button
              key={conv.id}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
              onClick={() => fetchMessages(conv.id)}
              className="w-full text-left p-3.5 rounded-xl border transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md group"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-panel)',
                borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
              }}
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-xs font-medium truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                    {conv.title || 'Conversation sans titre'}
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                      {timeAgo(conv.started_at)}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>•</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                      {conv.message_count} msg
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={(e) => handleDelete(conv.id, e)}
                  className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 p-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all hover:scale-110"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}
                  aria-label="Supprimer la conversation"
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </motion.button>
          ))}
        </AnimatePresence>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  // ── Render detail view ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const renderDetailView = () => (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {/* Back button */}
      <button
        onClick={() => { setView('list'); setSelectedConversation(null); }}
        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors hover:opacity-80"
        style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }}
      >
        <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        Retour
      </button>

      {/* Load into context button */}
      {onLoadConversation && messages.length > 0 && (
        <button
          onClick={() => onLoadConversation(messages)}
          className="w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium border transition-colors"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-subtle)',
            borderColor: 'var(--border-focus)',
            color: 'var(--accent-primary)',
          }}
        >
          Reprendre cette conversation
        </button>
      )}

      {/* Messages */}
      <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto space-y-1 pr-1 custom-scrollbar">
        {messages.map((msg, index) => {
          const isAssistant = msg.role === 'assistant';
          const isConsecutive = index > 0 && messages[index - 1].role === msg.role;

          return (
            <div
              key={msg.id}
              className={`flex gap-2 ${isAssistant ? 'flex-row' : 'flex-row-reverse'} ${isConsecutive ? 'mt-0.5' : 'mt-2.5'}`}
            >
              {!isConsecutive ? (
                <div
                  className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center mt-0.5"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: isAssistant ? 'var(--accent-subtle)' : 'var(--bg-secondary)',
                    border: `1px solid ${isAssistant ? 'var(--border-focus)' : 'var(--border-base)'}`,
                  }}
                >
                  {isAssistant
                    ? <Cpu className="w-2.5 h-2.5" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
                    : <User className="w-2.5 h-2.5" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
                  }
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="w-5 flex-shrink-0" />
              )}
              <div className={`flex flex-col gap-0.5 max-w-[80%] ${isAssistant ? 'items-start' : 'items-end'}`}>
                {!isConsecutive && (
                  <span className="text-[8px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider px-0.5 mb-0.5" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                    {isAssistant ? 'Jarvis' : 'Vous'}
                  </span>
                )}
                <div
                  className="px-3 py-2 text-[11px] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap"
                  style={{
                    backgroundColor: isAssistant ? 'var(--bg-secondary)' : 'var(--accent-subtle)',
                    border: `1px solid ${isAssistant ? 'var(--border-base)' : 'var(--border-focus)'}`,
                    color: isAssistant ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--accent-primary)',
                    borderRadius: isAssistant
                      ? (isConsecutive ? '10px 14px 14px 10px' : '4px 14px 14px 10px')
                      : (isConsecutive ? '14px 10px 10px 14px' : '14px 4px 10px 14px'),
                  }}
                >
                  {msg.content}
                </div>
                {!isConsecutive && (
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-mono px-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                    {formatDate(msg.created_at)}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  // ── Render search results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const renderSearchView = () => (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <button
        onClick={() => { setView('list'); setSearchResults([]); setSearchQuery(''); }}
        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors hover:opacity-80"
        style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }}
      >
        <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        Retour
      </button>

      <p className="text-[10px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
        {searchResults.length} résultat{searchResults.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} pour "{searchQuery}"
      </p>

      <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 pr-1 custom-scrollbar">
        {searchResults.length === 0 && !isSearching ? (
          <p className="text-xs text-center py-6" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            Aucun résultat trouvé.
          </p>
        ) : (
          searchResults.map((result) => (
            <button
              key={result.message_id}
              onClick={() => fetchMessages(result.conversation_id)}
              className="w-full text-left p-3 rounded-xl border transition-all hover:shadow-sm"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-panel)',
                borderColor: 'var(--border-base)',
              }}
            >
              <p className="text-[10px] font-medium truncate mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }}>
                {result.conversation_title || 'Conversation sans titre'}
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                {result.content}
              </p>
              <span className="text-[9px] font-mono mt-1 block" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                {formatDate(result.created_at)} • {result.role}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <Panel
      title="Historique"
      icon={<History className="w-4 h-4" />}
      actions={
        <IconButton
          variant="default"
          icon={<RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
          onClick={fetchConversations}
          tooltip="Rafraîchir"
          aria-label="Rafraîchir l'historique"
          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg"
        />
      }
    >
      {loading && view === 'list' ? (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-8">
          <RefreshCw className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <>
          {view === 'list' && renderListView()}
          {view === 'detail' && renderDetailView()}
          {view === 'search' && renderSearchView()}
        </>
      )}
    </Panel>
  );
});
```

`src\components\panels\GitPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
import React, { useState, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  GitBranch, GitCommit, GitMerge, Plus, Minus, Check,
  RefreshCw, Upload, Download, ChevronDown, ChevronRight,
  FileText, FilePlus, FileX, Loader2, Eye,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Panel } from '../ui/Panel';
import { IconButton } from '../ui/IconButton';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface GitFile {
  indexStatus: string;
  workTreeStatus: string;
  path: string;
}

interface GitCommitEntry {
  hash: string;
  shortHash: string;
  author: string;
  date: string;
  message: string;
}

interface GitBranchEntry {
  name: string;
  current: boolean;
}

type Tab = 'changes' | 'branches' | 'log';

// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function statusIcon(indexStatus: string, workTreeStatus: string) {
  if (indexStatus === '?' || workTreeStatus === '?') return <FilePlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" />;
  if (indexStatus === 'D' || workTreeStatus === 'D') return <FileX className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-400" />;
  if (indexStatus === 'A') return <FilePlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-400" />;
  return <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />;
}

function statusLabel(indexStatus: string, workTreeStatus: string): string {
  if (indexStatus === '?' || workTreeStatus === '?') return 'U';
  if (indexStatus === 'A') return 'A';
  if (indexStatus === 'D' || workTreeStatus === 'D') return 'D';
  if (indexStatus === 'R') return 'R';
  return 'M';
}

// ─── Component ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface GitPanelProps {
  onViewDiff?: (file: string, staged: boolean) => void;
}

export function GitPanel({ onViewDiff }: GitPanelProps) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('changes');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Changes state
  const [branch, setBranch] = useState('');
  const [stagedFiles, setStagedFiles] = useState<GitFile[]>([]);
  const [unstagedFiles, setUnstagedFiles] = useState<GitFile[]>([]);
  const [untrackedFiles, setUntrackedFiles] = useState<GitFile[]>([]);
  const [commitMessage, setCommitMessage] = useState('');
  const [showStaged, setShowStaged] = useState(true);
  const [showUnstaged, setShowUnstaged] = useState(true);

  // Branches state
  const [branches, setBranches] = useState<GitBranchEntry[]>([]);
  const [newBranchName, setNewBranchName] = useState('');

  // Log state
  const [commits, setCommits] = useState<GitCommitEntry[]>([]);

  // Diff state
  const [diffContent, setDiffContent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [diffFile, setDiffFile] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // ─── API calls ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const fetchStatus = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/status');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) { setError(data.error); return; }
      setBranch(data.branch || '');
      const files: GitFile[] = data.files || [];
      setStagedFiles(files.filter(f => f.indexStatus !== ' ' && f.indexStatus !== '?'));
      setUnstagedFiles(files.filter(f => f.workTreeStatus !== ' ' && f.indexStatus !== '?' && f.workTreeStatus !== '?'));
      setUntrackedFiles(files.filter(f => f.indexStatus === '?'));
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message || 'Erreur de connexion');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const fetchBranches = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/branches');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) { setError(data.error); return; }
      setBranches(data.branches || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const fetchLog = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/log');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) { setError(data.error); return; }
      setCommits(data.commits || []);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const stageFile = useCallback(async (filePath: string) => {
    await fetch('/api/git/stage', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ files: [filePath] }),
    });
    fetchStatus();
  }, [fetchStatus]);

  const unstageFile = useCallback(async (filePath: string) => {
    await fetch('/api/git/unstage', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ files: [filePath] }),
    });
    fetchStatus();
  }, [fetchStatus]);

  const stageAll = useCallback(async () => {
    await fetch('/api/git/stage', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ files: ['.'] }),
    });
    fetchStatus();
  }, [fetchStatus]);

  const handleCommit = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!commitMessage.trim()) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/commit', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ message: commitMessage.trim() }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) { setError(data.error); return; }
      setCommitMessage('');
      fetchStatus();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [commitMessage, fetchStatus]);

  const handlePush = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/push', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({}) });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) setError(data.error);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const handlePull = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/pull', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({}) });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) setError(data.error);
      else fetchStatus();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [fetchStatus]);

  const handleSwitchBranch = useCallback(async (branchName: string) => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/switch', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ branch: branchName }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) setError(data.error);
      else { fetchBranches(); fetchStatus(); }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [fetchBranches, fetchStatus]);

  const handleCreateBranch = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!newBranchName.trim()) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/git/switch', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ branch: newBranchName.trim(), create: true }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.error) setError(data.error);
      else { setNewBranchName(''); fetchBranches(); fetchStatus(); }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [newBranchName, fetchBranches, fetchStatus]);

  const viewDiff = useCallback(async (file: string, staged: boolean) => {
    if (onViewDiff) { onViewDiff(file, staged); return; }
    try {
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ file, staged: String(staged) });
      const res = await fetch(`/api/git/diff?${params}`);
      const data = await res.json();
      setDiffContent(data.diff || 'Aucune modification.');
      setDiffFile(file);
    } catch { setDiffContent(null); }
  }, [onViewDiff]);

  // ─── Auto-refresh on mount and tab change ────────────────────────────────

  useEffect(() => { fetchStatus(); }, [fetchStatus]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab === 'branches') fetchBranches();
    if (tab === 'log') fetchLog();
  }, [tab, fetchBranches, fetchLog]);

  // ─── Render ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  const renderFileList = (files: GitFile[], label: string, isStaged: boolean, show: boolean, onToggle: () => void) => (
    <div className="mb-2">
      <button
        onClick={onToggle}
        className="flex items-center gap-1 w-full text-left px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
      >
        {show ? <ChevronDown className="w-3 h-3" /> : <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" />}
        <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
          {label}
        </span>
        <span className="text-[10px] ml-auto px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)', color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
          {files.length}
        </span>
      </button>
      <AnimatePresence>
        {show && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}
            className="overflow-hidden"
          >
            {files.map((file) => (
              <div
                key={file.path}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1 rounded hover:bg-white/5 group transition-colors"
              >
                {statusIcon(file.indexStatus, file.workTreeStatus)}
                <span className="text-[11px] truncate flex-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  {file.path}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-mono px-1 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)', color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                  {statusLabel(file.indexStatus, file.workTreeStatus)}
                </span>
                <div className="hidden group-hover:flex items-center gap-0.5">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => viewDiff(file.path, isStaged)}
                    className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-white/10"
                    title="Voir le diff"
                  >
                    <Eye className="w-3 h-3" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
                  </button>
                  {isStaged ? (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => unstageFile(file.path)}
                      className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-white/10"
                      title="Retirer du staging"
                    >
                      <Minus className="w-3 h-3 text-red-400" />
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => stageFile(file.path)}
                      className="p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-white/10"
                      title="Ajouter au staging"
                    >
                      <Plus className="w-3 h-3 text-green-400" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <Panel
      title="Git"
      icon={<GitBranch className="w-4 h-4" />}
      actions={
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <IconButton
            icon={loading ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
            onClick={fetchStatus}
            tooltip="Rafraîchir"
            variant="default"
            disabled={loading}
          />
          <IconButton icon={<Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />} onClick={handlePull} tooltip="Pull" variant="default" disabled={loading} />
          <IconButton icon={<Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />} onClick={handlePush} tooltip="Push" variant="default" disabled={loading} />
        </div>
      }
    >
      {/* Branch badge */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
        <GitBranch className="w-3.5 h-3.5" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
        <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }}>
          {branch || '...'}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Error display */}
      {error && (
        <div className="mb-3 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-[11px]" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(239,68,68,0.1)', color: '#f87171', border: '1px solid rgba(239,68,68,0.2)' }}>
          {error}
          <button onClick={() => setError(null)} className="ml-2 underline">×</button>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="flex gap-0.5 mb-3 p-0.5 rounded-lg" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' }}>
        {([
          { key: 'changes', label: 'Changements', icon: <FileText className="w-3 h-3" /> },
          { key: 'branches', label: 'Branches', icon: <GitMerge className="w-3 h-3" /> },
          { key: 'log', label: 'Historique', icon: <GitCommit className="w-3 h-3" /> },
        ] as { key: Tab; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode }[]).map(({ key, label, icon }) => (
          <button
            key={key}
            onClick={() => setTab(key)}
            className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-semibold transition-all"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: tab === key ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)' : 'transparent',
              color: tab === key ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--text-dimmed)',
            }}
          >
            {icon} {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* ─── Changes Tab ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {tab === 'changes' && (
        <div className="max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
          {renderFileList(stagedFiles, 'Staged', true, showStaged, () => setShowStaged(v => !v))}
          {renderFileList([...unstagedFiles, ...untrackedFiles], 'Modifications', false, showUnstaged, () => setShowUnstaged(v => !v))}

          {stagedFiles.length === 0 && unstagedFiles.length === 0 && untrackedFiles.length === 0 && !loading && (
            <div className="text-center py-6">
              <Check className="w-6 h-6 mx-auto mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
              <p className="text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>Aucune modification</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Stage all + Commit area */}
          {(unstagedFiles.length > 0 || untrackedFiles.length > 0) && (
            <button
              onClick={stageAll}
              className="w-full mt-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold transition-colors hover:bg-white/10"
              style={{ border: '1px solid var(--border-base)', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}
            >
              <Plus className="w-3 h-3 inline mr-1" /> Tout stager
            </button>
          )}

          {stagedFiles.length > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-3 pt-3" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
              <textarea
                value={commitMessage}
                onChange={(e) => setCommitMessage(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Message du commit..."
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-[11px] resize-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-1"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
                  border: '1px solid var(--border-base)',
                  color: 'var(--text-primary)',
                  minHeight: '3rem',
                }}
                rows={2}
              />
              <button
                onClick={handleCommit}
                disabled={!commitMessage.trim() || loading}
                className="w-full mt-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold transition-all disabled:opacity-40"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-primary)',
                  color: '#fff',
                }}
              >
                <GitCommit className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1" />
                Commit ({stagedFiles.length} fichier{stagedFiles.length > 1 ? 's' : ''})
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── Branches Tab ────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {tab === 'branches' && (
        <div className="max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
          {/* Create branch */}
          <div className="flex gap-1 mb-3">
            <input
              value={newBranchName}
              onChange={(e) => setNewBranchName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Nouvelle branche..."
              className="flex-1 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] focus:outline-none focus:ring-1"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
                border: '1px solid var(--border-base)',
                color: 'var(--text-primary)',
              }}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleCreateBranch()}
            />
            <button
              onClick={handleCreateBranch}
              disabled={!newBranchName.trim()}
              className="px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-semibold transition-colors disabled:opacity-40"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--accent-primary)', color: '#fff' }}
            >
              <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Branch list */}
          {branches.filter(b => !b.name.startsWith('remotes/')).map((b) => (
            <button
              key={b.name}
              onClick={() => !b.current && handleSwitchBranch(b.name)}
              disabled={b.current}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-left transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 disabled:opacity-70"
            >
              <GitBranch className="w-3 h-3" style={{ color: b.current ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
              <span className="text-[11px] flex-1 truncate" style={{ color: b.current ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                {b.name}
              </span>
              {b.current && (
                <span className="text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-semibold" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(14,165,233,0.15)', color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }}>
                  actuelle
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}

          {/* Remote branches */}
          {branches.filter(b => b.name.startsWith('remotes/')).length > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-3 pt-2" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider px-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>Remotes</span>
              {branches.filter(b => b.name.startsWith('remotes/')).map((b) => (
                <button
                  key={b.name}
                  onClick={() => handleSwitchBranch(b.name.replace(/^remotes\/origin\//, ''))}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full px-3 py-1 rounded text-left hover:bg-white/5"
                >
                  <GitBranch className="w-3 h-3" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
                  <span className="text-[10px] truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{b.name}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── Log Tab ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      {tab === 'log' && (
        <div className="max-h-[400px] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
          {commits.map((c) => (
            <div
              key={c.hash}
              className="flex items-start gap-2 px-2 py-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
            >
              <GitCommit className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p className="text-[11px] font-medium truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
                  {c.message}
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                    {c.shortHash}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                    {c.author}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                    {c.date}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
          {commits.length === 0 && !loading && (
            <p className="text-center text-[11px] py-4" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
              Aucun commit trouvé
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ─── Inline Diff Viewer ──────────────────────────────────────────── */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {diffContent && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            className="mt-3 overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="rounded-lg overflow-hidden" style={{ border: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-1.5" style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' }}>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>{diffFile}</span>
                <button onClick={() => { setDiffContent(null); setDiffFile(null); }} className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>×</button>
              </div>
              <pre className="px-3 py-2 text-[10px] font-mono overflow-x-auto max-h-48 custom-scrollbar" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)', backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)' }}>
                {diffContent.split('\n').map((line, i) => (
                  <div
                    key={i}
                    style={{
                      color: line.startsWith('+') ? '#4ade80' : line.startsWith('-') ? '#f87171' : line.startsWith('@@') ? '#60a5fa' : 'inherit',
                      backgroundColor: line.startsWith('+') ? 'rgba(74,222,128,0.06)' : line.startsWith('-') ? 'rgba(248,113,113,0.06)' : 'transparent',
                    }}
                  >
                    {line}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </pre>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </Panel>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Brain, RefreshCw, Database, FileCode, Network, Lightbulb,

} from 'lucide-react';
import { Panel } from '../ui/Panel';
import { IconButton } from '../ui/IconButton';

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Types (miroir de la réponse GET /api/knowledge/dashboard)
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface DashboardWorkspace {
  selfRoot: string;
  activeWorkspace: string;
  sandboxActive: boolean;
}

interface DashboardGraph {
  lastIndexed: string;
  totalFiles: number;
  totalLines: number;
  totalEntities: number;
  totalExports: number;
  totalImports: number;
  averageFileSize: number;
  filesByExtension: Record<string, number>;
  entitiesByType: Record<string, number>;
  structuralEntities?: {
    routes: number;
    databaseTables: number;
    environmentVariables: number;
    tests: number;
    symbols: number;
  };
  relations?: {
    total: number;
    byType: Record<string, number>;
  };
  topLargest: { path: string; lines: number; size: number; entities: number }[];
  topEntityDense: { path: string; entities: number; lines: number }[];
  topImpacted: { path: string; impacted: number }[];
  couplingRanking: { path: string; dependencies: number; dependents: number; totalEdges: number }[];
  cycleCount: number;
  cycles: { files: string[]; length: number }[];
}

interface DashboardMemory {
  totalFacts: number;
  factByCategory: Record<string, number>;
  topTags: { tag: string; count: number }[];
  topUsedFacts: ProjectFact[];
  recentFacts: ProjectFact[];
}

type ProjectFactCategory =
  | 'architecture' | 'convention' | 'pattern' | 'decision'
  | 'known-bug' | 'api' | 'module' | 'workflow' | 'security'
  | 'stack' | 'refactoring' | 'todo';

interface ProjectFact {
  id: string;

}

interface KnowledgeHealth {
  initialized: boolean;
  fileCount: number;
  entityCount: number;
  exportCount: number;
  importCount: number;
  cycleCount: number;
  factCount: number;
  criticalModuleCount: number;
  freshness: number;
  lastIndexed?: string;
  warnings: string[];
}

interface DetectedPattern {
  type: 'error_pattern' | 'success_pattern' | 'optimization' | 'decision';
  signature: string;
  occurrenceCount: number;
  relatedFiles: string[];
  aggregatedImportance: number;
  growthPct: number;
  isRecurring: boolean;
}

interface DashboardPatterns {
  errorPatterns: DetectedPattern[];
  successPatterns: DetectedPattern[];
  optimizations: DetectedPattern[];
  decisions: DetectedPattern[];
}

interface DashboardPayload {
  generatedAt: string;
  workspace: DashboardWorkspace;
  graph: DashboardGraph;
  memory: DashboardMemory;
  health: KnowledgeHealth;
  patterns: DashboardPatterns;
}

// ─── Types Relations & Watcher ──────────────────────────────────────────────

interface EntityRelation {
  source: { name: string; filePath: string; type: string };
  target: { name: string; filePath: string; type: string };
  relationType:
    | 'extends' | 'implements' | 'uses' | 'tests' | 'configures' | 'composes' | 'depends_on'
    | 'calls' | 'serves' | 'reads_env' | 'writes_table' | 'reads_table' | 'tested_by';
  confidence: number;
  sourceLine?: number;
}

type TabId = 'overview' | 'files' | 'memory' | 'health' | 'patterns' | 'relations';

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Helpers
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} o`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} Ko`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} Mo`;
}

function formatNumber(n: number): string {
  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return String(n);
}

function relativeTime(dateStr: string): string {
  if (!dateStr) return '—';
  const diff = Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime();
  const s = Math.floor(diff / 1000);
  if (s < 60) return `${s}s`;
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  if (m < 60) return `${m}min`;
  const h = Math.floor(m / 60);
  if (h < 24) return `${h}h`;
  const j = Math.floor(h / 24);
  return `${j}j`;
}

const CATEGORY_META: Record<string, { label: string; color: string; icon: React.ReactNode }> = {

  security:     { label: 'Sécurité',     color: '#ef4444', icon: <FileWarning size={10} /> },
  stack:        { label: 'Stack',        color: '#0ea5e9', icon: <Layers size={10} /> },
  refactoring:  { label: 'Refactorings', color: '#fb923c', icon: <BarChart3 size={10} /> },

};

const PATTERN_META: Record<string, { label: string; color: string }> = {

};

// Sous-composants légers
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function StatCard({
  label, value, sub, icon, color, progress, progressLabel,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  sub?: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  color: string;
  progress?: number;
  progressLabel?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className="rounded-2xl p-3.5 flex flex-col gap-2"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: `${color}0B`,
        border: `1px solid ${color}22`,
      }}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span
            className="w-7 h-7 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center"
            style={{ backgroundColor: `${color}1A`, color }}
          >
            {icon}
          </span>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
            {label}
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-2">
        <span className="text-xl font-bold leading-none" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
          {value}
        </span>
        {sub && <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{sub}</span>}
      </div>
      {typeof progress === 'number' && (
        <div className="space-y-1">
          <div className="h-1.5 w-full rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: `${color}15` }}>
            <div
              className="h-full rounded-full"
              style={{ width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, progress * 100))}%`, backgroundColor: color }}
            />
          </div>
          {progressLabel && (
            <div className="text-[9px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              {progressLabel}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function BarList<T extends { label: string; value: number; suffix?: string; hint?: string }>({
  items, color, maxItems = 10,
}: {
  items: T[];
  color: string;
  maxItems?: number;
}) {
  const sorted = [...items].sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value).slice(0, maxItems);
  const max = sorted[0]?.value || 1;
  if (sorted.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="py-8 text-center text-[11px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
        Aucune donnée disponible
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <ul className="space-y-1.5">
      {sorted.map((it, i) => (
        <li key={i} className="space-y-1">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10.5px] gap-2">
            <span
              className="font-mono truncate"
              style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)', maxWidth: '70%' }}
              title={it.label}
            >
              {it.label}
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              {it.value}
              {it.suffix && <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{it.suffix}</span>}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: `${color}12` }}>
            <div
              className="h-full rounded-full"
              style={{ width: `${(it.value / max) * 100}%`, backgroundColor: color }}
            />
          </div>
          {it.hint && (
            <div className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{it.hint}</div>
          )}
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

// Onglets
```
