`src\components\panels\MissionPanel.tsx`:

```tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import {
  Target, Loader2, CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertTriangle,
  ChevronRight, Brain, Zap, RotateCcw, Pause, Play,
  TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Minus, Clock, Layers,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Panel } from '../ui/Panel';
import { IconButton } from '../ui/IconButton';

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Types
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface MissionEvent {
  type: 'mission_event';
  event: string;
  missionId: string;
  title?: string;
  status?: string;
  goalId?: string;
  goalTitle?: string;
  actionId?: string;
  skill?: string;
  success?: boolean;
  confidence?: number;
  decision?: string;
  reason?: string;
  durationMs?: number;
  error?: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

interface MissionEntry {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'blocked';
  priority: string;
  goals: GoalEntry[];
  activeGoalId: string | null;
  confidence: number;
  metrics: {
    totalActions: number;
    successfulActions: number;
    failedActions: number;
  };
  createdAt: Date;
}

interface GoalEntry {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'blocked';
  actions: ActionEntry[];
}

interface ActionEntry {
  id: string;
  skill: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'failed';
  confidence?: number;
  decision?: string;
  durationMs?: number;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Helpers
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function confidenceColor(conf: number): string {
  if (conf >= 0.7) return '#4ade80';
  if (conf >= 0.4) return '#fbbf24';
  return '#f87171';
}

function confidenceIcon(conf: number) {
  if (conf >= 0.7) return <TrendingUp size={10} />;
  if (conf >= 0.4) return <Minus size={10} />;
  return <TrendingDown size={10} />;
}

function statusIcon(status: string, size = 10) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'in_progress': return <Loader2 size={size} className="animate-spin" style={{ color: '#38bdf8' }} />;
    case 'completed': return <CheckCircle2 size={size} style={{ color: '#4ade80' }} />;
    case 'failed': return <XCircle size={size} style={{ color: '#f87171' }} />;
    case 'blocked': return <AlertTriangle size={size} style={{ color: '#fbbf24' }} />;
    default: return <Clock size={size} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />;
  }
}

function decisionBadge(decision: string) {
  const config: Record<string, { color: string; label: string; icon: React.ReactNode }> = {
    continue: { color: '#4ade80', label: 'Continue', icon: <Play size={8} /> },
    retry: { color: '#fbbf24', label: 'Retry', icon: <RotateCcw size={8} /> },
    replan: { color: '#f97316', label: 'Replan', icon: <Brain size={8} /> },
    escalate: { color: '#f87171', label: 'Escalade', icon: <AlertTriangle size={8} /> },
    abort: { color: '#ef4444', label: 'Abort', icon: <XCircle size={8} /> },
  };
  const c = config[decision] ?? config.continue;
  return (
    <span
      className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[8px] font-bold uppercase"
      style={{ color: c.color, backgroundColor: `${c.color}15` }}
    >
      {c.icon} {c.label}
    </span>
  );
}

function formatDuration(ms?: number): string {
  if (!ms) return '';
  if (ms < 1000) return `${ms}ms`;
  return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Main Component
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

interface MissionPanelProps {
  inline?: boolean;
}

export function MissionPanel({ inline = false }: MissionPanelProps) {
  const [missions, setMissions] = useState<MissionEntry[]>([]);
  const [expandedMission, setExpandedMission] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedGoal, setExpandedGoal] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Listen for mission events
  useEffect(() => {
    const handler = (e: Event) => {
      const detail = (e as CustomEvent<MissionEvent>).detail;
      if (!detail || detail.type !== 'mission_event') return;

      setMissions(prev => {
        const existing = prev.find(m => m.id === detail.missionId);

        switch (detail.event) {
          case 'mission_started':
            if (existing) return prev;
            return [...prev, {
              id: detail.missionId,
              title: detail.title ?? 'Mission',
              status: 'in_progress',
              priority: 'medium',
              goals: [],
              activeGoalId: null,
              confidence: 0.5,
              metrics: { totalActions: 0, successfulActions: 0, failedActions: 0 },
              createdAt: new Date(detail.timestamp),
            }];

          case 'goal_started':
            return prev.map(m => {
              if (m.id !== detail.missionId) return m;
              const goalExists = m.goals.find(g => g.id === detail.goalId);
              if (goalExists) {
                return {
                  ...m,
                  activeGoalId: detail.goalId!,
                  goals: m.goals.map(g => g.id === detail.goalId ? { ...g, status: 'in_progress' as const } : g),
                };
              }
              return {
                ...m,
                activeGoalId: detail.goalId!,
                goals: [...m.goals, {
                  id: detail.goalId!,
                  title: detail.goalTitle ?? 'Objectif',
                  status: 'in_progress' as const,
                  actions: [],
                }],
              };
            });

          case 'action_started':
            return prev.map(m => {
              if (m.id !== detail.missionId) return m;
              return {
                ...m,
                goals: m.goals.map(g => {
                  if (g.id !== detail.goalId) return g;
                  return {
                    ...g,
                    actions: [...g.actions, {
                      id: detail.actionId!,
                      skill: detail.skill ?? '?',
                      status: 'in_progress' as const,
                    }],
                  };
                }),
              };
            });

          case 'action_completed':
            return prev.map(m => {
              if (m.id !== detail.missionId) return m;
              return {
                ...m,
                confidence: detail.confidence ?? m.confidence,
                metrics: {
                  totalActions: m.metrics.totalActions + 1,
                  successfulActions: m.metrics.successfulActions + (detail.success ? 1 : 0),
                  failedActions: m.metrics.failedActions + (detail.success ? 0 : 1),
                },
                goals: m.goals.map(g => {
                  if (g.id !== detail.goalId) return g;
                  return {
                    ...g,
                    actions: g.actions.map(a => {
                      if (a.id !== detail.actionId) return a;
                      return {
                        ...a,
                        status: detail.success ? 'completed' as const : 'failed' as const,
                        confidence: detail.confidence,
                        decision: detail.decision,
                        durationMs: detail.durationMs,
                      };
                    }),
                  };
                }),
              };
            });

          case 'goal_escalated':
            return prev.map(m => {
              if (m.id !== detail.missionId) return m;
              return {
                ...m,
                goals: m.goals.map(g => g.id === detail.goalId ? { ...g, status: 'blocked' as const } : g),
              };
            });

          case 'mission_completed':
            return prev.map(m => {
              if (m.id !== detail.missionId) return m;
              return { ...m, status: detail.success ? 'completed' as const : 'failed' as const };
            });

          case 'mission_cancelled':
            return prev.map(m => {
              if (m.id !== detail.missionId) return m;
              return { ...m, status: 'failed' as const };
            });

          default:
            return prev;
        }
      });
    };

    window.addEventListener('jarvis-mission-event', handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('jarvis-mission-event', handler);
  }, []);

  // Auto-expand first active mission
  useEffect(() => {
    const active = missions.find(m => m.status === 'in_progress');
    if (active && !expandedMission) {
      setExpandedMission(active.id);
    }
  }, [missions, expandedMission]);

  const activeMissions = missions.filter(m => m.status === 'in_progress' || m.status === 'blocked');
  const completedMissions = missions.filter(m => m.status === 'completed' || m.status === 'failed');

  const content = (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full">
      {/* Header stats */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 flex-shrink-0" style={{ borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-1">
          <StatChip count={activeMissions.length} label="actives" color="#38bdf8" />
          <StatChip count={completedMissions.filter(m => m.status === 'completed').length} label="ok" color="#4ade80" />
          <StatChip count={completedMissions.filter(m => m.status === 'failed').length} label="err" color="#f87171" />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mission list */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-2 py-2 space-y-2 custom-scrollbar">
        {missions.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyMissionState />
        ) : (
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {missions.map(mission => (
              <MissionCard
                key={mission.id}
                mission={mission}
                expanded={expandedMission === mission.id}
                expandedGoal={expandedGoal}
                onToggle={() => setExpandedMission(prev => prev === mission.id ? null : mission.id)}
                onToggleGoal={(goalId) => setExpandedGoal(prev => prev === goalId ? null : goalId)}
              />
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  if (inline) return content;

  return (
    <Panel
      title="Missions"
      icon={<Target className="w-4 h-4" />}
      actions={
        <span className="text-[9px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)', color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
          {activeMissions.length} actives
        </span>
      }
    >
      {content}
    </Panel>
  );
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Sub-components
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function StatChip({ count, label, color }: { count: number; label: string; color: string }) {
  return (
    <div
      className="flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[9px] font-mono"
      style={{ color, backgroundColor: `${color}12` }}
    >
      <span className="font-bold">{count}</span>
      <span className="opacity-70">{label}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function MissionCard({
  mission,
  expanded,
  expandedGoal,
  onToggle,
  onToggleGoal,
}: {
  mission: MissionEntry;
  expanded: boolean;
  expandedGoal: string | null;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onToggleGoal: (goalId: string) => void;
}) {
  const isActive = mission.status === 'in_progress';
  const confColor = confidenceColor(mission.confidence);
  const progress = mission.metrics.totalActions > 0
    ? Math.round((mission.metrics.successfulActions / mission.metrics.totalActions) * 100)
    : 0;

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
      className="rounded-xl overflow-hidden"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: isActive ? 'rgba(56,189,248,0.04)' : 'var(--bg-input)',
        border: `1px solid ${isActive ? 'rgba(56,189,248,0.2)' : 'var(--border-base)'}`,
      }}
    >
      {/* Mission header */}
      <button
        className="w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 text-left cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/5 transition"
        onClick={onToggle}
      >
        {/* Status icon */}
        <div className="flex-shrink-0">
          {statusIcon(mission.status, 14)}
        </div>

        {/* Info */}
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="text-[11px] font-semibold truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
            {mission.title}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
            {/* Progress bar */}
            <div className="flex-1 h-1 rounded-full overflow-hidden" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}>
              <motion.div
                className="h-full rounded-full"
                style={{ backgroundColor: confColor }}
                animate={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
                transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}
              />
            </div>
            {/* Confidence */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5" style={{ color: confColor }}>
              {confidenceIcon(mission.confidence)}
              <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold">
                {Math.round(mission.confidence * 100)}%
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <motion.div animate={{ rotate: expanded ? 90 : 0 }} className="flex-shrink-0">
          <ChevronRight size={12} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
        </motion.div>
      </button>

      {/* Expanded: Goal Stack */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {expanded && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.15 }}
            className="overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="px-3 pb-3 space-y-1.5" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
              {/* Metrics row */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 pt-2 pb-1">
                <span className="text-[9px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                  Actions: <span style={{ color: '#4ade80' }}>{mission.metrics.successfulActions}✓</span>
                  {' '}<span style={{ color: '#f87171' }}>{mission.metrics.failedActions}✗</span>
                  {' '}/ {mission.metrics.totalActions}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Goals */}
              {mission.goals.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-[9px] italic py-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                  Planification en cours...
                </div>
              ) : (
                mission.goals.map(goal => (
                  <GoalCard
                    key={goal.id}
                    goal={goal}
                    isActive={goal.id === mission.activeGoalId}
                    expanded={expandedGoal === goal.id}
                    onToggle={() => onToggleGoal(goal.id)}
                  />
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

function GoalCard({
  goal,
  isActive,
  expanded,
  onToggle,
}: {
  goal: GoalEntry;
  isActive: boolean;
  expanded: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className="rounded-lg overflow-hidden"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: isActive ? 'rgba(56,189,248,0.06)' : 'transparent',
        border: `1px solid ${isActive ? 'rgba(56,189,248,0.15)' : 'var(--border-base)'}`,
      }}
    >
      <button
        className="w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 text-left cursor-pointer hover:bg-white/5 transition"
        onClick={onToggle}
      >
        <div className="flex-shrink-0">{statusIcon(goal.status, 10)}</div>
        <span className="text-[10px] flex-1 truncate font-medium" style={{ color: isActive ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
          {goal.title}
        </span>
        {isActive && (
          <span className="text-[8px] px-1 py-0.5 rounded font-bold uppercase"
            style={{ color: '#38bdf8', backgroundColor: 'rgba(56,189,248,0.1)' }}>
            actif
          </span>
        )}
        <motion.div animate={{ rotate: expanded ? 90 : 0 }}>
          <ChevronRight size={9} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
        </motion.div>
      </button>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {expanded && goal.actions.length > 0 && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            className="overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="px-2 pb-2 space-y-0.5" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--border-base)' }}>
              {goal.actions.map(action => (
                <ActionRow key={action.id} action={action} />
              ))}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

function ActionRow({ action }: { action: ActionEntry }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-1.5 py-1 rounded hover:bg-white/5">
      <div className="flex-shrink-0">{statusIcon(action.status, 9)}</div>
      <Zap size={9} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} className="flex-shrink-0" />
      <span className="text-[9px] font-mono flex-1 truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
        {action.skill}
      </span>
      {action.durationMs && (
        <span className="text-[8px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
          {formatDuration(action.durationMs)}
        </span>
      )}
      {action.decision && decisionBadge(action.decision)}
      {action.confidence !== undefined && (
        <span className="text-[8px] font-mono" style={{ color: confidenceColor(action.confidence) }}>
          {Math.round(action.confidence * 100)}%
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function EmptyMissionState() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-10 gap-3">
      <div
        className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)' }}
      >
        <Target size={20} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
      </div>
      <div className="text-center px-4">
        <p className="text-[11px] font-medium" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
          Aucune mission active
        </p>
        <p className="text-[9px] mt-1 leading-relaxed" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
          Les missions se déclenchent pour les tâches complexes multi-étapes.
          L'IA décompose, planifie, exécute et vérifie automatiquement.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Gauge, AlertTriangle, AlertOctagon, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useLiveAPIContext } from '../../context/LiveAPIContext';
import type { PromptContextState } from '../../hooks/useToken';

function formatTokens(n: number): string {
  if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
  if (n >= 1_000) return `${(n / 1_000).toFixed(1)}k`;
  return n.toLocaleString();
}

const LEVEL_STYLES = {
  ok: {
    bar: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #10b981, #06b6d4)',
    bg: '#e6fffa', // Fond clair pour OK
    border: '#b2f2bb', // Bordure claire
    text: '#0ca678', // Texte vert plus sombre
    label: 'Normal',
  },
  warn: {
    bar: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #f59e0b, #fb923c)',
    bg: '#fff9db', // Fond clair pour Warn
    border: '#ffe066', // Bordure claire
    text: '#e67700', // Texte orange plus sombre
    label: 'Élevé',
  },
  critical: {
    bar: 'linear-gradient(90deg, #ef4444, #dc2626)',
    bg: '#fff5f5', // Fond clair pour Critical
    border: '#ffc9c9', // Bordure claire
    text: '#e03131', // Texte rouge plus sombre
    label: 'Critique',
  },
} as const;

interface PromptContextIndicatorProps {
  context: PromptContextState;
  connected?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Indicateur temps réel de l'utilisation de la fenêtre de contexte du prompt.
 */
export function PromptContextIndicator({ context, connected = false }: PromptContextIndicatorProps) {
  const styles = LEVEL_STYLES[context.level];
  const hasData = context.currentSize > 0 || connected;
  const { summarizeContext } = useLiveAPIContext();
  const [summarizing, setSummarizing] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div
      className="rounded-xl p-2.5"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: styles.bg,
        border: `1px solid ${styles.border}`,
      }}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-1.5">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
          <Gauge size={12} style={{ color: styles.text, flexShrink: 0 }} />
          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
            Contexte prompt
          </span>
          {connected && (
            <span
              className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-1.5 py-[1px] text-[8px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide"
              style={{ backgroundColor: styles.bg, color: styles.text }}
            >
              live
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <span className="text-[9px] font-bold tabular-nums flex-shrink-0" style={{ color: styles.text }}>
          {hasData ? `${context.percent}%` : '—'}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div
        className="h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden mb-1.5"
        style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.06)' }}
      >
        <div
          className="h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500"
          style={{
            width: `${Math.min(100, context.percent)}%`,
            background: styles.bar,
          }}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <span className="text-[9px] tabular-nums" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
          {hasData
            ? `${formatTokens(context.currentSize)} / ${formatTokens(context.maxSize)} tokens`
            : 'En attente de connexion…'}
        </span>
        {hasData && (
          <span className="text-[9px] font-medium" style={{ color: styles.text }}>
            {styles.label}
            {context.turns > 0 ? ` · ${context.turns} tour${context.turns > 1 ? 's' : ''}` : ''}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>

      {context.suggestion && context.level !== 'ok' && (
        <div
          className="flex items-start gap-1.5 mt-2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[9-xs]"
          style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.04)', color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}
        >
          {context.level === 'critical'
            ? <AlertOctagon size={10} className="flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" style={{ color: styles.text }} />
            : <AlertTriangle size={10} className="flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" style={{ color: styles.text }} />}
          <span>{context.suggestion}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Bouton de résumé automatique quand le contexte est élevé */}
      {context.level !== 'ok' && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={async () => {
            if (summarizing) return;
            setSummarizing(true);
            try {
              await summarizeContext(8);
            } finally {
              setSummarizing(false);
            }
          }}
          disabled={summarizing || !connected}
          className="w-full mt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-medium transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(14,165,233,0.08)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(14,165,233,0.2)',
            color: '#0e97a0',
          }}
        >
          {summarizing ? (
            <div className="w-3 h-3 border border-current border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Sparkles size={10} />
          )}
          {summarizing ? 'Résumé…' : 'Résumer le contexte'}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import {
  Box, RefreshCw, Upload, Trash2, Loader2, CheckCircle2,
  XCircle, FileText, Power, Lock, ShieldCheck, Radio,
  GitCompareArrows, FilePlus2, FileX2, FileCode2,
  AlertTriangle, AlertOctagon, Play, ChevronDown,
  Bot, RotateCcw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useSandboxWatcher } from '../../hooks/useSandboxWatcher';
import { SandboxDiffViewer } from '../sandbox/SandboxDiffViewer';
import { useLiveAPIContext } from '../../context/LiveAPIContext';
import { PromptContextIndicator } from './PromptContextIndicator';

interface SandboxStatus {
  active: boolean;
  path: string;
  modifiedFiles: string[];
  modifiedCount: number;
  lastSync: string | null;
  exists: boolean;
}

interface TscDiagnostic {
  file: string | null;
  line: number | null;
  column: number | null;
  code: string | null;
  severity: 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';
  message: string;
  raw: string;
}

interface ValidationState {
  loading: boolean;
  ran: boolean;
  valid: boolean;
  errorCount: number;
  warningCount: number;
  diagnostics: TscDiagnostic[];
  errorsByFile: Record<string, TscDiagnostic[]>;
  rawOutput: string;
}

function authHeaders(): Record<string, string> {
  const token = localStorage.getItem('jarvis_api_token');
  return token ? { 'x-jarvis-token': token } : {};
}

/**
 * SandboxPanel — Panneau de contrôle du workspace sandbox.
 * Design épuré, suivi d'état clair, tooltips, fichiers cliquables.
 */
export function SandboxPanel() {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<SandboxStatus | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error'; msg: string } | null>(null);
  const [realtimeEvents, setRealtimeEvents] = useState<number>(0);
  const [showCodeInput, setShowCodeInput] = useState(false);
  const [securityCode, setSecurityCode] = useState('');
  const [showResetCodeInput, setShowResetCodeInput] = useState(false);
  const [resetCode, setResetCode] = useState('');
  const [showDiffViewer, setShowDiffViewer] = useState(false);
  const [selectedDiffFile, setSelectedDiffFile] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const codeInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const resetCodeRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const hasFetched = useRef(false);
  const [expandedErrors, setExpandedErrors] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [askingAI, setAskingAI] = useState(false);
  const [validation, setValidation] = useState<ValidationState>({
    loading: false,
    ran: false,
    valid: true,
    errorCount: 0,
    warningCount: 0,
    diagnostics: [],
    errorsByFile: {},
    rawOutput: '',
  });

  const liveAPI = useLiveAPIContext();
  const { promptContext, connected } = liveAPI;

  const applyValidationResult = useCallback((data: any) => {
    setValidation({
      loading: false,
      ran: true,
      valid: !!data.valid,
      errorCount: data.errorCount ?? 0,
      warningCount: data.warningCount ?? 0,
      diagnostics: Array.isArray(data.diagnostics) ? data.diagnostics : [],
      errorsByFile: (data.errorsByFile && typeof data.errorsByFile === 'object') ? data.errorsByFile : {},
      rawOutput: data.rawOutput ?? data.errors ?? '',
    });
  }, []);

  const runValidation = useCallback(async () => {
    setValidation(v => ({ ...v, loading: true }));
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/sandbox/validate', { method: 'POST', headers: authHeaders() });
      if (!res.ok) {
        setValidation(v => ({ ...v, loading: false, ran: true, valid: false, errorCount: 0, warningCount: 0, diagnostics: [], errorsByFile: {}, rawOutput: `HTTP ${res.status}` }));
        return;
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      applyValidationResult(data);
    } catch {
      setValidation(v => ({ ...v, loading: false, ran: true, valid: false, errorCount: 0, warningCount: 0, diagnostics: [], errorsByFile: {}, rawOutput: 'Erreur réseau' }));
    }
  }, [applyValidationResult]);

  const askAIToFix = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!validation.ran) {
      await runValidation();
    }
    const filesWithIssues = Object.entries(validation.errorsByFile ?? {});
    if (filesWithIssues.length === 0) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'success', msg: 'Aucune erreur — rien à corriger' });
      return;
    }
    if (!liveAPI.connected) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', msg: 'Connecte d\'abord l\'assistant vocal (bouton orb)' });
      return;
    }
    setAskingAI(true);
    try {
      const fetched: string[] = [];
      for (const [file] of filesWithIssues) {
        try {
          const r = await fetch(`/api/sandbox/file-diff?path=${encodeURIComponent(file)}`, { headers: authHeaders() });
          if (r.ok) {
            const d = await r.json();
            if (typeof d.modified === 'string') {
              fetched.push(file + '||' + d.modified);
            }
          }
        } catch { /* skip */ }
      }

      const diagBlocks: string[] = [];
      for (const [file, diags] of filesWithIssues) {
        const list = (diags as TscDiagnostic[]).map(d =>
          `  • [${d.severity.toUpperCase()} ${d.code ?? ''}] L${d.line}${d.column !== null ? `:C${d.column}` : ''} — ${d.message}`
        ).join('\n');
        diagBlocks.push(`### Erreurs dans ${file} :\n${list}`);
      }

      const codeBlocks: string[] = [];
      for (const entry of fetched) {
        const [file, ...rest] = entry.split('||');
        const content = rest.join('||');
        codeBlocks.push(`### Contenu sandbox de ${file} :\n\`\`\`${file.endsWith('.tsx') || file.endsWith('.ts') ? 'typescript' : file.endsWith('.json') ? 'json' : ''}\n${content}\n\`\`\``);
      }

      const prompt = [
        '## DEMANDE : Corriger les erreurs TypeScript du SANDBOX',
        '',
        'Contexte : Les modifications ci-dessous se trouvent DANS LE SANDBOX (`.jarvis/sandbox/`) et ont été validées par `tsc --noEmit`. Il faut corriger uniquement les erreurs listées dans CHAQUE FICHIER, en respectant strictement l\'intention du code original. Ecris dans le sandbox via les outils `read_project_file`/`modify_project_file`/`write_project_file` en utilisant le path sandbox comme WORKSPACE TEMPORAIRE (le vrai workspace racine est le dossier contenant `.jarvis/sandbox/`).',
        '',
        '## Liste des erreurs TSC :',
        ...diagBlocks,
        '',
        '## Code sandbox complet (contenu modifié actuel) :',
        ...codeBlocks,
        '',
        'Règles à suivre OBLIGATOIREMENT :',
        '1. Lis d\'abord chaque fichier concerné dans le sandbox avant de le modifier.',
        '2. Corriger UNIQUEMENT les erreurs listées ci-dessus — ne PAS faire de refactoring, ne PAS toucher aux lignes non concernées.',
        '3. Conserver strictement le style, la structure, les noms de variables/fonctions existants.',
        '4. Après chaque modification : déclencher une re-validation via Valider (côté utilisateur) ou re-tenter tsx --noEmit.',
        '5. Si une erreur implique un fichier hors sandbox (dépendance du workspace principal), lire le fichier original pour comprendre l\'API attendue.',
        '6. Ne PAS synchroniser auto vers le workspace principal — laisse l\'utilisateur valider chaque changement.',
        '',
        'Commence par résumer brièvement ce que tu vas faire, puis applique les corrections fichier par fichier.',
      ].join('\n');

      liveAPI.sendTextMessage(prompt);
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('jarvis-ide-action', { detail: { type: 'open-ide' } }));
      setFeedback({ type: 'success', msg: `Demande envoyée — ${filesWithIssues.length} fichier(s) à corriger` });
    } catch (e: any) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', msg: e.message || 'Échec envoi' });
    } finally {
      setAskingAI(false);
    }
  }, [validation.errorsByFile, validation.ran, liveAPI, runValidation]);

  const fetchStatus = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/sandbox/status', { headers: authHeaders() });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'success') setStatus(data.sandbox);
    } catch { /* silent */ }
    finally { setLoading(false); }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hasFetched.current) return;
    hasFetched.current = true;
    fetchStatus();
  }, [fetchStatus]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (showCodeInput && codeInputRef.current) {
      codeInputRef.current.focus();
      return;
    }
    if (showResetCodeInput && resetCodeRef.current) {
      resetCodeRef.current.focus();
    }
  }, [showCodeInput, showResetCodeInput]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!status?.active) return;
    if (validation.ran) return;
    runValidation();
  }, [status?.active, validation.ran, runValidation]);

  useSandboxWatcher({
    enabled: status?.active ?? false,
    onFileChanged: useCallback((_rp: string) => {
      fetchStatus();
      setRealtimeEvents(prev => prev + 1);
    }, [fetchStatus]),
    onTreeChanged: useCallback(() => {
      fetchStatus();
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('jarvis-sandbox-changed'));
    }, [fetchStatus]),
    onFileDeleted: useCallback((_rp: string) => {
      fetchStatus();
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('jarvis-sandbox-changed'));
    }, [fetchStatus]),
  });

  const doAction = useCallback(async (action: string, method = 'POST', body?: object) => {
    setBusy(action);
    setFeedback(null);
    try {
      const headers: Record<string, string> = {
        ...authHeaders(),
        ...(body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : {}),
      };
      const res = await fetch(`/api/sandbox/${action}`, { method, headers, ...(body ? { body: JSON.stringify(body) } : {}) });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.status === 'success') {
        setFeedback({ type: 'success', msg: actionMessages[action] || 'OK' });
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('jarvis-sandbox-changed'));
        setShowCodeInput(false);
        setSecurityCode('');
        // Si sync réussit : reset validation à "clean"
                if (action === 'sync' || action === 'discard') {
                  applyValidationResult({ valid: true, errorCount: 0, warningCount: 0, diagnostics: [], errorsByFile: {}, rawOutput: '' });
                }
                if (action === 'init' || action === 'activate' || action === 'reset') {
                  runValidation();
                }
      } else if (data.status === 'validation_failed') {
        applyValidationResult(data);
        const filesInError = Object.keys(data.errorsByFile || {}).length;
        const errCount = data.errorCount ?? 0;
        let msg: string;
        if (errCount === 0 && filesInError === 0) {
          // Échec tsc sans erreurs parsées — problème de config ou chemin
          const raw = (data.rawOutput || data.errors || '').trim();
          msg = raw
            ? `Échec build (config tsc) — ${raw.slice(0, 120)}${raw.length > 120 ? '…' : ''}`
            : 'Échec build — vérifiez la config tsc du sandbox';
        } else {
          msg = `${errCount} erreur(s) dans ${filesInError} fichier(s) — voir les différences`;
        }
        setFeedback({ type: 'error', msg });
      } else {
        setFeedback({ type: 'error', msg: data.error || 'Erreur' });
      }
      await fetchStatus();
    } catch (e: any) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', msg: e.message || 'Erreur réseau' });
    } finally { setBusy(null); }
  }, [fetchStatus, applyValidationResult, runValidation]);

  const handleDeactivate = useCallback(() => {
    if (!showCodeInput) {
      setShowCodeInput(true);
      setSecurityCode('');
      setShowResetCodeInput(false);
      setFeedback(null);
      return;
    }
    if (securityCode.length !== 6) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', msg: '6 chiffres requis' });
      return;
    }
    doAction('deactivate', 'POST', { code: securityCode });
  }, [showCodeInput, securityCode, doAction]);

  const handleReset = useCallback(() => {
    if (!showResetCodeInput) {
      setShowResetCodeInput(true);
      setResetCode('');
      setShowCodeInput(false);
      setFeedback(null);
      return;
    }
    if (resetCode.length !== 6) {
      setFeedback({ type: 'error', msg: '6 chiffres requis' });
      return;
    }
    doAction('reset', 'POST', { code: resetCode });
  }, [showResetCodeInput, resetCode, doAction]);

  const actionMessages: Record<string, string> = {
      init: 'Sandbox initialisé',
      activate: 'Sandbox activé',
      deactivate: 'Sandbox désactivé',
      sync: 'Synchronisation réussie',
      discard: 'Modifications abandonnées',
      reset: 'Sandbox réinitialisé',
    };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!feedback) return;
    const t = setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 4000);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [feedback]);

  if (loading && !status) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-10" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
        <Loader2 size={14} className="animate-spin" />
        <span className="text-[11px]">Chargement…</span>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-3">

      {/* ═══ Status header ═══ */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 py-1">
        <div
          className="h-8 w-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center"
          style={{
            backgroundColor: status?.active
              ? 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success) 12%, transparent)'
              : 'var(--bg-input)',
          }}
        >
          <Box size={15} style={{ color: status?.active ? 'var(--color-success)' : 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              {status?.active ? 'Sandbox actif' : 'Sandbox inactif'}
            </span>
            {status?.active && <ShieldCheck size={11} style={{ color: 'var(--color-success)' }} />}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5 flex-wrap">
            <span className="text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
              {status?.modifiedCount ?? 0} modification{(status?.modifiedCount ?? 0) > 1 ? 's' : ''}
            </span>
            {validation.ran && (
              <span
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full px-1.5 py-[1px] text-[9px] font-bold"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: validation.valid
                    ? 'rgba(74,222,128,0.12)'
                    : 'rgba(248,113,113,0.12)',
                  color: validation.valid ? 'var(--color-success)' : '#f87171',
                }}
                title={validation.valid ? 'Build sandbox valide' : `Build sandbox invalide — ${validation.errorCount} erreurs`}
              >
                {validation.loading
                  ? <><Loader2 size={8} className="animate-spin" /> TSC…</>
                  : validation.valid
                  ? <><CheckCircle2 size={8} /> OK{validation.warningCount > 0 ? `·${validation.warningCount}w` : ''}</>
                  : <><AlertOctagon size={8} /> {validation.errorCount}{validation.warningCount > 0 ? `·${validation.warningCount}w` : ''}</>}
              </span>
            )}
            {realtimeEvents > 0 && (
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--color-success)' }}>
                <Radio size={7} className="animate-pulse" />
                live
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={fetchStatus}
          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors"
          title="Rafraîchir l'état du sandbox"
        >
          <RefreshCw size={12} className={loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''} style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* ═══ Contexte prompt temps réel ═══ */}
      <PromptContextIndicator context={promptContext} connected={connected} />

      {/* ═══ Quick actions — compact row ═══ */}
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">

        {/* Deactivate */}
        {status?.active && (
          <ActionRow
            icon={<Lock size={12} />}
            label="Désactiver"
            color="var(--color-warning)"
            onClick={handleDeactivate}
            busy={busy === 'deactivate'}
            tooltip="Entrez un code à 6 chiffres pour désactiver le sandbox"
          />
        )}

        {/* Activate */}
        {status?.exists && !status.active && (
          <ActionRow
            icon={<Power size={12} />}
            label="Activer"
            color="var(--color-success)"
            onClick={() => doAction('activate')}
            busy={busy === 'activate'}
            tooltip="Isoler les écritures dans le sandbox"
          />
        )}

        {/* Init */}
        {!status?.exists && (
          <ActionRow
            icon={<Box size={12} />}
            label="Initialiser"
            color="var(--accent-primary)"
            onClick={() => doAction('init')}
            busy={busy === 'init'}
            tooltip="Copier le code source dans un espace isolé"
          />
        )}

        {/* Validate build */}
        {status?.active && (
          <ActionRow
            icon={validation.loading ? <Loader2 size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : <Play size={12} />}
            label={validation.ran
              ? validation.valid
                ? `Build valide${validation.warningCount ? ` · ${validation.warningCount} warn` : ''}`
                : `Corriger ${validation.errorCount} erreur${validation.errorCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}`
              : 'Valider le build'}
            color={validation.ran && !validation.valid ? 'var(--color-error)' : 'var(--accent-primary)'}
            onClick={runValidation}
            busy={validation.loading}
            tooltip="Lancer TypeScript --noEmit sur le sandbox pour détecter erreurs et avertissements"
          />
        )}

        {/* Ask AI to fix */}
        {status?.active && validation.ran && (validation.errorCount + validation.warningCount) > 0 && (
          <ActionRow
            icon={askingAI ? <Loader2 size={12} className="animate-spin" /> : <Bot size={12} />}
            label={askingAI
              ? 'Envoi en cours…'
              : `Demander à l'IA de corriger (${Object.keys(validation.errorsByFile).length} fichier${Object.keys(validation.errorsByFile).length > 1 ? 's' : ''})`}
            color="var(--color-purple, #a78bfa)"
            onClick={askAIToFix}
            busy={askingAI}
            tooltip="Envoyer à l'assistant IA le code sandbox complet + toutes les erreurs TSC, avec instruction de ne corriger que ces erreurs"
          />
        )}

        {/* Security code input */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {showCodeInput && status?.active && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
              className="overflow-hidden"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)' }}>
                <input
                  ref={codeInputRef}
                  type="password"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  maxLength={6}
                  placeholder="Code 6 chiffres"
                  value={securityCode}
                  onChange={(e) => setSecurityCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6))}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') handleDeactivate();
                    if (e.key === 'Escape') { setShowCodeInput(false); setSecurityCode(''); }
                  }}
                  className="flex-1 bg-transparent outline-none text-[11px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-center"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleDeactivate}
                  disabled={securityCode.length !== 6}
                  className="text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded transition-opacity disabled:opacity-30"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--color-warning)' }}
                >
                  OK
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => { setShowCodeInput(false); setSecurityCode(''); }}
                  className="text-[9px] px-1 py-0.5 rounded hover:bg-white/10"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}
          {showResetCodeInput && status?.exists && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
              className="overflow-hidden"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)' }}>
                <input
                  ref={resetCodeRef}
                  type="password"
                  inputMode="numeric"
                  maxLength={6}
                  placeholder="Code 6 chiffres"
                  value={resetCode}
                  onChange={(e) => setResetCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 6))}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') handleReset();
                    if (e.key === 'Escape') { setShowResetCodeInput(false); setResetCode(''); }
                  }}
                  className="flex-1 bg-transparent outline-none text-[11px] font-mono tracking-[0.25em] text-center"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleReset}
                  disabled={resetCode.length !== 6}
                  className="text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded transition-opacity disabled:opacity-30"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--color-warning)' }}
                >
                  OK
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => { setShowResetCodeInput(false); setResetCode(''); }}
                  className="text-[9px] px-1 py-0.5 rounded hover:bg-white/10"
                  style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        {/* Separator */}
        {status?.active && status.modifiedCount > 0 && (
          <div className="h-px my-1" style={{ backgroundColor: 'var(--border-base)' }} />
        )}

        {/* View diff */}
        {status?.active && status.modifiedCount > 0 && (
          <ActionRow
            icon={<GitCompareArrows size={12} />}
            label="Voir les différences"
            color="var(--color-info)"
            onClick={() => {
              setSelectedDiffFile(null);
              setShowDiffViewer(true);
            }}
            busy={false}
            tooltip="Comparer avant/après, accepter ou rejeter fichier par fichier"
            highlight
          />
        )}

        {/* Sync */}
        {status?.active && status.modifiedCount > 0 && (
          <ActionRow
            icon={<Upload size={12} />}
            label="Synchroniser tout"
            color="var(--color-success)"
            onClick={() => doAction('sync')}
            busy={busy === 'sync'}
            tooltip="Valider le build puis appliquer toutes les modifications au repo principal"
          />
        )}

        {/* Discard */}
                {status?.active && status.modifiedCount > 0 && (
                  <ActionRow
                    icon={<Trash2 size={12} />}
                    label="Tout rejeter"
                    color="var(--color-error)"
                    onClick={() => doAction('discard')}
                    busy={busy === 'discard'}
                    tooltip="Supprimer toutes les modifications et réinitialiser le sandbox"
                  />
                )}

                {/* Reset sandbox */}
                {status?.exists && (
                  <ActionRow
                    icon={<RotateCcw size={12} />}
                    label="Réinitialiser sandbox"
                    color="var(--color-warning)"
                    onClick={handleReset}
                    busy={busy === 'reset'}
                    tooltip="Écraser le sandbox avec une copie fraîche du code source (code requis)"
                  />
                )}
              </div>

      {/* ═══ Modified files — clickable to open diff ═══ */}
      {status?.active && status.modifiedFiles.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mt-1">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1 mb-1.5">
            <span className="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
              Fichiers modifiés
            </span>
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-input)' }}>
              {status.modifiedFiles.length}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-0.5 max-h-44 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar">
            {status.modifiedFiles.map(f => {
              const isNew = false;
              const Icon = isNew ? FilePlus2 : FileCode2;
              const fileDiags = validation.ran ? (validation.errorsByFile[f] ?? []) : [];
              const errCount = fileDiags.filter(d => d.severity === 'error').length;
              const warnCount = fileDiags.filter(d => d.severity === 'warning').length;
              const hasIssues = errCount > 0 || warnCount > 0;
              const iconColor = hasIssues ? '#f87171' : (isNew ? '#4ade80' : 'var(--accent-primary)');

              return (
                <button
                  key={f}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setShowDiffViewer(true);
                    setSelectedDiffFile(f);
                  }}
                  className="group w-full flex items-center gap-2 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-left transition-all hover:bg-white/5"
                  style={{
                    borderLeft: hasIssues ? `2px solid rgba(248,113,113,0.45)` : '2px solid transparent',
                  }}
                  title={hasIssues
                    ? `${f} — ${errCount} erreur(s), ${warnCount} avertissement(s)`
                    : `Cliquer pour voir les modifications de ${f}`}
                >
                  <Icon size={11} style={{ color: iconColor, flexShrink: 0 }} />
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono truncate flex-1 transition-colors group-hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                    {f}
                  </span>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-shrink-0">
                    {errCount > 0 && (
                      <span
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full px-1 py-[1px] text-[8px] font-bold"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(248,113,113,0.15)', color: '#f87171' }}
                      >
                        <AlertOctagon size={7} />
                        {errCount}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    {warnCount > 0 && (
                      <span
                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full px-1 py-[1px] text-[8px] font-bold"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(251,191,36,0.15)', color: '#fbbf24' }}
                      >
                        <AlertTriangle size={7} />
                        {warnCount}
                      </span>
                    )}
                    <span className="text-[8px] opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                      diff →
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ═══ Validation errors panel — fichier par fichier ═══ */}

      {/* Cas tsc config error : valid=false mais aucune erreur parsée — afficher rawOutput */}
      {validation.ran && !validation.valid && validation.errorCount === 0 && validation.rawOutput && (
        <div
          className="rounded-lg overflow-hidden border"
          style={{ borderColor: 'rgba(248,113,113,0.25)', backgroundColor: 'rgba(248,113,113,0.04)' }}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5">
            <AlertOctagon size={11} style={{ color: '#f87171' }} />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold" style={{ color: '#f87171' }}>
              Échec build (configuration tsc)
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="px-2.5 pb-2.5">
            <pre
              className="text-[9.5px] font-mono whitespace-pre-wrap break-all max-h-40 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar rounded p-2"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)', color: '#fca5a5' }}
            >
              {validation.rawOutput}
            </pre>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {validation.ran && validation.errorCount + validation.warningCount > 0 && (
        <div
          className="rounded-lg overflow-hidden border"
          style={{
            borderColor: validation.errorCount > 0 ? 'rgba(248,113,113,0.25)' : 'rgba(251,191,36,0.25)',
            backgroundColor: validation.errorCount > 0 ? 'rgba(248,113,113,0.04)' : 'rgba(251,191,36,0.04)',
          }}
        >
          <div
            className="flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 cursor-pointer select-none"
            onClick={() => setExpandedErrors(v => !v)}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              {validation.errorCount > 0 ? (
                <AlertOctagon size={11} style={{ color: '#f87171' }} />
              ) : (
                <AlertTriangle size={11} style={{ color: '#fbbf24' }} />
              )}
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold" style={{ color: validation.errorCount > 0 ? '#f87171' : '#fbbf24' }}>
                {validation.errorCount} erreur{validation.errorCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}
                {validation.warningCount > 0 && ` · ${validation.warningCount} avertissement${validation.warningCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}`}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[9px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                dans {Object.keys(validation.errorsByFile).length} fichier{Object.keys(validation.errorsByFile).length > 1 ? 's' : ''}
              </span>
            </div>
            <ChevronDown size={12} style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)', transform: expandedErrors ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0)', transition: 'transform .15s' }} />
          </div>
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {expandedErrors && (
              <motion.div
                initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
                exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                className="overflow-hidden"
              >
                <div className="divide-y max-h-64 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)' }}>
                  {Object.entries(validation.errorsByFile).map(([file, diags]) => {
                    const errs = (diags as TscDiagnostic[]).filter(d => d.severity === 'error').length;
                    const warns = (diags as TscDiagnostic[]).filter(d => d.severity === 'warning').length;
                    return (
                      <div key={file} className="px-2.5 py-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1.5">
                          <FileCode2 size={9} style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)', flexShrink: 0 }} />
                          <span className="text-[9.5px] font-mono truncate flex-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
                            {file}
                          </span>
                          {errs > 0 && (
                            <span
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full px-1 py-[1px] text-[8px] font-bold"
                              style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(248,113,113,0.15)', color: '#f87171' }}
                            >
                              <AlertOctagon size={6} />{errs}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {warns > 0 && (
                            <span
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 rounded-full px-1 py-[1px] text-[8px] font-bold"
                              style={{ backgroundColor: 'rgba(251,191,36,0.15)', color: '#fbbf24' }}
                            >
                              <AlertTriangle size={6} />{warns}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <ul className="space-y-0.5 font-mono pl-2.5">
                          {(diags as TscDiagnostic[]).map((d, i) => (
                            <li key={i} className="flex gap-1.5 text-[9.5px] leading-snug">
                              <span
                                className="flex-shrink-0 w-20 text-right tabular-nums"
                                style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}
                              >
                                {d.line !== null
                                  ? `L${d.line}${d.column !== null ? `:C${d.column}` : ''}`
                                  : 'global'}
                              </span>
                              <span
                                className="flex-shrink-0 w-14 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider"
                                style={{
                                  color:
                                    d.severity === 'error' ? '#f87171' :
                                    d.severity === 'warning' ? '#fbbf24' :
                                    'var(--text-muted)',
                                }}
                              >
                                {d.code ?? d.severity}
                              </span>
                              <span style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }} className="flex-1">
                                {d.message}
                              </span>
                            </li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ═══ Last sync ═══ */}
      {status?.lastSync && (
        <p className="text-[9px] text-center mt-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
          Sync : {new Date(status.lastSync).toLocaleString('fr-FR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', day: '2-digit', month: '2-digit' })}
        </p>
      )}

      {/* ═══ Feedback ═══ */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {feedback && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-[10px] font-medium"
            style={{
              backgroundColor: feedback.type === 'success'
                ? 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success) 8%, transparent)'
                : 'color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-error) 8%, transparent)',
              color: feedback.type === 'success' ? 'var(--color-success)' : 'var(--color-error)',
            }}
          >
            {feedback.type === 'success' ? <CheckCircle2 size={11} /> : <XCircle size={11} />}
            <span>{feedback.msg}</span>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>

    {/* ═══ Diff Viewer overlay ═══ */}
    <AnimatePresence>
      {showDiffViewer && (
        <SandboxDiffViewer
          onClose={() => { setShowDiffViewer(false); setSelectedDiffFile(null); fetchStatus(); }}
          initialSelectedFile={selectedDiffFile}
        />
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  );
}

// ── ActionRow — compact button with icon, label, tooltip ─────────────────────

function ActionRow({ icon, label, color, onClick, busy, tooltip, highlight }: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  color: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  busy: boolean;
  tooltip: string;
  highlight?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <motion.button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={busy}
      whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}
      className="flex items-center gap-2.5 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 text-left transition-all disabled:opacity-50 w-full group"
      style={{
        backgroundColor: highlight
          ? `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 10%, transparent)`
          : 'transparent',
        border: highlight
          ? `1px solid color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 22%, transparent)`
          : '1px solid transparent',
      }}
      title={tooltip}
    >
      <div
        className="flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-md flex-shrink-0 transition-transform group-hover:scale-110"
        style={{ backgroundColor: `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 12%, transparent)`, color }}
      >
        {busy ? <Loader2 size={11} className="animate-spin" /> : icon}
      </div>
      <span className="text-[11px] font-medium transition-colors group-hover:text-[var(--text-primary)]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)' }}>
        {label}
      </span>
    </motion.button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { Clock3, CheckCircle2, Circle } from 'lucide-react';
import { Panel } from '../ui/Panel';

export interface ScheduledTaskViewModel {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  actionName: string;
  intervalMs: number;
  enabled?: boolean;
  lastRunAt?: number;
}

interface ScheduledTasksPanelProps {
  tasks: ScheduledTaskViewModel[];
  onRefresh?: () => Promise<void> | void;
}

function formatInterval(ms: number) {
  if (ms >= 3600_000) return `${(ms / 3600_000).toFixed(ms % 3600_000 === 0 ? 0 : 1)}h`;
  if (ms >= 60_000) return `${Math.round(ms / 60_000)}m`;
  return `${Math.round(ms / 1000)}s`;
}

function formatRelative(ts?: number) {
  if (!ts) return 'Jamais';
  const diff = Date.now() - ts;
  if (diff < 60_000) return 'À l’instant';
  if (diff < 3_600_000) return `${Math.round(diff / 60_000)}m`; 
  return `${Math.round(diff / 3_600_000)}h`;
}

export const ScheduledTasksPanel = React.memo(function ScheduledTasksPanel({ tasks, onRefresh }: ScheduledTasksPanelProps) {
  const [busyId, setBusyId] = React.useState<string | null>(null);

  const runAction = React.useCallback(async (path: string, method: 'POST' | 'DELETE' = 'POST') => {
    setBusyId(path);
    try {
      await fetch(path, { method });
      await onRefresh?.();
    } finally {
      setBusyId(null);
    }
  }, [onRefresh]);

  return (
    <Panel title="Tâches planifiées" icon={<Clock3 className="w-4 h-4" />}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {tasks.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="rounded-xl border px-3 py-3 text-[11px]" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
            Aucune tâche planifiée pour le moment.
          </div>
        ) : (
          tasks.map((task) => (
            <div key={task.id} className="rounded-xl border px-3 py-2.5" style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)' }}>
              <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                <div className="mt-0.5"><CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} /></div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>{task.name}</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{formatInterval(task.intervalMs)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] mt-0.5" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>{task.description || task.actionName}</div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1 text-[10px]" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><Circle className="w-2.5 h-2.5" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />{task.actionName}</span>
                    <span>•</span>
                    <span>Dernière exécution: {formatRelative(task.lastRunAt)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => runAction(`/api/automation/scheduled-tasks/${task.id}/toggle`)}
                      disabled={busyId === task.id}
                      className="rounded-md border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                      style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}
                    >
                      {task.enabled === false ? 'Reprendre' : 'Pause'}
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => runAction(`/api/automation/scheduled-tasks/${task.id}/run`)}
                      disabled={busyId === task.id}
                      className="rounded-md border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                      style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}
                    >
                      Exécuter
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => runAction(`/api/automation/scheduled-tasks/${task.id}`, 'DELETE')}
                      disabled={busyId === task.id}
                      className="rounded-md border px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-semibold disabled:opacity-50"
                      style={{ borderColor: 'var(--border-base)', color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }}
                    >
                      Supprimer
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        )}
      </div>
    </Panel>
  );
});
```

```tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { MessageSquare, Trash2, User, Cpu } from 'lucide-react';
import { Panel } from '../ui/Panel';
import { IconButton } from '../ui/IconButton';
import type { TranscriptEntry } from '../../hooks/useLiveAPI';
import { useProfile } from '../../context/UserProfileContext';

interface SessionTranscriptPanelProps {
  transcript: TranscriptEntry[];
  onClear: () => void;
}

function timeLabel(d: Date): string {
  return d.toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
}

export const SessionTranscriptPanel = React.memo(function SessionTranscriptPanel({
  transcript,
  onClear,
}: SessionTranscriptPanelProps) {
  const { profile } = useProfile();
  const bottomRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [transcript.length]);

  return (
    <Panel
      title="Session"
      icon={<MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />}
      actions={
        <IconButton
          variant="default"
          icon={<Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
          onClick={onClear}
          tooltip="Clear transcript"
          aria-label="Clear transcript"
          className="p-1.5 rounded-lg"
        />
      }
    >
      <div
        className="h-64 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col gap-3 pr-1 custom-scrollbar"
        role="log"
        aria-label="Conversation transcript"
        aria-live="polite"
      >
        {transcript.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-2">
            <MessageSquare className="w-6 h-6" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }} />
            <p className="text-[11px] text-center" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
              La conversation apparaîtra ici.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {transcript.map((entry) => {
              const isAssistant = entry.role === 'assistant';
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={entry.id}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
                  className={`flex gap-2 ${isAssistant ? 'flex-row' : 'flex-row-reverse'}`}
                >
                  {/* Avatar */}
                  <div
                    className="w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex-shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center mt-0.5"
                    style={{
                      backgroundColor: isAssistant ? 'var(--accent-subtle)' : 'var(--bg-secondary)',
                      border: `1px solid ${isAssistant ? 'var(--border-focus)' : 'var(--border-base)'}`,
                    }}
                  >
                    {isAssistant
                      ? <Cpu className="w-3 h-3" style={{ color: 'var(--accent-primary)' }} />
                      : <User className="w-3 h-3" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }} />
                    }
                  </div>

                  {/* Bubble */}
                  <div className={`flex flex-col gap-0.5 max-w-[80%] ${isAssistant ? 'items-start' : 'items-end'}`}>
                    <div
                      className="px-3 py-2 rounded-2xl text-xs leading-relaxed"
                      style={{
                        backgroundColor: isAssistant ? 'var(--bg-secondary)' : 'var(--accent-subtle)',
                        border: `1px solid ${isAssistant ? 'var(--border-base)' : 'var(--border-focus)'}`,
                        color: isAssistant ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--accent-primary)',
                        borderRadius: isAssistant
                          ? '4px 14px 14px 14px'
                          : '14px 4px 14px 14px',
                      }}
                    >
                      {/* Speaker label */}
                      <span
                        className="block text-[9px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider mb-1 opacity-60"
                      >
                        {isAssistant ? profile.aiName || 'Leanna' : profile.userName || 'Vous'}
                      </span>
                      {entry.text}
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[9px] font-mono px-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-dimmed)' }}>
                      {timeLabel(entry.timestamp)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        )}
        <div ref={bottomRef} />
      </div>
    </Panel>
  );
});
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { motion } from 'motion/react';
import {
  Blocks, Clock, CloudRain, Github, Globe, Database,
  Monitor, Code, List, Brain, Zap,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Panel } from '../ui/Panel';
import { Toggle } from '../ui/Toggle';

const iconMap: Record<string, React.FC<React.SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>>> = {
  Clock, CloudRain, Github, Globe, Database,
  Monitor, Blocks, Code, List, Brain,
};

interface Skill {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  icon: string;
  status: string;
}

interface SkillsPanelProps {
  skills: Skill[];
  enabledSkills: Record<string, boolean>;
  onToggle: (id: string) => void;
}

function StatusBadge({ status, enabled }: { status: string; enabled: boolean }) {
  const isConfigured = status === 'active' || status === 'authenticated';

  const label = !isConfigured ? 'Auth requise' : enabled ? 'Actif' : 'Inactif';
  const color = !isConfigured
    ? 'var(--color-warning, #f59e0b)'
    : enabled
      ? 'var(--color-success, #10b981)'
      : 'var(--text-dimmed)';

  return (
    <span
      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full"
      style={{
        color,
        backgroundColor: `color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 12%, transparent)`,
        border: `1px solid color-mix(in srgb, ${color} 25%, transparent)`,
      }}
    >
      <span
        className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full"
        style={{ backgroundColor: color }}
      />
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export const SkillsPanel = React.memo(function SkillsPanel({ skills, enabledSkills, onToggle }: SkillsPanelProps) {
  const activeCount = skills.filter(s =>
    (s.status === 'active' || s.status === 'authenticated') && enabledSkills[s.id] !== false
  ).length;

  return (
    <Panel
      title="Skills"
      icon={<Zap className="w-4 h-4" />}
      actions={
        <span
          className="text-[11px] font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full"
          style={{
            color: 'var(--color-success, #10b981)',
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.1)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.25)',
          }}
        >
          {activeCount}/{skills.length} actifs
        </span>
      }
    >
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        {skills.map((skill, i) => {
          const Icon = iconMap[skill.icon] || Blocks;
          const isConfigured = skill.status === 'active' || skill.status === 'authenticated';
          const isEnabled = isConfigured && enabledSkills[skill.id] !== false;

          return (
            <motion.div
              key={skill.id}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.2, delay: i * 0.03 }}
              className="group flex flex-col items-center gap-2 px-3 py-3 rounded-xl transition-all duration-150"
              style={{
                backgroundColor: isEnabled ? 'var(--bg-secondary)' : 'transparent',
                border: `1px solid ${isEnabled ? 'var(--border-strong)' : 'var(--border-base)'}`,
              }}
            >
              {/* Icon */}
              <div
                className="p-2 rounded-lg flex-shrink-0 transition-colors duration-150"
                style={{
                  backgroundColor: isEnabled ? 'var(--accent-subtle, rgba(14,165,233,0.1))' : 'var(--bg-secondary)',
                  color: isEnabled ? 'var(--accent-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)',
                }}
              >
                <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>

              {/* Name */}
              <span
                className="text-xs font-medium text-center truncate w-full"
                style={{ color: isEnabled ? 'var(--text-primary)' : 'var(--text-muted)' }}
              >
                {skill.name}
              </span>

              {/* Toggle or configure */}
              {isConfigured ? (
                <Toggle
                  checked={isEnabled}
                  onChange={() => onToggle(skill.id)}
                  aria-label={`Toggle ${skill.name}`}
                />
              ) : (
                <span
                  className="text-[10px] font-medium px-2 py-1 rounded-lg"
                  style={{
                    color: 'var(--text-dimmed)',
                    backgroundColor: 'var(--bg-secondary)',
                    border: '1px solid var(--border-base)',
                  }}
                >
                  Configurer
                </span>
              )}
            </motion.div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </Panel>
  );
});
```
